raw.description:
Chief Project Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Project Officer (CPO) is responsible for leading the organization's strategic project portfolio, enterprise-wide program management, and major transformation initiatives across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that strategic projects are properly planned, prioritized, funded, executed, and delivered in alignment with organizational goals. The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and senior management team, the CPO will establish effective project governance, optimize resources, manage delivery risks, and ensure measurable business outcomes from the organization's project investments.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Project & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide project management and portfolio strategy.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and oversee strategic projects across insurance and investment business units.
  • Ensure project portfolios align with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, business cases, resource requirements, expected returns, and implementation risks.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and ensure projects deliver their intended strategic and financial benefits.

Insurance & Investment Project Delivery

  • Lead strategic initiatives involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee projects involving new insurance product launches, policy administration systems, claims management, underwriting processes, and distribution expansion.
  • Manage investment-related initiatives involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Coordinate projects involving regulatory changes, business process modernization, and operational restructuring.
  • Support the implementation of new business models, financial products, and market expansion initiatives.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Establish and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO), including project standards, methodologies, policies, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Ensure consistent project management practices across business units and subsidiaries.
  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Present portfolio performance reports, major risks, and project recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.
  • Oversee projects involving insurance technology (InsurTech), financial technology (FinTech), automation, AI, cloud platforms, CRM, and enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and investment service platforms.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, and CDO teams to ensure technology projects meet business requirements.
  • Monitor technology implementation costs, timelines, system integration, and business adoption.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and manage project portfolio budgets and investment plans.
  • Monitor expenditure, cost variations, financial performance, and project profitability.
  • Optimize resource allocation across projects, departments, and business units.
  • Evaluate project return on investment (ROI), cost-benefit analysis, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify and manage project-related operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk management, legal, compliance, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish risk mitigation, contingency, and business continuity plans for critical projects.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and organizational requirements.

Business Transformation & Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead cross-functional transformation programs aimed at improving operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Support organizational restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration projects.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving geographic expansion, new market entry, and business diversification.
  • Drive process improvement, automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Track business benefits and ensure successful adoption of project outcomes.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to establish project priorities.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders, regulators, investors, consultants, and external partners, as appropriate.
  • Resolve project conflicts involving scope, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation.
  • Provide executive-level updates on project performance, delivery challenges, and strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead project directors, program managers, project managers, and PMO professionals.
  • Develop high-performing project delivery teams across multiple business units.
  • Establish accountability, performance standards, and professional development programs.
  • Promote a culture of project ownership, collaboration, innovation, and delivery excellence.
  • Introduce project management tools, dashboards, and performance measurement systems.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Finance, Business Strategy, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership position overseeing complex project portfolios and strategic programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale, multi-departmental projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience establishing and managing enterprise PMOs and project governance frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and other project delivery methodologies.
  • Strong financial planning, budgeting, risk management, and resource allocation capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic projects delivered on time and within budget.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and strategic alignment.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Achievement of project milestones and approved deliverables.
  • Return on investment (ROI) and realization of expected business benefits.
  • Successful delivery of insurance and investment transformation initiatives.
  • Project risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Resource utilization and project team productivity.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project quality ratings.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.
  • Successful execution of digital transformation and business expansion projects.

In this role, you’ll lead the development of analytical solutions that illuminate critical KPIs, uncover performance trends, and support strategic decision-making across the business. You’ll partner closely with stakeholders to map business processes, align data solutions with real-world operations, and conduct deep-dive analyses that solve high-value challenges. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape how data informs strategy and contributes to our mission of creating healthier lives.

As a Sr. BI & Data Analyst you will be focused on:

Our team thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. We work closely with cross-functional engineering and business partners to deliver impactful data and analytics solutions that shape the future of research and development.

In this role, primary responsibilities include:

  • Analyzing complex scientific datasets to uncover meaningful insights and support strategic initiatives.
  • Mapping key business process rules to ensure data solutions align with operational realities.
  • Creating insight-driven solutions that bring visibility into critical KPIs and performance metrics.
  • Conducting deep-dive analyses to solve challenging problems and support evidence-based recommendations.
  • Engage Business Stakeholders at all levels to identify requirements for current and future products through ongoing interaction.
  • Lead requirements workshops and User Acceptance Testing for new data, products and analytics solutions.
  • Analyze business processes and develop business flow diagrams and data flow diagrams to support system design and optimization.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
  • Data Profiling, mining, and data validation/testing to ensure data is fit for use by the business.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and present results in a clear and user-friendly manner.
  • Build strong business relationships that foster a collaborative and trusting approach and partnership.

We are looking for the following minimum qualifications for this role:

  • Bachelor degree in Business Management, Computer Science or any related field.
  • Master in Business Administration/ Information Systems/ Computer Science is an asset.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to approach challenges creatively.
  • Ability to understand and make sense of complex datasets with a strong attention to detail
  • Ability to translate requirements to well-written user stories to bridge the gap between business and technology.
  • Strong business mindset with ability to collaborate with business partners to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management and delivery.
  • Ability to see big picture and then identify key areas for deep analysis to support sound solutions.
  • Self-driven and capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
  • Experience in life science or Biotechnology industry is a plus.

Technical Expertise required:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in writing complex SQL queries, data mining, data profiling, and data validation/testing;

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience organizing and running User Acceptance Testing cycles and training with business users and stakeholders;
  • Experience working with Data Visualization Tools like Power BI, Tableau, Looker, MicroStrategy
  • Experienced working in Agile Software Development Methodology.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Sutherland:

At Sutherland Healthcare Solutions, we’re transforming how we work by harnessing the power of AI, data, and digital innovation to accelerate the discovery and development of life-saving therapies. Our vision is to embed artificial intelligence and advanced analytics across every stage of our scientific and operational workflows—empowering our teams with smarter tools, seamless data, and actionable insights to deliver client-centric services and solutions that better serve our customers and, ultimately, improve patients’ lives.

raw.title: Engenheiro de Análise Virtual de Desempenho de Veículos e Potência Fluida (Moden
raw.excerpt: Sobre Nós Inovação.  Sustentabilidade.  Produtividade.
raw.description:
Sobre Nós

Inovação. Sustentabilidade. Produtividade. É assim que estamos abrindo novos caminhos em nossa missão de promover, de forma sustentável, o nobre trabalho de agricultores e construtores em todos os lugares. Com uma população global crescente e demandas aumentadas por recursos, nossos produtos são fundamentais para alimentar e abrigar o mundo.

Desde o desenvolvimento de produtos que funcionam com energia alternativa até tecnologias de precisão que aumentam a produtividade, estamos entregando soluções que beneficiam as pessoas – e elas são possíveis graças a pessoas como você. Se a oportunidade de desenvolver suas habilidades como parte de uma equipe global e colaborativa o entusiasma, você está no lugar certo.

Desenvolva uma Carreira. Construa um Futuro!

Faça parte desta empresa na vanguarda da agricultura e construção, que inova apaixonadamente para impulsionar a eficiência e o sucesso do cliente. E sabemos que a inovação não pode acontecer sem colaboração. Portanto, tudo o que fazemos na CNH Industrial trata de alcançar novos patamares como uma equipe, sempre entregando para o bem de nossos clientes.

Objetivo do Cargo

  • O candidato selecionado apoiará o desenvolvimento de veículos fora de estrada de próxima geração, contribuindo para decisões de engenharia desde as fases iniciais de desenvolvimento de conceito até a validação final do produto.
  • O Engenheiro de Desempenho de Veículos e Sistemas Hidráulicos é responsável por definir, avaliar e otimizar o desempenho em nível de veículo por meio de análise de engenharia, simulações virtuais, modelagem de sistemas e atividades de correlação experimental, trabalhando em sistemas de trem de força, transmissão, hidráulicos, eletrificados e sistemas veiculares.
  • O candidato será solicitado a realizar simulações de conceito em fase inicial, permitindo estudos de trade-off de arquitetura e avaliação virtual de tecnologias emergentes antes que o hardware esteja disponível, dentro de projetos multidisciplinares complexos coordenados em organizações globais de engenharia.
  • O candidato selecionado contribuirá para a avaliação de soluções inovadoras, incluindo sistemas de potência fluida avançados, trens de força híbridos, eletrificação de veículos e tecnologias de combustíveis alternativos, apoiando a transição para máquinas fora de estrada mais sustentáveis e eficientes.

Principais Responsabilidades

Engenharia de Desempenho de Veículos

  • Analisar e otimizar a produtividade do veículo, eficiência de combustível, utilização de energia e desempenho geral da máquina.
  • Apoiar a definição de metas e requisitos do veículo.
  • Realizar análises de fluxo de potência e balanço energético em nível de veículo.
  • Avaliar a eficiência da transmissão, capacidade de tração e desempenho operacional.
  • Conduzir benchmarking competitivo e avaliações de tecnologia.

Engenharia de Sistemas Hidráulicos

  • Desenvolver e validar arquiteturas, subsistemas e componentes hidráulicos.
  • Analisar a eficiência hidráulica e perdas de potência em nível de componente, subsistema e veículo.
  • Otimizar o desempenho do sistema considerando estratégias de controle, consumo de energia e perfis de uso do cliente.
  • Apoiar a definição de soluções inovadoras de sistemas hidráulicos para futuras plataformas de veículos.

Hibridização, Eletrificação e Combustíveis Alternativos

  • Apoiar estudos de viabilidade e atividades de integração de sistemas para arquiteturas de veículos híbridos e eletrificados.
  • Avaliar estratégias de gerenciamento de energia entre subsistemas convencionais e eletrificados.
  • Avaliar fluxos de energia, utilização da bateria e eficiência geral do sistema.
  • Analisar o impacto de combustíveis alternativos (HVO, Biodiesel, GNL, GNC, Hidrogênio e futuras soluções de baixo carbono) no desempenho e eficiência do veículo.
  • Apoiar roteiros tecnológicos e atividades de seleção de conceitos para o desenvolvimento sustentável de veículos.

Desenvolvimento de Conceito em Fase Inicial e Engenharia Virtual

  • Realizar simulações de conceito em fase inicial para apoiar decisões de arquitetura antes da disponibilidade de protótipos.
  • Conduzir análises de trade-off entre conceitos e tecnologias concorrentes.
  • Desenvolver metodologias de avaliação virtual para desempenho do veículo, economia de combustível, produtividade e eficiência hidráulica.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de engenharia "shift-left" por meio de abordagens de desenvolvimento baseadas em modelos.
  • Gerar recomendações baseadas em dados para acelerar o desenvolvimento e reduzir o risco do programa.

Simulação e Modelagem de Sistemas

  • Desenvolver e manter modelos de simulação de alta fidelidade e de ordem reduzida.
  • Executar atividades de validação virtual em nível de componente, subsistema e veículo completo.
  • Correlacionar resultados de simulação com medições experimentais.
  • Apoiar processos de engenharia baseados em modelos durante todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento do produto.
  • Utilizar ambientes de simulação como AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink e outras ferramentas de análise de engenharia.

Liderança de Projetos e Gestão de Stakeholders

  • Liderar fluxos de trabalho técnicos dentro de projetos multidisciplinares complexos.
  • Coordenar atividades entre equipes globais de engenharia e múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Impulsionar o alinhamento técnico e os processos de tomada de decisão.
  • Apresentar resultados de simulação, recomendações técnicas e atualizações de projetos para a gerência e liderança de engenharia.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de projetos, identificação de riscos e atividades de mitigação.
  • Interagir com fornecedores, parceiros de pesquisa e organizações externas de engenharia quando necessário.

Experiência Necessária

COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS (HARD SKILLS)

  • Mestrado em engenharia mecânica, automotiva, de energia ou aeroespacial, ou equivalente
  • Experiência profissional na indústria de veículos fora de estrada, agrícolas, de construção, automotivos ou comerciais - anos de experiência: 3-5
  • Conhecimento de princípios de desempenho de veículos, trem de força, transmissão e gerenciamento de energia
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de potência fluida: arquiteturas hidráulicas, subsistemas, componentes, eficiência e perdas de potência
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas de veículos fora de estrada híbridos e eletrificados, gerenciamento de energia veicular e tecnologias de combustíveis alternativos (HVO, Biodiesel, GNL, GNC, Hidrogênio)
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de simulação como AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink e outras ferramentas de análise de engenharia
  • Abordagem de Engenharia de Sistemas; exposição a Engenharia de Sistemas Baseada em Modelos (MBSE) será um diferencial
  • Técnicas avançadas de otimização e Planejamento de Experimentos (DoE), análise de dados e ferramentas de visualização
  • Engenharia digital e metodologias de validação virtual; aplicações de Inteligência Artificial para fluxos de trabalho de engenharia (preferencial)

COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS (SOFT SKILLS)

  • Forte mentalidade de engenharia de sistemas e excelentes habilidades analíticas
  • Capacidade de traduzir informações técnicas complexas em recomendações acionáveis que impulsionam decisões de negócios e produtos
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de apresentar resultados de simulação e recomendações técnicas para a gerência e liderança de engenharia
  • Capacidade de coordenar atividades entre equipes globais de engenharia e múltiplos stakeholders (engenharia de produto, controles, validação, manufatura, gestão de programas, fornecedores e parceiros técnicos)
  • Capacidade de trabalhar tanto de forma autônoma quanto como parte de uma equipe global multidisciplinar
  • Comprometimento com prazos, marcos e cronogramas estabelecidos
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais.

Qualificações Preferenciais

  • Pronto e disposto a assumir responsabilidade e prestar contas por suas próprias ações e decisões
  • Esforçar-se pela autonomia
  • Comunicação aberta e transparente
  • Oferecer suporte incondicional e superar as expectativas
  • Focado em objetivos e soluções (e não em obstáculos).

Transparência Salarial

O salário anual para esta função é de EUR €39.000,00 - €52.000,00 mais qualquer bônus aplicável (os salários reais variarão e serão baseados em vários fatores, como habilidades, experiência e qualificação para a função.)

Para funções abertas em vários locais, a faixa salarial indicada refere-se ao local principal. Se um local diferente for considerado, a faixa salarial aplicável será comunicada aos candidatos antes da primeira entrevista.

O Que Oferecemos

Oferecemos oportunidades de carreira dinâmicas em um cenário internacional. Como um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais, estamos comprometidos em gerar valor para todos os nossos funcionários e promover uma cultura de respeito.

Na CNH, entendemos que as melhores soluções vêm das diversas experiências e habilidades de nossas pessoas. Aqui, você terá autonomia para desenvolver sua carreira, seguir sua paixão e ajudar a construir um futuro melhor. Para apoiar nossos funcionários, oferecemos benefícios regionais abrangentes, incluindo:

  • Arranjos de trabalho flexíveis
  • Benefícios de poupança e aposentadoria
  • Reembolso de mensalidades escolares
  • Licença parental
  • Assistência à adoção
  • Suporte à fertilidade e planejamento familiar
  • Programas de Assistência ao Funcionário
  • Correspondência de contribuições de caridade e folga remunerada para voluntariado

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Trust & Safety Engineering protects Affirm’s consumers, merchants, and network from fraud and abuse. We build the real-time systems, risk signals, and tools that stop bad actors without adding friction for the people we serve. Our engineers work with data science, risk, and operations to stay ahead of evolving threats at scale

You will be matched with a role after completing the interview evaluation process. Your recruiter will work closely with you throughout the process to understand your interests and experience to find the strongest role fit.

What you’ll do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What we look for

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - USA 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA Pacific base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT): $195,000 - $255,000

USA Sapphire base pay range (all other U.S. states): $173,000 - $233,000

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

raw.description:
Are you motivated to participate in a dynamic, multi-tasking environment? Do you want to join a company that invests in its employees? Are you seeking a position where you can use your skills while continuing to be challenged and learn? Then we encourage you to dive deeper into this opportunity.

NeoGenomics has an opening for a Temporary Certified Coding Specialist who wants to continue to learn in order to allow our company to grow.

Shift: Monday – Friday, Remote role.

Now that you know what we're looking for in talent, let us tell you why you'd want to work at NeoGenomics:

As an employer, we promise to provide you with a purpose driven mission in which you have the opportunity to save lives by improving patient care through the exceptional work you perform. Together, we will become the world's leading cancer reference laboratory.

Position Summary:

As a Certified Coding Specialist, you will analyze medical records and abstracts clinical data by assigning codes from patient records in accordance to coding classification systems. You will also interact with physicians when code assignments are not straightforward or documentation in the record is inadequate, ambiguous or unclear for coding purposes. Identifies and reports documentation issues and may participate in team education activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Abstracts relevant clinical and demographic information from the medical record to assign current ICD10 and CPT codes in accordance with coding and reimbursement guidelines
  • Identifies principal and secondary ICD10 diagnosis codes with minimal error based on national based standards
  • Codes with an accuracy of 97% based on QA internal reviews
  • Records all diagnostic procedures and assigns appropriate procedure codes
  • Requests diagnosis from physicians when information is not recorded
  • Determines and records required medical information
  • Maintains the confidentiality of medical information contained in each record and protects data by following HIPAA compliant regulations

Experience, Education and Qualifications:

  • AAPC or AHIMA Certification required
  • Minimum experience for this position should have at least 1-year of medical coding experience
  • Thorough knowledge of ICD10 diagnosis coding and official coding guidelines
  • Thorough knowledge of CPT coding, NCCI and modifier usage
  • Thorough knowledge of CMS LCD/NCD and payer medical policies
  • Thorough knowledge of anatomy and physiology in addition to medical terminology and disease process

title: Business/Sales Development Representative

raw.title: Business/Sales Development Representative
raw.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a proactive, commercially minded Business Development Representative (BDR) to join Gcore's centralized Business Development team.
raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded Business Development Representative (BDR) to join Gcore's centralized Business Development team.
In this role, you will help drive Gcore's growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers through inbound inquiries, targeted outbound prospecting, industry events, and customer reactivation initiatives.
You will be one of the first points of contact for prospective customers, helping them understand how Gcore's solutions can address their business needs and guiding them toward the right next step.
This is more than a meeting-booking role. We are looking for someone who can have meaningful customer conversations, recognize genuine commercial opportunities, and contribute to a high-quality sales pipeline.
You will independently manage your prospecting and qualification activities while collaborating closely with Sales, Marketing, Presales, Product, and Customer Support teams.

What You'll Do

Identify and Qualify Business Opportunities

  • Engage prospective customers through inbound inquiries, outbound prospecting, industry events, and customer reactivation.
  • Research target companies, identify key decision-makers, and personalize outreach based on business needs.
  • Initiate conversations through email, phone, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer challenges, purchase intent, and commercial potential.
  • Qualify opportunities against established criteria and ensure smooth handovers to the appropriate Sales representatives.

Guide Customers Toward the Right Solutions

  • Develop a practical understanding of Gcore's products, services, and customer use cases.
  • Identify when customers would benefit from a consultative sales engagement or a self-service solution.
  • Guide prospective customers through available options, pricing information, and next steps.
  • Collaborate with Presales, Product, and Customer Support teams when additional expertise is required.

Manage and Improve Prospecting Activities

  • Independently manage assigned target accounts, prospecting initiatives, and follow-up activities.
  • Participate in industry events, including prospect engagement and post-event follow-up.
  • Re-engage former customers to identify potential new business opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve outreach effectiveness, qualification quality, and customer engagement.
  • Share market insights, customer feedback, and successful approaches with the team.

Collaborate and Deliver Results

  • Work closely with Sales to understand commercial priorities and opportunity qualification expectations.
  • Partner with Marketing to improve lead quality, targeting, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect information, interactions, and qualification outcomes in HubSpot.
  • Take ownership of the quality of opportunities generated and ensure timely follow-up.
  • Consistently contribute to team pipeline generation objectives.

What We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales development, inside sales, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.
  • Experience with prospecting, lead qualification, and customer engagement.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence in initiating conversations with prospective customers.
  • Ability to understand customer needs, ask relevant questions, and identify commercial opportunities.
  • A proactive, results-oriented mindset with the ability to manage daily activities independently.
  • Strong research and organizational skills, with attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize activities, manage follow-ups, and consistently deliver results.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different teams.
  • Fluent English and at least one additional language.
  • Willingness to travel internationally for industry events and customer engagement.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, or related industries.
  • Familiarity with CDN, DDoS protection, WAF/WAAP, cloud computing, hosting, or networking solutions.
  • Experience with both inbound and outbound lead generation.
  • Exposure to account-based prospecting, ICP segmentation, or sales engagement tools.
  • Experience attending trade shows, conferences, or industry networking events.
  • German, French, or other European languages.
  • Experience with customer reactivation or win-back initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

Your primary measure of success will be the number of Sales Qualified Opportunities (SQOs) you generate.
An SQO is a genuine commercial opportunity where customer needs and purchase intent have been established, clear next steps are defined, and the opportunity has been accepted by the Sales team.

You will be successful when you:

  • Consistently generate high-quality Sales Qualified Opportunities.
  • Independently manage your prospecting and qualification activities.
  • Identify genuine customer needs and connect prospects with the appropriate Sales expertise.
  • Ensure smooth opportunity handovers and accurate CRM documentation.
  • Maintain timely and consistent communication with prospects.
  • Build productive relationships across Sales, Marketing, Presales, and Product.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve your effectiveness and contribute to team results.

Why Join This Team?

You will play a direct role in Gcore's commercial growth by connecting prospective customers with solutions that address their business needs.
You will gain exposure to different customer segments, technologies, and European markets while developing your commercial expertise within a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
We value initiative, meaningful customer engagement, continuous learning, and the quality of opportunities created — not simply the volume of outreach activities.

Benefits

At Gcore, we want you to do your best work and enjoy the journey. Our benefits are designed to support your growth, well-being, and life beyond work:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid or remote options, depending on your role
  • Work from anywhere in the world for up to 45 days per year
  • Private medical insurance for you and your family*
  • Extra paid vacation and sick leave days*
  • Support for life’s important moments and celebrations
  • Language courses to help you connect and grow
  • Modern, welcoming offices with snacks, drinks, and entertainment*
  • Team sports and social activities*

*Benefits may vary depending on your location.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The world’s digital experiences run on something invisible: the infrastructure and software that keep them fast, reliable, and secure. At Gcore, you’ll help design and deliver that foundation for an AI-driven world.

We’re a global provider of infrastructure and software solutions for AI, cloud, network, and security, powering everything from real-time communication and streaming to enterprise AI and secure web applications. With 210+ edge locations, 50+ cloud regions, and thousands of GPUs, your work here can reach users and businesses across the globe.

You’ll collaborate with leading technology partners such as Intel, NVIDIA, Dell, and Equinix, and work on platforms that power digital products used around the world. Our vision is simple: to connect the world to AI, anywhere, anytime.

Want to work on technology that goes beyond a single product or industry? Join a global team of 550+ professionals building infrastructure and software that supports the entire digital ecosystem.

raw.excerpt: OverviewCotiviti Healthcare is a leading provider of payment accuracy services to the most recognized companies in the healthcare and retail industries.
raw.description:
Overview

Cotiviti Healthcare is a leading provider of payment accuracy services to the most recognized companies in the healthcare and retail industries. We are seeking innovative thinkers and creative problem solvers who are interested in making a contribution to improving healthcare and want to be part of a team that is expanding rapidly and providing opportunities for career growth. If you want to make a difference and contribute to the improvement of healthcare payment integrity, consider an opportunity to join our healthcare recovery team as a Payment Accuracy Specialist.

A Payment Accuracy Specialist 1 is a member of the greater Data Mining Business Unit (BU). Cotiviti's Data Mining team configures custom claim reviews to investigate untapped billing compliance issues specific to regulations and contracted policies across product, market, and provider types.

This role is responsible for auditing client data and generating high quality recoverable claims for the benefit of Cotiviti and our clients. Responsible for conducting or assisting in the identification, validation, and documentation of moderate to more complex audit projects. Documents relevant facts, information, and conclusions drawn to support the work performed and validate the claim. Utilizes this information to knowledge share within the audit team. Displays a high degree of independent judgment and professional skepticism that enhances the work performed in order to achieve success in the position.

Responsibilities

  • This individual will receive direct supervision and ongoing support to ensure efficiency in production and quality review of assigned work.
  • Demonstrates the ability to build and maintain a solid understanding of Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) guidelines to establish the correct order of liability.
  • Proficient with Cotiviti audit tools Recovery Management System (RMS), specific client systems) to complete auditing, review simple - medium proprietary reports, has an advanced understanding of Microsoft Excel and client applications.
  • Draws on prior experience to audit standard reports and paid claims to identify over and under-payments of claims. The scope may include Data Mining, Claim Adjudication, Contract Compliance, Provider Billing & Duplicate Payment Reviews, Policy & Reimbursement Analysis, and Quality Assurance. This role is assigned to medium/complex reports.
  • Enters overpayments into Cotiviti system accurately and in accordance with standard procedures. Identifies and discusses audit findings with the audit team as a part of knowledge sharing and concept expansion.
  • May update current reports, develop, and run custom queries and validate the accuracy of current reports used. Makes determinations based on prior knowledge and experience of client contract terms with the likelihood of recovery acceptance.
  • Meets or exceeds standards for productivity, maintains regular and predictable attendance, and achieves production goals and standards set by the audit for the auditing concept. Ensures the expected level of quality and quantity for assigned work, including hit rate, claims written, vendor/project volume completion, ID, and/or fees per hour.
  • Meets or Exceeds Standards for Quality by achieving the expected level of quality set by the audit for the auditing concept, for valid claim identification and documentation.
  • Responds effectively to inquiries received on claims written. Provides verification of claims validation and confirmation, in a concise written manner, utilizing facts and details for justification purposes.
  • Demonstrates aptitude in reviewing transaction types, client contracts/vendor agreements, and client data with limited supervision of how to identify potential over or underpayments. Makes recommendations on medical policy application, state and federal statues, and other reimbursement methodologies as it applies to the audit concept.
  • Participates in onboarding new hires and cross-training efforts.
  • Identifies New Claim Types & Concept Expansion by researching and identifying potential claims outside the audit concept. Suggests, develops, and analyzes high quality, high value concepts and/or process improvements, tool enhancements, etc.
  • Recommends New Concepts & Processes by leveraging knowledge of client, contract terms, and complex claim types. Works towards developing and implementing new ideas, approaches, and/or technological improvements that will support and enhance audit production. Evaluates information and draws logical conclusions. The Implementation Engineer (Integrations) designs, builds, and supports IVR and API integrations for enterprise contact center environments. This role works directly with customers to gather requirements, design call flows, and connect internal systems with third-party services such as CRM platforms, billing systems, and payment services. The position combines hands-on integration development, solution consulting, and troubleshooting to deliver reliable, scalable solutions and successful customer deployments.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Analyze customer contact center configurations, data extracts, and call flows to plan for the API integration
  • Gather and document customer requirements for API integrations, evaluate system readiness, and define scope, deliverables, and API integration timelines.
  • Build integrations between Intermedia contact center platform and third-party services using APIs, including CRM, billing, and payment platforms.
  • Read API documentation and design authentication, requests, data mappings, retries, and error handling; validate authentication and connectivity using tools such as Postman.
  • Create and maintain backend services, webhooks, middleware, and automation workflows that support customer implementations and ongoing data exchange.
  • Transform and synchronize data across systems, including mapping and validating customer records between CRM platforms, billing systems, and internal databases.
  • Design and implement API-driven IVR call flows, including data collection, menu design, conditional routing, and payment integrations; guide customers in creating efficient, user-friendly experiences.

  • Troubleshoot integration failures, latency, and data quality; lead troubleshooting of production incidents and complex issues across APIs, IVR platforms, CRM systems;
  • Apply security practices including OAuth 2.0, secrets management, and encryption.
  • Lead technical design discussions and provide professional services and consulting for large and strategic customer accounts throughout implementation.
  • Provide post implementation escalation support to ensure stability and successful adoption.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in contact center technology, systems integration, or technical implementation. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise contact center technologies, including IVR call flows, routing rules, callbacks, external data tables, working hours configurations, and reporting or monitoring tools.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and OAuth 2.0, with practical experience using API documentation and tools such as Postman to build, validate, and troubleshoot integrations.
  • Familiarity with GraphQL APIs and API debugging using Swagger or developer portals.
  • Hands-on scripting or development experience in a backend language such as Python, JavaScript, Java, or C#, including working with variables, data types, string manipulation, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, data mapping, and data transformation to support reliable synchronization and validation across systems.
  • Experience integrating CRM platforms such as Salesforce or Zendesk with external systems and evaluating their API capabilities and technical constraints.
  • Experience with cloud services, logging, and monitoring, with strong troubleshooting skills across distributed systems, APIs, and IVR environments.
  • Understanding of API rate limits, retries, versioning, permissions, secrets management, and encryption, and the ability to apply these practices to customer integrations.
  • Ability to analyze customer environments and translate requirements into scalable solutions that improve contact center efficiency and customer experience.
  • Proven ability to manage deliverables, timelines, tests, and technical documentation, and to use ticketing or CRM systems to track implementation tasks, communications, and configuration updates.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and customer-facing communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and lead design discussions.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with Sales, Product, Development, Security, Support, and external vendors while continuously developing technical expertise.

This role can be remote based in the US or Canada

Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Application Architect to contribute to the design and delivery of cloud-native applications on AWS, growing into architectural ownership while staying close to the code. This is a role for someone who enjoys hands-on development and wants to sharpen the judgment that comes from designing services, APIs, and event flows that have to run reliably in production. You’ll help decompose systems into well-bounded services, shape serverless and container-based deployments, and make the day-to-day calls that keep applications scalable, secure, and maintainable.

In this role, you will work as a delivery-embedded contributor on a cross-functional team building real systems for real clients. You’ll collaborate closely with senior architects, engineers, and product partners to translate requirements into sound application architecture, implement infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines, and integrate AI services where they add value. Along the way you’ll develop the technical instincts that come from shipping things that matter and learn to weigh tradeoffs across cost, performance, resilience, and team velocity.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Contribute to the design of cloud-native applications, helping define service boundaries, API contracts, and data flows on AWS
  • Build and deploy microservices and serverless functions using containers and managed compute
  • Implement event-driven patterns and asynchronous messaging between services
  • Design and implement APIs across protocols and gateways
  • Support infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines that make deployments repeatable and safe
  • Implement observability, scalability, and resilience practices so applications stay healthy under load
  • Apply AWS Well-Architected practices for security, reliability, and cost across the services you build
  • Build and integrate AI and LLM services into cloud applications, including RAG and inference workflows
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Cursor, and other modern AI assistants to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Collaborate with engineers, data, AI, and product teams to translate requirements into sound application architecture
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs and design decisions clearly across functions
  • Maintain architecture and API documentation that supports reproducibility, onboarding, and shared understanding
  • Participate actively in design and code reviews, raising concerns and offering constructive feedback

Leadership & Influence

  • Take ownership of system components end-to-end with growing scope of architectural responsibility
  • Contribute to architectural standards and best practices that lift the quality of work across the team
  • Begin mentoring more junior engineers, sharing knowledge and supporting their growth

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with hands-on experience designing cloud-native applications
  • Working knowledge of a cloud platform and cloud-native application patterns, with AWS preferred
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language and familiarity with another (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Go)
  • Experience building microservices, serverless functions, and event-driven systems
  • Familiarity with containers and orchestration
  • Experience designing and consuming APIs across REST, GraphQL, or gRPC and working with API gateways
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure as code and CI/CD
  • Familiarity with observability, scalability, and resilience practices in cloud applications
  • Understanding of cloud security, identity, and access management fundamentals
  • Experience integrating AI or LLM services into applications, including RAG or inference patterns
  • Demonstrable, day-to-day usage of AI-forward tools such as Claude and Cursor
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges with sound judgment

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • CMS integration specialist experienced in localized site builds and content migration, with hands-on exposure to SurfOS.

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

This range may be modified in the future. The salary range for this role based in the US is $110,000. USD - $ 151,000.USD; the salary range for this role based in Canada is: $90,000. USD - $124,000. USD.   • Guide assigned distributors in deploying product knowledge, machine insight, and account strategies at focused customers and target segments.

  • Use CRM and digital tools to document opportunities, customer intelligence, technical requirements, competitive activity, and coordinated sales actions.
  • Develop account strategies informed by product fit, application requirements, market trends, customer priorities, and competitive positioning.
  • Investigate customer feedback and concerns, coordinate corrective actions with internal teams, and communicate timely progress to customers and partners.
  • Maintain current knowledge of customer businesses, machine platforms, market dynamics, and emerging mobile technology trends to support strategic planning.
  • Represent Bosch Rexroth professionally through clear communication, ethical conduct, technical credibility, and a customer-first approach.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fluid power, or a related technical discipline; equivalent education and/or directly relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 5 years of recent experience in sales, account management, product management, applications engineering, or technical sales within the mobile or hydraulic manufacturing industry.
  • Direct OEM sales experience and hands-on mobile hydraulics experience required.
  • Experience supporting regional OEM sales, key market segments, distributor channels, or industrial/mobile hydraulic applications preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of Bosch Rexroth hydraulic product lines, mobile valve technologies, machine applications, and technical solutions for priority market segments.
  • Technical familiarity with open- and closed-loop hydraulic technology preferred.
  • Understanding of system-level approaches for mobile machinery, including hydraulics, electronics, IoT-enabled technologies, and application-specific solutions.
  • Demonstrated strengths in strategic planning, communication, negotiation, presentations, account management, and technical application support.
  • Ability to deliver effective technical and commercial presentations to key customers, distributor partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong time management and follow-through skills to support a high level of outside sales activity, customer visits, project coordination, and opportunity follow-up.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach with the ability to promote the full Bosch Rexroth product portfolio within a matrixed organization.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% annually, subject to business needs.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans

Bosch Rexroth is dedicated to making the world a better place through innovation and technology. We are looking for associates who will take on our customers’ challenges with passion and persistence until the right solution is found and who will thrive in a face-paced, collaborative and exciting environment.

  • Strong client communication skills and the ability to guide clients through technical and operational processes.

Agency experience is preferred. Experience running campaigns on X (formerly Twitter) is a plus.

Regnology is a global leader in regulatory reporting, helping financial institutions, regulators, and tax authorities improve data quality, efficiency, and cost savings. Our mission: to safeguard financial markets through smarter, future-ready solutions.

What you’ll do

This role is the primary owner of the Certinia (FinancialForce) side of our Salesforce implementation, with a particular focus on PSA (Professional Services Automation). You will be the go-to person for how Certinia is configured, maintained, and evolved - translating business needs into robust PSA processes and keeping the application healthy, well-governed, and aligned with how our services organisation actually works.

You will work as part of an established Salesforce team that already includes Architects, Developers, and Admins, so deep Salesforce expertise across the whole platform is not required. What matters is a firm grasp of core Salesforce concepts so you can collaborate effectively with the team, reason about how Certinia sits on top of the platform, and make sound configuration decisions. No coding is expected - our development team handles custom development; your strength is configuration, process ownership, and functional depth in Certinia PSA.

Key Responsibilities

Certinia PSA Ownership

  • Act as the main owner and subject-matter expert for Certinia PSA - resource management, projects, timecards, expenses, milestones, and billing events as they relate to PSA processes
  • Own the PSA configuration: project templates, assignment and scheduling logic, approval processes, and PSA-specific automation
  • Translate requirements from services, finance, and delivery stakeholders into well-structured Certinia processes and configuration
  • Maintain PSA data integrity and keep the application aligned with evolving business and reporting needs

Configuration & Continuous Improvement

  • Own declarative configuration on the Certinia side - objects, fields, flows, validation rules, page layouts, and permissions relevant to PSA
  • Assess Certinia release notes and seasonal updates, plan for impact, and coordinate testing before changes reach production
  • Identify and deliver continuous improvements and automation to streamline PSA workflows
  • Maintain configuration documentation so the Certinia setup is transparent and supportable

Data, Security & System Health

  • Manage user provisioning, licences, profiles, and permissions for Certinia users
  • Run data quality checks, imports, and validation, and support periodic backups
  • Monitor queues, background jobs, and system health; review audit trails and resolve access/permission issues

Collaboration & Support

  • Work closely with the Salesforce Architects, Developers, and Admins - flagging where custom development is needed and handing off cleanly rather than building it yourself
  • Provide day-to-day support and training to Certinia/PSA users across the business
  • Support sandbox management, release cycles, and UAT for Certinia-related changes

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and configuring Certinia (FinancialForce), with strong functional depth in PSA
  • Proven track record as the owner of a Certinia/PSA environment - not just supporting it, but shaping and improving it
  • Firm grasp of core Salesforce concepts (data model, security model, flows, validation rules, sharing) - enough to work confidently within a Salesforce team, without needing to write code
  • Certinia PSA certification
  • Ability to translate business processes into clean, maintainable Certinia configuration
  • Sound data management practices: imports, deduplication, backups, and quality controls
  • Clear communicator able to support and train business users and collaborate with a technical team

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator certification
  • Experience assessing and managing Certinia seasonal releases and their business impact
  • Exposure to integrations between Certinia/Salesforce and finance or ERP systems
  • Basic reporting/analytics or SOQL familiarity for data validation

Why you should decide on us

  • Market Leadership: Join a global leader where our agile culture and innovative spirit allow you to shape the future of financial stability.
  • International Scope: Take ownership of high-profile international projects and benefit from our global internal mobility initiatives.
  • Growth & Mentorship: Access a wide range of our technical and functional training opportunities.
  • Culture of Inclusion: We foster a supportive, transparent atmosphere with frequent team events and a commitment to diversity.

To get a first impression, we only need your CV and look forward to meeting you in a (personal/virtual) interview!
Recognizing the benefits of working in diverse teams, we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, and sexual identity.

The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Risk Management Framework (RMF) Compliance Lead. This person will be responsible for the overall management and execution of the Risk Management Framework (RMF) tasks, providing expert guidance and direction to a team of RMF professionals.

Work Location: This is a remote position, but candidate must be willing to work during the hours of 8am - 5pm EST

This position is contingent upon contract award

What You’ll Do:

  • Oversee and manage the overall execution of the Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, ensuring adherence to established principles and standards (NIST SP 800-37 and 800-53).
  • Provide advanced expertise on RMF processes to ensure consistent application of security controls, policies, and procedures across all supported systems.
  • Lead and mentor a team of RMF professionals, ensuring the delivery of high-quality documentation and outputs such as System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Ensure the accuracy, quality, and completeness of all deliverables related to the RMF process, driving continuous improvement and compliance.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all RMF-related matters, facilitating communication between internal teams, leadership, and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure that all RMF activities comply with relevant regulations, policies, and guidelines, maintaining a secure operational posture.
  • Oversee the integration of RMF processes across the organization, identifying areas for improvement and fostering a culture of cybersecurity awareness and compliance.
  • Lead Authority to Operate (ATO) authorization and maintenance, including security control implementation, authorization package development, risk remediation, continuous monitoring

Qualifications

  • Proven experience supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) authorization, maintenance, and continuous monitoring within FedRAMP High or other federal environments
  • Expertise in the Risk Management Framework (RMF), including NIST SP 800-37 and NIST SP 800-53, to ensure consistent implementation of security controls.

  • Ability to perform thorough risk assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and provide actionable mitigation strategies aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Proficient in creating, reviewing, and validating RMF deliverables, such as System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), and POA&Ms.
  • Skilled in managing large-scale cybersecurity projects, ensuring adherence to timelines, resources, and organizational goals.

Preferred Qualifications

Target Salary Range

raw.title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
raw.excerpt: Our missionWe're making Africa the first cashless continent.
raw.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can’t, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn’t take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don’t know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.

AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren’t secure, won’t scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.

We’re looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn’t much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use.

In this role, you'll...

    • Own how Wave’s general work tools get used. You’re accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they’re set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you’ve seen first-hand from users.
    • Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.
    • Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.
    • Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You’re the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn’t exist at all.
    • Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you’ll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we’ve found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $142,200 - $203,300 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirement

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, or in a similar role where you owned products or processes end-to-end, ideally in high-ownership, fast-paced environments like scale-ups.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and improving operational workflows that save teams time, produce accurate results, and run reliably at a reasonable cost.
  • AI-fluent: you’ve used tools like Claude or ChatGPT to build skills, automations, or workflows that did something meaningful in your actual job, not just experiments.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you
  • Bonus if you
    • Speak at least conversational French
    • Have worked with Slack and an enterprise workflow tool like Monday, Jira or Linear.
    • Have worked in or closely with large operations teams (support, field, finance)
    • Are a mobile money user in Sub-Saharan Africa

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Have a good nose for user-focused product design and obsess over user experience.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.
  • Are excited about travel and meet users where they are — your users will be in Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, and other countries in Africa, and some travel will be essential.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you’ve seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don’t just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you’re excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you’ll feel right at home here.

If that’s you, we’d love to meet you.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
