Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty.

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such asApple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

  • Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

  • Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

  • Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

  • Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

  • Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the implementation owner of a customer’s success with SAFE, from the first onboarding call to a working, trusted deployment delivering value as a key part of their business processes. You sit between the customer's implementation teams and SAFE's engineering teams, understanding all sides well enough to translate between them. You have detailed product knowledge to be able to implement customers' business needs using existing features, and create customisations as needed.

In this role you will have a strong understanding of SAFE/Industry best practice, guiding the customer to achieve their outcomes on the SAFE Platform, This will include educating and enabling the customer, as well as a technical implementation.

You build the scripts, configure the platform, integrations, agents and automations that get a customer live. You diagnose what stands in the way of a customer's success, and where necessary engage internal teams with a clear, evidenced problem statement with an agreed outcome. You hold the end-to-end picture of how SAFE works, so a conversation between a customer and SAFE teams reaches a decision quickly.

You use AI tooling every day to engage with customers more effectively, work with more autonomy and enable others, improving existing processes and tooling to achieve rapid deployments and value realisation.

What you'll do:

    Own customer onboarding and delivery

  • Lead technical onboarding for assigned customers: scope, plan, configure, integrate and confirm the customer is getting value.

  • Own each engagement to a defined outcome. Keep the customer and internal teams informed on progress, risks and next steps.

  • Travel to customer sites for workshops, deployments and escalations.

  • Write scripts and lightweight automations that speed up onboarding, data loading, integration set-up and repeat tasks.

    • Technical implementation

  • Collect technical details from customers about their environment, data sources and integrations: authentication, permissions, network constraints, payload formats and expected behaviour.

  • Configure and customise the SAFE platform to meet customer business needs, making direct product fixes where appropriate.

  • Build and test customer-specific workflows and AI agents, using SAFE and third-party APIs as needed.

  • Build custom solutions to achieve customer outcomes where product gaps exist.

  • Create tooling to accelerate delivery processes and automate repetitive tasks.

  • Diagnose failed or incomplete integrations and data flows.

    • Debug and troubleshoot

  • Reproduce and investigate issues using logs, platform telemetry and platform knowledge. Work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, with or without AI tooling

  • Present each issue to engineering with the evidence: what happens, what should happen, who it affects, and what you have already ruled out.

  • Stay with the issue until the customer has a resolution or an agreed workaround.

    • Bridge the customer and engineering

  • Talk to engineering stakeholders as a peer. Define the outcome a customer needs, not the implementation.

  • Join customer and internal technical calls to provide expert guidance and drive project deliverables to completion.

  • Spot patterns across customers. Raise them as product feedback with the customer's business outcome and their own words.

  • Act as an internal customer, working closely with Product teams to ensure that new features are understood and have a clear route to deliver customer value.

    • Use AI tooling to scale your work

  • Use AI tools to analyse logs, draft scripts, summarise issues and prepare customer-facing material, using your experience to refine outcomes.

  • Turn repeated tasks into reusable scripts, AI skills or automations that the wider team can use.

What you'll bring:

    Essential

  • Ownership and accountability. You take a problem as yours until it is closed, and you say so early when something slips.

  • Creative thinking and problem-solving. You find a route to success, resolving issues as you hit them.

  • Curiosity. Not everything is documented. You explore, discover and experiment to achieve an outcome.

  • Experience in script building, product delivery and working directly with customers. This can come from a customer-facing technical role or substantial project work.

  • Product onboarding experience. You have taken customers or users from set-up to live use of a technical product.

  • API fluency. You can read API documentation, call and chain endpoints, handle authentication, and interpret responses and errors.

  • Debugging and troubleshooting skills. You work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, respecting customer data handling requirements.

  • Excellent written/verbal communication. You explain technical findings and concepts clearly to the level of the target audience, backed by an expert understanding of the system architecture.

  • Development. You write scripts that call APIs, process data, and automate customer tasks using Python as a preferred language. You understand code generated by AI tools for human review and challenge.

  • Cloud Services. You understand core cloud-based services and how they can be implemented at customers and used by SAFE.

  • Demonstrable use of AI tooling. You can show real examples of using AI to troubleshoot, script or automate, and you can say where it fell short.

  • Ability to travel to customer sites.

    • Nice to have

  • Exposure to cybersecurity, risk management or security-tool integrations (for example, vulnerability scanners, SIEM, asset inventories or identity providers).

  • Bash or PowerShell.

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role (forward deployed, solutions, customer or support engineering) at a SaaS or enterprise software company.

  • Experience working in distributed, multi-time-zone teams.

Why this role is exciting:

  • Own customer outcomes at the point where SAFE meets real enterprise environments.

  • Work with engineering, product and customer teams on problems that shape the platform.

  • Build creative solutions to problems, both customer facing and internal

  • Learn cyber risk, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), a growing part of cybersecurity.

  • Use Python, APIs and AI tooling to remove manual work for yourself and the team.

If you’re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that’s redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀

Who we’re looking for

We're looking for a hands-on ABM Manager who cares about pipeline, loves working with sales, and wants to make a real impact on ARR. You'll build and run Fieldwire's account-based marketing strategy from the ground up. Reporting to the Growth Marketing Team Lead, you'll partner closely with Sales, Sales Enablement, Marketing Operations, Content, Product Marketing, and regional teams to turn account intelligence into coordinated programs that create pipeline, accelerate revenue, and strengthen alignment across our go-to-market organization.

What you’ll be doing

A day in the life of the Account-Based Marketing Manager will see you:

  • Owning the 6sense platform day to day, managing intent data, building audiences, monitoring account engagement signals, and surfacing actionable insights to sales and marketing teams.
  • Building and maintaining Fieldwire's target account list, working closely with sales to define and continuously refine our ICP across markets and segments.
  • Designing and executing multi-channel ABM campaigns targeting high-priority accounts, coordinating across paid media, email, content, and sales outreach to deliver a coherent account experience.
  • Working closely with sales teams across markets to align on target accounts, share intent signals in real time, and build a tight feedback loop on lead quality and pipeline progression.
  • Collaborating with the digital agency, design, and content teams to develop account-specific assets and messaging that resonate with target personas in construction and field operations.
  • Defining and tracking ABM performance metrics including account engagement, pipeline influenced, and deal velocity, and report regularly on program performance with clear recommendations.
  • Managing budgets and resources effectively, ensuring maximum ROI on ABM initiatives.
  • Contributing to the broader demand generation strategy alongside the CRO and Lifecycle Manager, identifying opportunities to connect ABM efforts with inbound and lifecycle motions.

What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or similar field
  • 4-6 years of experience in B2B SaaS demand generation or ABM, with demonstrated hands-on ownership of account-based programs, not just support.
  • Direct, hands-on experience with the 6sense platform.
  • Solid understanding of how marketing and sales motions connect, including MQL logic, pipeline stages, and CRM data flows in Salesforce.
  • Experience with Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform.
  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and not everything is defined for you.

And if you have any of the following, we REALLY want you to apply today!

  • Experience in construction tech, field operations software, or other industry-specific B2B SaaS.
  • Exposure to multi-market or international campaign execution.
  • Experience with Dreamdata or similar revenue attribution platforms.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Ads and intent-based audience targeting.

Compensation:

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: $130,000- $150,000

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors such as your skills, qualifications and experience. In addition to the salary you may be eligible for a corporate bonus which can range up to 30%.

Why Fieldwire?

The field-first construction platform for less busywork and more building. Trusted on 4M+ projects worldwide, Fieldwire by Hilti gives crews reliable access to plans, tasks, and updates on one simple platform. It unites the field and office around a single, transparent source of truth, keeping teams aligned from start to finish. Designed for easy adoption, crews gain real-time visibility into progress, clear ownership of work, and the context to make confident decisions. As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.

Where is the job located?

This role is fully remote within the United States, East Coast preferred. Our headquarters are based in beautiful San Francisco and our office is centrally located right off of Embarcadero Bart station.

--

Fieldwire is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.title: Senior Director, Talent Acquisition
raw.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help engineering teams bring life-changing products to the world years sooner.
raw.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help engineering teams bring life-changing products to the world years sooner.

CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions. Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design. Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster.

Founded in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2018 to a rapidly scaling company. We’ve recently been recognized on Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post.

About the Role

This is a plan, build-and-lead role. You’ll set the strategy for how CoLab finds, assesses, and wins the people who will take us from where we are to where we’re going. You won’t be an order-taker. You’ll sit with our executive team and hiring managers as a trusted advisor on the talent market. When a wish list doesn’t match reality, you’ll say so, bring the data, and help reset it. You’ll help decide which roles get priority, where we invest our sourcing energy, and when it’s worth paying for outside support.

You’ll also build the system. That means a rigorous, consistent assessment process aligned to our “Hell Yes” hiring criteria: scorecards, structured interviews, and work samples. It means a tech stack and reporting that leaders trust, with clear visibility into pipeline health, time-to-fill, pass-through rates, offer acceptance, and quality of hire. And it means playbooks that make us repeatable across engineering, go-to-market, and executive hiring.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’ve built a talent acquisition function, not just run one. You drive an organizational workforce plan and you’ve taken a recruiting function to a strategic partnership level inside a high-growth B2B company. You can show the before and after: faster hiring, a higher bar, and leaders who plan around your data instead of around their gut.

You’re a leader and a craftsperson. You coach your team, and you can still pick up a hard search yourself, whether that’s a VP or a mechanical engineer with a rare skill set. You can sit with a CEO and explain what the talent market will and won’t give them, and when a hiring plan doesn’t match reality, you say so, bring the numbers, and help reset it.

You think like a first-team leader. You’d give up a win for your own function if it was the right call for the company, and you build the same mindset in your team.

You’re energized by building: structured assessments, scorecards, playbooks, tooling, and a clear view of when to use agencies and when not to. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and with a function that’s still taking shape.

This probably isn’t the role for you if you want a fully built team and tech stack on day one, a role that’s purely strategic with no hands-on work, or an environment where hiring decisions are made without you.

Responsibilities

Lead the function

  • Set the Talent Acquisition strategy and multi-year hiring plan, tied to company growth targets and workforce planning
  • Lead, coach, and grow the Talent Acquisition team.
  • Decide how work is split between in-house, agency, and executive search partners, and manage those vendors and budgets.

Be a strategic partner

  • Advise the executive team and hiring managers on the talent market, compensation positioning, and hiring trade-offs, and push back with data when expectations don’t match reality
  • Run hiring prioritization (for example, tiering roles to focus sourcing and agency support where it matters most)
  • Join the People Team and Leadership Team as a first-team member, putting company outcomes ahead of functional ones

Build the system

  • Own a consistent, structured assessment process aligned to CoLab’s “Hell Yes” criteria: scorecards, structured interviews, and work samples etc
  • Own the Talent Acquisitions tech stack (ATS, sourcing tools, AI-assisted workflows) and drive adoption
  • Build scalable playbooks for high-volume, GTM, technical, and executive hiring
  • Report on search health: pipeline, time-to-fill, pass-through rates, offer acceptance, quality of hire, cost per hire, and diversity metrics

Build the brand and pipeline

  • Shape the employer brand and candidate experience, including the CoLab story for senior and passive talent
  • Build talent pipelines for anticipated roles, including engineers, GTM, and leadership
  • Develop an approach to hiring internationally and across Canada, the USA, including the local talent market

Stay hands-on when it counts

    • Personally support critical searches and close key candidates, especially in the early phase of the function

Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • [10-12+] years in recruiting, with [5+] years leading TA teams and [3+] years at Director level or above
  • Experience scaling hiring at a high-growth B2B technology company (ideally Series D-F)
  • Proven results hiring across technical, GTM, and executive roles
  • Strong operator: builds process, data, and tooling, and can show before-and-after outcomes
  • Experience managing recruiting budgets, agency partners, and offer/comp strategy
  • Data fluency, with metrics used to make decisions, not just to report
  • Executive presence and business acumen; you can hold your own with C Suite, SVP’s and VP’s and advise them on the talent market
  • Experience managing complex offers, including equity and multi-stakeholder negotiations
  • Recruiting experience in industrial software, PLM, CAD/CAE, manufacturing tech, or deep-tech hardware
  • Experience recruiting in Globally, including cross-border hiring considerations

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or rebuilding TA from an early-stage function
  • International hiring experience
  • Hiring for industrial, engineering software, or hardware-adjacent companies
  • Hands-on experience with Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, and AI sourcing tools
  • Remote or distributed team leadership

Equity Note

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

raw.description:
About us:

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that’s gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested over $2 billion in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than 100 countries and over 5 million borrowers

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva’s team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

Kiva's values:

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.

Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.

Role overview:

Kiva is seeking an Email Marketing Associate to help support the execution and continuous improvement of our email and lifecycle marketing programs. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Lifecycle & Email, this role will help build scalable operational processes that enable the Growth & Lifecycle team to execute increasingly sophisticated programs efficiently and consistently.

Working closely with Growth & Lifecycle, Product, Creative, Analytics, Data Science, and Engineering teams, you'll support campaign execution, marketing operations, and process improvements that help deliver personalized communications to Kiva's global community.

This role offers a strong foundation in marketing operations, with opportunities to grow over time into broader responsibilities across campaign management, marketing operations, and lifecycle marketing.

At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately, we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Campaign Execution & Lifecycle Operations

    • Support the intake, planning, building, QA, scheduling, and deployment of campaigns across multiple stakeholders.
    • Build, maintain, and optimize complex workflows and lifecycle journeys using Iterable.
    • Execute A/B tests and support experimentation initiatives.
    • Conduct thorough QA across content, links, personalization, segmentation, rendering, and user experience.
    • Support the development and maintenance of reusable templates, workflows, and operational processes.
    • Maintain project timelines, dependencies, and deliverables within Asana.

  • Audience & Marketing Technology Support

    • Build and maintain audience segments, dynamic lists, suppression logic, and targeting rules within Iterable.
    • Support personalization, frequency capping, and segmentation initiatives that improve user experience and list health.
    • Help audit, document, and improve customer data available for lifecycle marketing.
    • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to improve customer data quality and lifecycle capabilities.
    • Identify opportunities to improve automation, segmentation, and triggered messaging programs.

  • Reporting, Documentation & Optimization

    • Monitor and report on campaign and lifecycle performance metrics.
    • Document campaign learnings, experiment results, audience logic, and operational best practices.
    • Share insights and maintain documentation that improves team knowledge, efficiency, and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Support testing, research, and analytical initiatives that improve customer engagement and retention.
    • Identify opportunities to improve automation, targeting, and operational processes that improve marketing and team effectiveness.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in email marketing, technical production, lifecycle marketing, CRM administration, marketing operations, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with Iterable or a similar marketing automation platform (e.g., Braze, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
  • Experience supporting campaign execution, marketing automation workflows, audience segmentation, or QA processes.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to operational excellence.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing deadlines.
  • Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, and marketing performance metrics.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to learn new systems and technologies quickly and troubleshoot issues independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Interest in lifecycle marketing, email marketing, marketing operations, retention programs, or CRM.
  • Passion for Kiva's mission and expanding financial access around the world.

What we offer:

  • A work-from-home position; final candidate must be authorized to work in one of the states below.
  • An opportunity to improve real lives, solve hard problems, and change the world
  • Friendly, supportive, and adventurous environment with a team of engaged colleagues
  • A comprehensive, industry-leading benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, professional development, 401k matching, and unlimited PTO. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by Kiva.
  • We offer JOON, a flexible lifestyle spending account that provides an annual stipend for Wellness, Professional Development, or Working from Home.
  • Opportunities to connect with and learn from colleagues and partners around the world
  • Salary range: $52K - $64K; a final offer will be dependent upon a candidate’s location, skills, and experience.
  • Currently, we are only able to hire home employees residing in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, DE, FL, GA, IL, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, NY, OH, OR, SC, TX, UT, VA, and WA.

A diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is an integral part of Kiva's culture. We actively welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a great place to work. Join us and help us achieve our mission!

We will only accept applications directly from candidates. Kiva will not be responsible for any recruiting agency fees, absent a formal agreement.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleTeach For All is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to support a diverse group of network and prospective partner organizations in the Europe region and to lead regional work on public sector partnerships.
raw.description:
About the Role

Teach For All is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to support a diverse group of network and prospective partner organizations in the Europe region and to lead regional work on public sector partnerships. As a Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe, you will steward Teach For All’s engagement with a group of partner organizations in the Europe region, working to build and deepen relationships and collaboration in pursuing educational equity in Europe. In this role you will act as a strategic advisor to partner organizations, diagnosing needs and opportunities, consulting on strategic challenges, and mobilizing network resources to drive collective impact

In this position, you will also play a critical role in strengthening partner organizations’public sector partnerships through targeted support around institutional relations strategy development and execution in key countries in Europe. You will work closely with global team members to build more active partner connections and collaboration with their governments (Ministries of Education at national, regional or local levels; regional and local authorities; Universities and research institutions), by developing specific partner support initiatives, contributing to Erasmus+ projects, and designing learning experiences and ad-hoc resources when needed. The ideal candidate for this position will have a proven ability to work effectively across diverse contexts and cultures, navigating ambiguity with ease, and will have experience making sound strategic decisions that drive impact in complex and changing environments.

This role provides an exceptional opportunity for an individual with superior leadership, strategic, interpersonal, and programmatic skills to increase the impact of our mission and shape the education landscape in the region. The strongest candidates will have a proven ability to set a clear vision, build culture and relationships, influence outcomes through others, and make strategic decisions that drive meaningful impact. A strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is essential.

The ideal candidate will have a deep familiarity of living and working in Europe, must reside and be authorized to work in the region, speak English and ideally one additional regional language. The Director- Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe will report to the Head of Partner Engagement & Program - Europe and work closely with the Head of Region, Europe on external positioning and advocacy.

Outcomes

  • Regional partner organizations are highly engaged with each other and the network and are dedicated to our mission and values, and to contributing to progress towards Teach For All’s vision and intended outcomes, as measured by the annual network survey.
  • Partner organizations in the region are better supported to develop and implement new, innovative and forward looking public sector partnerships that enable them to scale their programmes and increase their impact in the education system.
  • There is growth in aggregate progress across the region, as demonstrated by relevant measures for the intended outcomes:
  • Our network is expanding in the region.
  • Collective leadership is strengthening within the communities and countries of network partners.
  • Students in our classrooms are developing holistically as leaders who can shape a better future.
  • Our network staff members, teachers, and alumni are a deeply interconnected, learning regional and global community.
  • Insights from our network inform the regional understanding of what will drive progress for marginalized children.
  • Strengthened relationships with regional program stakeholders in the region generating new opportunities for impact and influence. Support the growing impact of alumni in the region as leaders in schools and the education ecosystem.

Key responsibilities:

Partner Support (40%)

  • As a “portfolio lead,” serve as the primary day-to-day relationship holder with a portfolio of current and prospective partner organization CEOs, cultivating relationships to build positive, long-term partnerships as a means to achieving shared and mutually beneficial goals and outcomes.
  • Co-create and manage the implementation of an annual partnership plan with each organization in the Network Engagement Director’s portfolio, identifying how Teach For All will support them and how they will contribute back to the network on an ongoing basis. This plan will include the strategic engagement of other colleagues, teams and resources from across Teach For All.
  • Share insights, ask thoughtful questions, and provide support to partner and prospective partner organization CEOs and their leadership teams, to build their capacity, advance strategic clarity and impact, and foster learning and sharing across the network, in line with Teach For All’s shared global vision and priorities.

Public Sector Support (50 %)

  • Work directly with CEOs and Head of Institutional Relationships in each partner organization to develop strong public sector strategies and action plans to identify new champions in government and identify new ways of partnering with the public sector to increase their ability to scale their programmes and increase their impact by leveraging regional, national and multinational opportunities
  • Leveraging deep understanding of the educational landscape, develop and execute on strategies that build external champions and elevate awareness of our programmatic work in Ministries of Education and Ministries of Labour and Social Welfare, Regional and Local governments, and Universities across the region.
  • Continue to build more capacity across the region, in both partner organizations and Teach For All to develop and manage stronger public sector relationships in pursuit of sustainability and scale of our work in Europe
  • Facilitate meaningful learning experiences for partner organizations in the region, virtual and in-person when possible, such as immersive experiences and peer-to-peer visits for network partner organizations and emerging social entrepreneurs, fostering collaboration, culture, and connection in line with our broader network vision and values.
  • Lead initiatives and strategies on region wide and global priorities to contribute to progress against our network intended outcomes.
  • Co-build public sector partnership collaboration and learning across the region and globally.
  • Support leadership development of key stakeholders in the region from alumni and senior partner staff through coaching and leadership development experiences

Contribute to Teach For All globally (10%)

  • Work with the other global teams to contribute to global priorities and initiatives in particular in relation to our leadership development and program strategies
  • Represent the global organization as needed at external opportunities

Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience & Track Record: Minimum 10 years of professional experience, including demonstrable success leading senior-level public sector partnerships and navigating complex government or education systems across Europe.
  • Contextual & Geographic Mastery: Deep familiarity with living and working within the European sociopolitical landscape, with current legal authorization to live and work long-term in an eligible hiring country.
  • Strategic Systems Thinking: Proven ability to analyze educational landscapes, navigate bureaucratic systems, and design actionable public partnership strategies that achieve scale and sustainability.
  • Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional interpersonal and political acumen, with a track record of building trusted relationships with senior leaders, government ministers, and diverse community stakeholders.
  • Adaptive Leadership: Demonstrated experience navigating ambiguity, leading through influence across matrixed and cross-border teams without formal authority, and making sound decisions in complex environments.
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Demonstrated commitment to DEI principles, with deep self-awareness and the ability to navigate racial, cultural, ideological, and power dynamics across countries.
  • Linguistic Capability: Professional fluency in written and spoken English, paired with strong, professional-level communication skills.

Additional Desirable Skills / Experiences

  • Fluency or professional working proficiency in French or an additional European language.
  • Direct professional experience working inside schools, school networks, or national education ministries.
  • Formal executive or leadership coaching experience supporting senior executives and social entrepreneurs.
  • Prior hands-on experience designing or managing EU-funded programs (e.g., Erasmus+ projects).
  • Familiarity with the Teach For All network model and theory of systemic change.

What Teach For All Offers:

  • Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization’s progress
  • Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
  • Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
  • And much more!

Application Instructions

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

Work authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

Compensation

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

Travel and Hours

All work is delivered virtually. Up to 30% of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

About Teach For All

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

raw.description:
wo du mit anpacken kannst

  • Wir wollen unser Praxisverwaltungssystem tomedo® weiter in Stabilität und Kundenzufriedenheit erhöhen. Als technisch erfahrene:r UX-Designer:in unterstützt du dein Team v.a. in den Themenbereichen rund um die Telematikinfrastruktur (TI), so zum Beispiel die elektronische Patientenakte (ePA) oder das eRezept.

  • Als UX-Designer:in hast Du den direkten Draht zu unseren Kund:innen und hast eine Affinität für den medizinischen Bereich. Eigenständig führst Du Interviews und Usability-Tests durch, analysierst das Verhalten von Ärzt:innen und MFAs und triffst datenbasierte Design-Entscheidungen, welche die User Experience nachhaltig verbessern.

  • Von der Entwicklung erster Wireframes bis hin zu Klick-Prototypen und High-Fidelity-Designs – Deine Konzepte sind nicht nur visuell ansprechend, sondern auch hochfunktional und nutzerfreundlich.

  • Mit Liebe zum Detail optimierst du UI-Komponenten, damit unsere Software nicht nur konsistent ist, sondern auch modern und ansprechend.

  • In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Entwickler:innen, Produktmanager:innen und anderen Stakeholder:innen sorgst du dafür, dass deine Designs nicht nur technisch umsetzbar, sondern auch mit den rechtlichen Anforderungen konform sind. Du denkst wie ein Entwickler - und agierst wie ein UXer.

  • Du arbeitest gerne intensiv am Problem, bevor du Dich mit einer Lösung beschäftigst und berätst dein Team in Priorisierung und Strategie.

  • Du kannst bei uns zu 100% aus dem Home-Office arbeiten oder auch eines unserer Co-Working Spaces in Erfurt, Leipzig, Berlin und Hamburg nutzen.

  • Einer Teilzeitanstellung steht grundsätzlich nichts im Wege, allerdings wäre es ideal, wenn Du wöchentlich mindestens 32 Stunden Deiner Zeit mit uns verbringst.

was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich UX, Design oder Human-Computer Interaction.

  • Du bist seit mindestens 6 Jahren im UX Design unterwegs, idealerweise im Software Kontext und in einem agilen Umfeld mit stark regulierten und sehr technischen Themen.

  • Mit UX-Prinzipien aus Theorie und Wissenschaft bist du ebenso vertraut, wie mit der Weiterentwicklung von komponentenbasierten Design Systemen.

  • Design und Research Tools beherrschst Du aus dem Effeff und kannst Erfahrung mit Design-to-Code-Prozessen und AI-Prototyping vorweisen.

  • Du bringst praktische Erfahrung von UX Research sowie ein tiefes Verständnis von Product-Discovery-Prinzipien mit und weißt, wie man wertvolle Erkenntnisse daraus gewinnt.

  • Kommunikationsstärke, analytisches Denken und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise zeichnen Dich aus. Komplexe Anforderungen schrecken dich nicht ab – Du liebst es, durchdachte Lösungen zu finden und diese klar zu begründen.

  • Dein Interesse an KI-Tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) oder idealerweise sogar erste Erfahrungen mit agentischer KI wie Codex, Claude Cowork, Gemini Spark oder OpenClaw dürfen bei uns gerne praktisch angewandt werden.

  • Um bei uns richtig Fuß fassen zu können, ist es zwingend notwendig, dass Du fließend Deutsch beherrschst.

warum wir?

Wir sind ein offenes und ambitioniertes Team von über 600 Mitarbeitern, das Kundenorientierung wirklich lebt und gleichzeitig Spaß hat. Bei uns herrscht auch nach über 10 Jahren eine Startup-Atmosphäre, die neben dem legendären Obstkorb auch vielseitige Perks wie eine steuerfreie Shoppingkarte, Dienstrad-Leasing und Gesundheitskurse (z.B. Yoga, Rückentraining und mental Health) anbietet - sowohl online als auch im Büro.

Je nach Einsatzgebiet (und das sind mindestens 75% aller Unternehmensbereiche) bieten wir all unseren Kollegen flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office an. Wir verstehen uns als eng zusammenhaltendes Team mit Kooperations- statt Wettbewerbs-Atmosphäre. Außerhalb der Arbeit organisieren wir Events wie Beachvolleyball im Sommer, Grillfeste, Kochabende oder Paddeltouren.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:

  • Super Team und flache Hierarchien
  • Job Crafting/individuelle Arbeitsgestaltung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Weiterentwicklung
  • Homeoffice/Mobiles Arbeiten
  • Team Events
  • Förderung der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Betriebliche Krankenversicherung
  • Dienstradleasing/Jobrad
  • Hardwareleasing
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte
  • Betreuungkostenzuschuss/ Kita-Zuschuss
  • Erholungsbeihilfe
  • Essenszuschuss
  • Fahrtkostenzuschuss
  • Auslandsarbeit

überzeugt? dann bewirb dich jetzt bei uns!

Lade Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung inklusive Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und der relevanten Zeugnisse (Schul-, Ausbildungs-, Uni- und Arbeitszeugnisse) ganz einfach online auf unserer Homepage hoch. Sobald Deine Bewerbung bei uns angekommen bist, erhältst Du eine automatisch Bestätigung per Mail.

Du hast noch Fragen? Dann wende Dich ganz einfach an unsere Personalabteilung. Unser Recruitingteam steht Dir gerne bei Rückfragen zur Verfügung. Du erreichst sie unter . Weitere Informationen findest du auch auf unserer Website.

raw.description:
Chief Project Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Project Officer (CPO) is responsible for leading the organization's strategic project portfolio, enterprise-wide program management, and major transformation initiatives across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that strategic projects are properly planned, prioritized, funded, executed, and delivered in alignment with organizational goals. The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and senior management team, the CPO will establish effective project governance, optimize resources, manage delivery risks, and ensure measurable business outcomes from the organization's project investments.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Project & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide project management and portfolio strategy.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and oversee strategic projects across insurance and investment business units.
  • Ensure project portfolios align with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, business cases, resource requirements, expected returns, and implementation risks.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and ensure projects deliver their intended strategic and financial benefits.

Insurance & Investment Project Delivery

  • Lead strategic initiatives involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee projects involving new insurance product launches, policy administration systems, claims management, underwriting processes, and distribution expansion.
  • Manage investment-related initiatives involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Coordinate projects involving regulatory changes, business process modernization, and operational restructuring.
  • Support the implementation of new business models, financial products, and market expansion initiatives.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Establish and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO), including project standards, methodologies, policies, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Ensure consistent project management practices across business units and subsidiaries.
  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Present portfolio performance reports, major risks, and project recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.
  • Oversee projects involving insurance technology (InsurTech), financial technology (FinTech), automation, AI, cloud platforms, CRM, and enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and investment service platforms.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, and CDO teams to ensure technology projects meet business requirements.
  • Monitor technology implementation costs, timelines, system integration, and business adoption.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and manage project portfolio budgets and investment plans.
  • Monitor expenditure, cost variations, financial performance, and project profitability.
  • Optimize resource allocation across projects, departments, and business units.
  • Evaluate project return on investment (ROI), cost-benefit analysis, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify and manage project-related operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk management, legal, compliance, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish risk mitigation, contingency, and business continuity plans for critical projects.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and organizational requirements.

Business Transformation & Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead cross-functional transformation programs aimed at improving operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Support organizational restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration projects.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving geographic expansion, new market entry, and business diversification.
  • Drive process improvement, automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Track business benefits and ensure successful adoption of project outcomes.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to establish project priorities.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders, regulators, investors, consultants, and external partners, as appropriate.
  • Resolve project conflicts involving scope, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation.
  • Provide executive-level updates on project performance, delivery challenges, and strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead project directors, program managers, project managers, and PMO professionals.
  • Develop high-performing project delivery teams across multiple business units.
  • Establish accountability, performance standards, and professional development programs.
  • Promote a culture of project ownership, collaboration, innovation, and delivery excellence.
  • Introduce project management tools, dashboards, and performance measurement systems.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Finance, Business Strategy, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership position overseeing complex project portfolios and strategic programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale, multi-departmental projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience establishing and managing enterprise PMOs and project governance frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and other project delivery methodologies.
  • Strong financial planning, budgeting, risk management, and resource allocation capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic projects delivered on time and within budget.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and strategic alignment.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Achievement of project milestones and approved deliverables.
  • Return on investment (ROI) and realization of expected business benefits.
  • Successful delivery of insurance and investment transformation initiatives.
  • Project risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Resource utilization and project team productivity.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project quality ratings.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.
  • Successful execution of digital transformation and business expansion projects.

raw.description:
As a Senior BI & Data Analyst, you’ll be a key driver of insight and innovation within our Enterprise Data and Analytics team. We’re looking for a curious, detail-oriented professional who thrives on turning complex scientific and operational data into clear, actionable intelligence. In this role, you’ll lead the development of analytical solutions that illuminate critical KPIs, uncover performance trends, and support strategic decision-making across the business. You’ll partner closely with stakeholders to map business processes, align data solutions with real-world operations, and conduct deep-dive analyses that solve high-value challenges. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape how data informs strategy and contributes to our mission of creating healthier lives.

As a Sr. BI & Data Analyst you will be focused on:

Our team thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. We work closely with cross-functional engineering and business partners to deliver impactful data and analytics solutions that shape the future of research and development.

In this role, primary responsibilities include:

  • Analyzing complex scientific datasets to uncover meaningful insights and support strategic initiatives.
  • Mapping key business process rules to ensure data solutions align with operational realities.
  • Creating insight-driven solutions that bring visibility into critical KPIs and performance metrics.
  • Conducting deep-dive analyses to solve challenging problems and support evidence-based recommendations.
  • Engage Business Stakeholders at all levels to identify requirements for current and future products through ongoing interaction.
  • Lead requirements workshops and User Acceptance Testing for new data, products and analytics solutions.
  • Analyze business processes and develop business flow diagrams and data flow diagrams to support system design and optimization.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
  • Data Profiling, mining, and data validation/testing to ensure data is fit for use by the business.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and present results in a clear and user-friendly manner.
  • Build strong business relationships that foster a collaborative and trusting approach and partnership.

We are looking for the following minimum qualifications for this role:

  • Bachelor degree in Business Management, Computer Science or any related field.
  • Master in Business Administration/ Information Systems/ Computer Science is an asset.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to approach challenges creatively.
  • Ability to understand and make sense of complex datasets with a strong attention to detail
  • Ability to translate requirements to well-written user stories to bridge the gap between business and technology.
  • Strong business mindset with ability to collaborate with business partners to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management and delivery.
  • Ability to see big picture and then identify key areas for deep analysis to support sound solutions.
  • Self-driven and capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
  • Experience in life science or Biotechnology industry is a plus.

Technical Expertise required:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in writing complex SQL queries, data mining, data profiling, and data validation/testing;
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Business Systems Analyst / Data Analyst specializing in the Data & Analytics discipline, preferably in a senior or lead role;
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience organizing and running User Acceptance Testing cycles and training with business users and stakeholders;
  • Experience working with Data Visualization Tools like Power BI, Tableau, Looker, MicroStrategy
  • Experienced working in Agile Software Development Methodology.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Sutherland:

At Sutherland Healthcare Solutions, we’re transforming how we work by harnessing the power of AI, data, and digital innovation to accelerate the discovery and development of life-saving therapies. Our vision is to embed artificial intelligence and advanced analytics across every stage of our scientific and operational workflows—empowering our teams with smarter tools, seamless data, and actionable insights to deliver client-centric services and solutions that better serve our customers and, ultimately, improve patients’ lives.

raw.excerpt: Sobre Nós Inovação.  Sustentabilidade.  Produtividade.
raw.description:
Sobre Nós

Inovação. Sustentabilidade. Produtividade. É assim que estamos abrindo novos caminhos em nossa missão de promover, de forma sustentável, o nobre trabalho de agricultores e construtores em todos os lugares. Com uma população global crescente e demandas aumentadas por recursos, nossos produtos são fundamentais para alimentar e abrigar o mundo.

Desde o desenvolvimento de produtos que funcionam com energia alternativa até tecnologias de precisão que aumentam a produtividade, estamos entregando soluções que beneficiam as pessoas – e elas são possíveis graças a pessoas como você. Se a oportunidade de desenvolver suas habilidades como parte de uma equipe global e colaborativa o entusiasma, você está no lugar certo.

Desenvolva uma Carreira. Construa um Futuro!

Faça parte desta empresa na vanguarda da agricultura e construção, que inova apaixonadamente para impulsionar a eficiência e o sucesso do cliente. E sabemos que a inovação não pode acontecer sem colaboração. Portanto, tudo o que fazemos na CNH Industrial trata de alcançar novos patamares como uma equipe, sempre entregando para o bem de nossos clientes.

Objetivo do Cargo

  • O candidato selecionado apoiará o desenvolvimento de veículos fora de estrada de próxima geração, contribuindo para decisões de engenharia desde as fases iniciais de desenvolvimento de conceito até a validação final do produto.
  • O Engenheiro de Desempenho de Veículos e Sistemas Hidráulicos é responsável por definir, avaliar e otimizar o desempenho em nível de veículo por meio de análise de engenharia, simulações virtuais, modelagem de sistemas e atividades de correlação experimental, trabalhando em sistemas de trem de força, transmissão, hidráulicos, eletrificados e sistemas veiculares.
  • O candidato será solicitado a realizar simulações de conceito em fase inicial, permitindo estudos de trade-off de arquitetura e avaliação virtual de tecnologias emergentes antes que o hardware esteja disponível, dentro de projetos multidisciplinares complexos coordenados em organizações globais de engenharia.
  • O candidato selecionado contribuirá para a avaliação de soluções inovadoras, incluindo sistemas de potência fluida avançados, trens de força híbridos, eletrificação de veículos e tecnologias de combustíveis alternativos, apoiando a transição para máquinas fora de estrada mais sustentáveis e eficientes.

Principais Responsabilidades

Engenharia de Desempenho de Veículos

  • Analisar e otimizar a produtividade do veículo, eficiência de combustível, utilização de energia e desempenho geral da máquina.
  • Apoiar a definição de metas e requisitos do veículo.
  • Realizar análises de fluxo de potência e balanço energético em nível de veículo.
  • Avaliar a eficiência da transmissão, capacidade de tração e desempenho operacional.
  • Conduzir benchmarking competitivo e avaliações de tecnologia.

Engenharia de Sistemas Hidráulicos

  • Desenvolver e validar arquiteturas, subsistemas e componentes hidráulicos.
  • Analisar a eficiência hidráulica e perdas de potência em nível de componente, subsistema e veículo.
  • Otimizar o desempenho do sistema considerando estratégias de controle, consumo de energia e perfis de uso do cliente.
  • Apoiar a definição de soluções inovadoras de sistemas hidráulicos para futuras plataformas de veículos.

Hibridização, Eletrificação e Combustíveis Alternativos

  • Apoiar estudos de viabilidade e atividades de integração de sistemas para arquiteturas de veículos híbridos e eletrificados.
  • Avaliar estratégias de gerenciamento de energia entre subsistemas convencionais e eletrificados.
  • Avaliar fluxos de energia, utilização da bateria e eficiência geral do sistema.
  • Analisar o impacto de combustíveis alternativos (HVO, Biodiesel, GNL, GNC, Hidrogênio e futuras soluções de baixo carbono) no desempenho e eficiência do veículo.
  • Apoiar roteiros tecnológicos e atividades de seleção de conceitos para o desenvolvimento sustentável de veículos.

Desenvolvimento de Conceito em Fase Inicial e Engenharia Virtual

  • Realizar simulações de conceito em fase inicial para apoiar decisões de arquitetura antes da disponibilidade de protótipos.
  • Conduzir análises de trade-off entre conceitos e tecnologias concorrentes.
  • Desenvolver metodologias de avaliação virtual para desempenho do veículo, economia de combustível, produtividade e eficiência hidráulica.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de engenharia "shift-left" por meio de abordagens de desenvolvimento baseadas em modelos.
  • Gerar recomendações baseadas em dados para acelerar o desenvolvimento e reduzir o risco do programa.

Simulação e Modelagem de Sistemas

  • Desenvolver e manter modelos de simulação de alta fidelidade e de ordem reduzida.
  • Executar atividades de validação virtual em nível de componente, subsistema e veículo completo.
  • Correlacionar resultados de simulação com medições experimentais.
  • Apoiar processos de engenharia baseados em modelos durante todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento do produto.
  • Utilizar ambientes de simulação como AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink e outras ferramentas de análise de engenharia.

Liderança de Projetos e Gestão de Stakeholders

  • Liderar fluxos de trabalho técnicos dentro de projetos multidisciplinares complexos.
  • Coordenar atividades entre equipes globais de engenharia e múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Impulsionar o alinhamento técnico e os processos de tomada de decisão.
  • Apresentar resultados de simulação, recomendações técnicas e atualizações de projetos para a gerência e liderança de engenharia.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de projetos, identificação de riscos e atividades de mitigação.
  • Interagir com fornecedores, parceiros de pesquisa e organizações externas de engenharia quando necessário.

Experiência Necessária

COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS (HARD SKILLS)

  • Mestrado em engenharia mecânica, automotiva, de energia ou aeroespacial, ou equivalente
  • Experiência profissional na indústria de veículos fora de estrada, agrícolas, de construção, automotivos ou comerciais - anos de experiência: 3-5
  • Conhecimento de princípios de desempenho de veículos, trem de força, transmissão e gerenciamento de energia
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de potência fluida: arquiteturas hidráulicas, subsistemas, componentes, eficiência e perdas de potência
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas de veículos fora de estrada híbridos e eletrificados, gerenciamento de energia veicular e tecnologias de combustíveis alternativos (HVO, Biodiesel, GNL, GNC, Hidrogênio)
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de simulação como AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink e outras ferramentas de análise de engenharia
  • Abordagem de Engenharia de Sistemas; exposição a Engenharia de Sistemas Baseada em Modelos (MBSE) será um diferencial
  • Técnicas avançadas de otimização e Planejamento de Experimentos (DoE), análise de dados e ferramentas de visualização
  • Engenharia digital e metodologias de validação virtual; aplicações de Inteligência Artificial para fluxos de trabalho de engenharia (preferencial)

COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS (SOFT SKILLS)

  • Forte mentalidade de engenharia de sistemas e excelentes habilidades analíticas
  • Capacidade de traduzir informações técnicas complexas em recomendações acionáveis que impulsionam decisões de negócios e produtos
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de apresentar resultados de simulação e recomendações técnicas para a gerência e liderança de engenharia
  • Capacidade de coordenar atividades entre equipes globais de engenharia e múltiplos stakeholders (engenharia de produto, controles, validação, manufatura, gestão de programas, fornecedores e parceiros técnicos)
  • Capacidade de trabalhar tanto de forma autônoma quanto como parte de uma equipe global multidisciplinar
  • Comprometimento com prazos, marcos e cronogramas estabelecidos
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais.

Qualificações Preferenciais

  • Pronto e disposto a assumir responsabilidade e prestar contas por suas próprias ações e decisões
  • Esforçar-se pela autonomia
  • Comunicação aberta e transparente
  • Oferecer suporte incondicional e superar as expectativas
  • Focado em objetivos e soluções (e não em obstáculos).

Transparência Salarial

O salário anual para esta função é de EUR €39.000,00 - €52.000,00 mais qualquer bônus aplicável (os salários reais variarão e serão baseados em vários fatores, como habilidades, experiência e qualificação para a função.)

Para funções abertas em vários locais, a faixa salarial indicada refere-se ao local principal. Se um local diferente for considerado, a faixa salarial aplicável será comunicada aos candidatos antes da primeira entrevista.

O Que Oferecemos

Oferecemos oportunidades de carreira dinâmicas em um cenário internacional. Como um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais, estamos comprometidos em gerar valor para todos os nossos funcionários e promover uma cultura de respeito.

Na CNH, entendemos que as melhores soluções vêm das diversas experiências e habilidades de nossas pessoas. Aqui, você terá autonomia para desenvolver sua carreira, seguir sua paixão e ajudar a construir um futuro melhor. Para apoiar nossos funcionários, oferecemos benefícios regionais abrangentes, incluindo:

  • Arranjos de trabalho flexíveis
  • Benefícios de poupança e aposentadoria
  • Reembolso de mensalidades escolares
  • Licença parental
  • Assistência à adoção
  • Suporte à fertilidade e planejamento familiar
  • Programas de Assistência ao Funcionário
  • Correspondência de contribuições de caridade e folga remunerada para voluntariado

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Trust & Safety Engineering protects Affirm’s consumers, merchants, and network from fraud and abuse. We build the real-time systems, risk signals, and tools that stop bad actors without adding friction for the people we serve. Our engineers work with data science, risk, and operations to stay ahead of evolving threats at scale

You will be matched with a role after completing the interview evaluation process. Your recruiter will work closely with you throughout the process to understand your interests and experience to find the strongest role fit.

What you’ll do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What we look for

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - USA 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA Pacific base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT): $195,000 - $255,000

USA Sapphire base pay range (all other U.S. states): $173,000 - $233,000

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

raw.description:
Are you motivated to participate in a dynamic, multi-tasking environment? Do you want to join a company that invests in its employees? Are you seeking a position where you can use your skills while continuing to be challenged and learn? Then we encourage you to dive deeper into this opportunity.

NeoGenomics has an opening for a Temporary Certified Coding Specialist who wants to continue to learn in order to allow our company to grow.

Shift: Monday – Friday, Remote role.

Now that you know what we're looking for in talent, let us tell you why you'd want to work at NeoGenomics:

As an employer, we promise to provide you with a purpose driven mission in which you have the opportunity to save lives by improving patient care through the exceptional work you perform. Together, we will become the world's leading cancer reference laboratory.

Position Summary:

As a Certified Coding Specialist, you will analyze medical records and abstracts clinical data by assigning codes from patient records in accordance to coding classification systems. You will also interact with physicians when code assignments are not straightforward or documentation in the record is inadequate, ambiguous or unclear for coding purposes. Identifies and reports documentation issues and may participate in team education activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Abstracts relevant clinical and demographic information from the medical record to assign current ICD10 and CPT codes in accordance with coding and reimbursement guidelines

  • Codes with an accuracy of 97% based on QA internal reviews
  • Records all diagnostic procedures and assigns appropriate procedure codes
  • Requests diagnosis from physicians when information is not recorded
  • Determines and records required medical information
  • Maintains the confidentiality of medical information contained in each record and protects data by following HIPAA compliant regulations

Experience, Education and Qualifications:

  • AAPC or AHIMA Certification required
  • Minimum experience for this position should have at least 1-year of medical coding experience
  • Thorough knowledge of ICD10 diagnosis coding and official coding guidelines
  • Thorough knowledge of CPT coding, NCCI and modifier usage
  • Thorough knowledge of CMS LCD/NCD and payer medical policies
  • Thorough knowledge of anatomy and physiology in addition to medical terminology and disease process
