title: Business/Sales Development Representative
description: About the RoleWe are looking for a proactive, commercially minded Business Development Representative (BDR) to join Gcore's centralized Business Development team.

raw.title: Business/Sales Development Representative
raw.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a proactive, commercially minded Business Development Representative (BDR) to join Gcore's centralized Business Development team.
raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded Business Development Representative (BDR) to join Gcore's centralized Business Development team.
In this role, you will help drive Gcore's growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers through inbound inquiries, targeted outbound prospecting, industry events, and customer reactivation initiatives.
You will be one of the first points of contact for prospective customers, helping them understand how Gcore's solutions can address their business needs and guiding them toward the right next step.
This is more than a meeting-booking role. We are looking for someone who can have meaningful customer conversations, recognize genuine commercial opportunities, and contribute to a high-quality sales pipeline.
You will independently manage your prospecting and qualification activities while collaborating closely with Sales, Marketing, Presales, Product, and Customer Support teams.

What You'll Do

Identify and Qualify Business Opportunities

  • Engage prospective customers through inbound inquiries, outbound prospecting, industry events, and customer reactivation.
  • Research target companies, identify key decision-makers, and personalize outreach based on business needs.
  • Initiate conversations through email, phone, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer challenges, purchase intent, and commercial potential.
  • Qualify opportunities against established criteria and ensure smooth handovers to the appropriate Sales representatives.

Guide Customers Toward the Right Solutions

  • Develop a practical understanding of Gcore's products, services, and customer use cases.
  • Identify when customers would benefit from a consultative sales engagement or a self-service solution.
  • Guide prospective customers through available options, pricing information, and next steps.
  • Collaborate with Presales, Product, and Customer Support teams when additional expertise is required.

Manage and Improve Prospecting Activities

  • Independently manage assigned target accounts, prospecting initiatives, and follow-up activities.
  • Participate in industry events, including prospect engagement and post-event follow-up.
  • Re-engage former customers to identify potential new business opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve outreach effectiveness, qualification quality, and customer engagement.
  • Share market insights, customer feedback, and successful approaches with the team.

Collaborate and Deliver Results

  • Work closely with Sales to understand commercial priorities and opportunity qualification expectations.
  • Partner with Marketing to improve lead quality, targeting, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect information, interactions, and qualification outcomes in HubSpot.
  • Take ownership of the quality of opportunities generated and ensure timely follow-up.
  • Consistently contribute to team pipeline generation objectives.

What We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales development, inside sales, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.
  • Experience with prospecting, lead qualification, and customer engagement.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence in initiating conversations with prospective customers.
  • Ability to understand customer needs, ask relevant questions, and identify commercial opportunities.
  • A proactive, results-oriented mindset with the ability to manage daily activities independently.
  • Strong research and organizational skills, with attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize activities, manage follow-ups, and consistently deliver results.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different teams.
  • Fluent English and at least one additional language.
  • Willingness to travel internationally for industry events and customer engagement.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, or related industries.
  • Familiarity with CDN, DDoS protection, WAF/WAAP, cloud computing, hosting, or networking solutions.
  • Experience with both inbound and outbound lead generation.
  • Exposure to account-based prospecting, ICP segmentation, or sales engagement tools.
  • Experience attending trade shows, conferences, or industry networking events.
  • German, French, or other European languages.
  • Experience with customer reactivation or win-back initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

Your primary measure of success will be the number of Sales Qualified Opportunities (SQOs) you generate.
An SQO is a genuine commercial opportunity where customer needs and purchase intent have been established, clear next steps are defined, and the opportunity has been accepted by the Sales team.

You will be successful when you:

  • Consistently generate high-quality Sales Qualified Opportunities.
  • Independently manage your prospecting and qualification activities.
  • Identify genuine customer needs and connect prospects with the appropriate Sales expertise.
  • Ensure smooth opportunity handovers and accurate CRM documentation.
  • Maintain timely and consistent communication with prospects.
  • Build productive relationships across Sales, Marketing, Presales, and Product.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve your effectiveness and contribute to team results.

Why Join This Team?

You will play a direct role in Gcore's commercial growth by connecting prospective customers with solutions that address their business needs.
You will gain exposure to different customer segments, technologies, and European markets while developing your commercial expertise within a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
We value initiative, meaningful customer engagement, continuous learning, and the quality of opportunities created — not simply the volume of outreach activities.

Benefits

At Gcore, we want you to do your best work and enjoy the journey. Our benefits are designed to support your growth, well-being, and life beyond work:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid or remote options, depending on your role
  • Work from anywhere in the world for up to 45 days per year
  • Private medical insurance for you and your family*
  • Extra paid vacation and sick leave days*
  • Support for life’s important moments and celebrations
  • Language courses to help you connect and grow
  • Modern, welcoming offices with snacks, drinks, and entertainment*
  • Team sports and social activities*

*Benefits may vary depending on your location.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The world’s digital experiences run on something invisible: the infrastructure and software that keep them fast, reliable, and secure. At Gcore, you’ll help design and deliver that foundation for an AI-driven world.

We’re a global provider of infrastructure and software solutions for AI, cloud, network, and security, powering everything from real-time communication and streaming to enterprise AI and secure web applications. With 210+ edge locations, 50+ cloud regions, and thousands of GPUs, your work here can reach users and businesses across the globe.

You’ll collaborate with leading technology partners such as Intel, NVIDIA, Dell, and Equinix, and work on platforms that power digital products used around the world. Our vision is simple: to connect the world to AI, anywhere, anytime.

Want to work on technology that goes beyond a single product or industry? Join a global team of 550+ professionals building infrastructure and software that supports the entire digital ecosystem.

raw.title: Payment Accuracy Specialist 1
raw.excerpt: OverviewCotiviti Healthcare is a leading provider of payment accuracy services to the most recognized companies in the healthcare and retail industries.
raw.description:
Overview

Cotiviti Healthcare is a leading provider of payment accuracy services to the most recognized companies in the healthcare and retail industries. We are seeking innovative thinkers and creative problem solvers who are interested in making a contribution to improving healthcare and want to be part of a team that is expanding rapidly and providing opportunities for career growth. If you want to make a difference and contribute to the improvement of healthcare payment integrity, consider an opportunity to join our healthcare recovery team as a Payment Accuracy Specialist.

A Payment Accuracy Specialist 1 is a member of the greater Data Mining Business Unit (BU). Cotiviti's Data Mining team configures custom claim reviews to investigate untapped billing compliance issues specific to regulations and contracted policies across product, market, and provider types.

This role is responsible for auditing client data and generating high quality recoverable claims for the benefit of Cotiviti and our clients. Responsible for conducting or assisting in the identification, validation, and documentation of moderate to more complex audit projects. Documents relevant facts, information, and conclusions drawn to support the work performed and validate the claim. Utilizes this information to knowledge share within the audit team. Displays a high degree of independent judgment and professional skepticism that enhances the work performed in order to achieve success in the position.

Responsibilities

  • This individual will receive direct supervision and ongoing support to ensure efficiency in production and quality review of assigned work.
  • Demonstrates the ability to build and maintain a solid understanding of Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) guidelines to establish the correct order of liability.
  • Proficient with Cotiviti audit tools Recovery Management System (RMS), specific client systems) to complete auditing, review simple - medium proprietary reports, has an advanced understanding of Microsoft Excel and client applications.
  • Draws on prior experience to audit standard reports and paid claims to identify over and under-payments of claims. The scope may include Data Mining, Claim Adjudication, Contract Compliance, Provider Billing & Duplicate Payment Reviews, Policy & Reimbursement Analysis, and Quality Assurance. This role is assigned to medium/complex reports.
  • Enters overpayments into Cotiviti system accurately and in accordance with standard procedures. Identifies and discusses audit findings with the audit team as a part of knowledge sharing and concept expansion.
  • May update current reports, develop, and run custom queries and validate the accuracy of current reports used. Makes determinations based on prior knowledge and experience of client contract terms with the likelihood of recovery acceptance.
  • Meets or exceeds standards for productivity, maintains regular and predictable attendance, and achieves production goals and standards set by the audit for the auditing concept. Ensures the expected level of quality and quantity for assigned work, including hit rate, claims written, vendor/project volume completion, ID, and/or fees per hour.
  • Meets or Exceeds Standards for Quality by achieving the expected level of quality set by the audit for the auditing concept, for valid claim identification and documentation.
  • Responds effectively to inquiries received on claims written. Provides verification of claims validation and confirmation, in a concise written manner, utilizing facts and details for justification purposes.
  • Demonstrates aptitude in reviewing transaction types, client contracts/vendor agreements, and client data with limited supervision of how to identify potential over or underpayments. Makes recommendations on medical policy application, state and federal statues, and other reimbursement methodologies as it applies to the audit concept.
  • Participates in onboarding new hires and cross-training efforts.
  • Identifies New Claim Types & Concept Expansion by researching and identifying potential claims outside the audit concept. Suggests, develops, and analyzes high quality, high value concepts and/or process improvements, tool enhancements, etc.
  • Recommends New Concepts & Processes by leveraging knowledge of client, contract terms, and complex claim types. Works towards developing and implementing new ideas, approaches, and/or technological improvements that will support and enhance audit production. Evaluates information and draws logical conclusions. Uses learned, tried, and proven validation methods to test and produce the desired/intended result of the new concept. May collaborate with Engineering in the development of new reports.
  • Demonstrates understanding of Cotiviti policies & procedures, and external regulatory requirements and performs duties in accordance with such regulatory requirements.
  • Ensures confidentiality and security of all data, adhering to all HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability) laws and requirements. Demonstrates the skills, knowledge, and ability to ensure that our environment is safe, complying with industry standards.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma - Required.
  • Bachelor’s degree (Preferred) and/or a minimum of at least (2 - 4) year/s related experience in healthcare.
  • At least 2 - 3 years of Cotiviti experience is recommended for individuals seeking their next opportunity internally.
  • Healthcare industry experience, including knowledge of Medicaid Claims is strongly preferred.
  • Computer proficiency including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Access).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interest in working with large data sets and various databases.
  • Ability to work well in an individual and team environment demonstrating self–motivation to deliver success.

Cognitive/Mental Requirements:

  • Ability to analyze large volumes of data, identify trends, discrepancies, and anomalies. Must have exceptional attention to detail to ensure accuracy in financial records and audit findings.
  • Demonstrates strong critical thinking skills, with the ability to assess complex situations, identify key issues, and propose practical solutions. Able to approach challenges methodically and with a strategic mindset.
  • Make informed decisions based on available data, regulations, and auditing standards. Must be able to weigh options and make recommendations that align with both compliance requirements and organizational goals.
  • Strong understanding of auditing standards, regulations, and industry best practices. Must be able to apply these standards consistently to ensure accurate and compliant audit processes.
  • Ability to recognize when something is wrong or needs further investigation. Must have the initiative to probe deeper into financial records or processes to uncover issues, inconsistencies, or irregularities.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of an audit team, sharing insights, collaborating on tasks, and contributing to a positive and productive team dynamic.
  • Demonstrates strong time management skills with the ability to juggle multiple tasks simultaneously and efficiently.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.

Base compensation ranges from $25.75 to $29.75 per hour. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Nonexempt employees are eligible to receive overtime pay for hours worked in excess of 40 hours in a given week, or as otherwise required by applicable state law.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Date of posting:11/10/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 11/17/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

raw.excerpt: Are you looking for a company where YOUR VOICE is heard?
raw.description:
Are you looking for a company where YOUR VOICE is heard? Where you can MAKE A DIFFERENCE? Do you THRIVE in a FAST-PACED work environment? Do you wake every morning EXCITED to work with GREAT PEOPLE and create SUCCESS TOGETHER? Then Intermedia is the place for you.
Intermedia has established itself as a leading provider of cloud communications and collaboration tech that allows companies to connect better. We have a strong track record of growth, profitability, and creating an environment where everyone matters. Everyone. While we are fast-paced and admittedly a bit intense, we promise that you won’t be bored. You will find Intermedia is a place where you can indulge your passion for creating and supporting great cloud technology. What’s more, we always look to promote from within and have many employees who have been with us 10, 15, and 20+ years!
Culture at Intermedia is built on teamwork and transparency. We hold each other accountable and always have each other’s back!
Are you ready to make your mark?
About the Role:
The Implementation Engineer (Integrations) designs, builds, and supports IVR and API integrations for enterprise contact center environments. This role works directly with customers to gather requirements, design call flows, and connect internal systems with third-party services such as CRM platforms, billing systems, and payment services. The position combines hands-on integration development, solution consulting, and troubleshooting to deliver reliable, scalable solutions and successful customer deployments.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Analyze customer contact center configurations, data extracts, and call flows to plan for the API integration
  • Gather and document customer requirements for API integrations, evaluate system readiness, and define scope, deliverables, and API integration timelines.
  • Build integrations between Intermedia contact center platform and third-party services using APIs, including CRM, billing, and payment platforms.
  • Read API documentation and design authentication, requests, data mappings, retries, and error handling; validate authentication and connectivity using tools such as Postman.
  • Create and maintain backend services, webhooks, middleware, and automation workflows that support customer implementations and ongoing data exchange.
  • Transform and synchronize data across systems, including mapping and validating customer records between CRM platforms, billing systems, and internal databases.
  • Design and implement API-driven IVR call flows, including data collection, menu design, conditional routing, and payment integrations; guide customers in creating efficient, user-friendly experiences.
  • Work with product, backend engineering, security, support, and vendor teams to clarify requirements, resolve technical constraints, and implement integrations with cloud services such as Azure or AWS.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, integration documentation, and operational runbooks covering configuration, deployment, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Troubleshoot integration failures, latency, and data quality; lead troubleshooting of production incidents and complex issues across APIs, IVR platforms, CRM systems;
  • Apply security practices including OAuth 2.0, secrets management, and encryption.
  • Lead technical design discussions and provide professional services and consulting for large and strategic customer accounts throughout implementation.
  • Provide post implementation escalation support to ensure stability and successful adoption.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in contact center technology, systems integration, or technical implementation. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise contact center technologies, including IVR call flows, routing rules, callbacks, external data tables, working hours configurations, and reporting or monitoring tools.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and OAuth 2.0, with practical experience using API documentation and tools such as Postman to build, validate, and troubleshoot integrations.
  • Familiarity with GraphQL APIs and API debugging using Swagger or developer portals.

raw.description:
This role can be remote based in the US or Canada

Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Application Architect to contribute to the design and delivery of cloud-native applications on AWS, growing into architectural ownership while staying close to the code. This is a role for someone who enjoys hands-on development and wants to sharpen the judgment that comes from designing services, APIs, and event flows that have to run reliably in production. You’ll help decompose systems into well-bounded services, shape serverless and container-based deployments, and make the day-to-day calls that keep applications scalable, secure, and maintainable.

In this role, you will work as a delivery-embedded contributor on a cross-functional team building real systems for real clients. You’ll collaborate closely with senior architects, engineers, and product partners to translate requirements into sound application architecture, implement infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines, and integrate AI services where they add value. Along the way you’ll develop the technical instincts that come from shipping things that matter and learn to weigh tradeoffs across cost, performance, resilience, and team velocity.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Contribute to the design of cloud-native applications, helping define service boundaries, API contracts, and data flows on AWS
  • Build and deploy microservices and serverless functions using containers and managed compute
  • Implement event-driven patterns and asynchronous messaging between services
  • Design and implement APIs across protocols and gateways
  • Support infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines that make deployments repeatable and safe
  • Implement observability, scalability, and resilience practices so applications stay healthy under load
  • Apply AWS Well-Architected practices for security, reliability, and cost across the services you build
  • Build and integrate AI and LLM services into cloud applications, including RAG and inference workflows
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Cursor, and other modern AI assistants to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Collaborate with engineers, data, AI, and product teams to translate requirements into sound application architecture
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs and design decisions clearly across functions
  • Maintain architecture and API documentation that supports reproducibility, onboarding, and shared understanding
  • Participate actively in design and code reviews, raising concerns and offering constructive feedback

Leadership & Influence

  • Take ownership of system components end-to-end with growing scope of architectural responsibility
  • Contribute to architectural standards and best practices that lift the quality of work across the team
  • Begin mentoring more junior engineers, sharing knowledge and supporting their growth

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with hands-on experience designing cloud-native applications
  • Working knowledge of a cloud platform and cloud-native application patterns, with AWS preferred
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language and familiarity with another (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Go)
  • Experience building microservices, serverless functions, and event-driven systems
  • Familiarity with containers and orchestration
  • Experience designing and consuming APIs across REST, GraphQL, or gRPC and working with API gateways
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure as code and CI/CD
  • Familiarity with observability, scalability, and resilience practices in cloud applications
  • Understanding of cloud security, identity, and access management fundamentals
  • Experience integrating AI or LLM services into applications, including RAG or inference patterns
  • Demonstrable, day-to-day usage of AI-forward tools such as Claude and Cursor
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges with sound judgment

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • CMS integration specialist experienced in localized site builds and content migration, with hands-on exposure to SurfOS.

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

This range may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role based in the US is $110,000. USD - $ 151,000.USD; the salary range for this role based in Canada is: $90,000. USD - $124,000. USD. raw.description:
Chief Project Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Project Officer (CPO) is responsible for leading the organization's strategic project portfolio, enterprise-wide program management, and major transformation initiatives across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that strategic projects are properly planned, prioritized, funded, executed, and delivered in alignment with organizational goals. The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and senior management team, the CPO will establish effective project governance, optimize resources, manage delivery risks, and ensure measurable business outcomes from the organization's project investments.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Project & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide project management and portfolio strategy.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and oversee strategic projects across insurance and investment business units.
  • Ensure project portfolios align with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, business cases, resource requirements, expected returns, and implementation risks.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and ensure projects deliver their intended strategic and financial benefits.

Insurance & Investment Project Delivery

  • Lead strategic initiatives involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee projects involving new insurance product launches, policy administration systems, claims management, underwriting processes, and distribution expansion.
  • Manage investment-related initiatives involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Coordinate projects involving regulatory changes, business process modernization, and operational restructuring.
  • Support the implementation of new business models, financial products, and market expansion initiatives.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Establish and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO), including project standards, methodologies, policies, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Ensure consistent project management practices across business units and subsidiaries.
  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Present portfolio performance reports, major risks, and project recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.
  • Oversee projects involving insurance technology (InsurTech), financial technology (FinTech), automation, AI, cloud platforms, CRM, and enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and investment service platforms.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, and CDO teams to ensure technology projects meet business requirements.
  • Monitor technology implementation costs, timelines, system integration, and business adoption.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and manage project portfolio budgets and investment plans.
  • Monitor expenditure, cost variations, financial performance, and project profitability.
  • Optimize resource allocation across projects, departments, and business units.
  • Evaluate project return on investment (ROI), cost-benefit analysis, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify and manage project-related operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk management, legal, compliance, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish risk mitigation, contingency, and business continuity plans for critical projects.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and organizational requirements.

Business Transformation & Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead cross-functional transformation programs aimed at improving operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Support organizational restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration projects.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving geographic expansion, new market entry, and business diversification.
  • Drive process improvement, automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Track business benefits and ensure successful adoption of project outcomes.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to establish project priorities.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders, regulators, investors, consultants, and external partners, as appropriate.
  • Resolve project conflicts involving scope, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation.
  • Provide executive-level updates on project performance, delivery challenges, and strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead project directors, program managers, project managers, and PMO professionals.
  • Develop high-performing project delivery teams across multiple business units.
  • Establish accountability, performance standards, and professional development programs.
  • Promote a culture of project ownership, collaboration, innovation, and delivery excellence.
  • Introduce project management tools, dashboards, and performance measurement systems.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Finance, Business Strategy, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership position overseeing complex project portfolios and strategic programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale, multi-departmental projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience establishing and managing enterprise PMOs and project governance frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and other project delivery methodologies.
  • Strong financial planning, budgeting, risk management, and resource allocation capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic projects delivered on time and within budget.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and strategic alignment.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Achievement of project milestones and approved deliverables.
  • Return on investment (ROI) and realization of expected business benefits.
  • Successful delivery of insurance and investment transformation initiatives.
  • Project risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Resource utilization and project team productivity.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project quality ratings.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.
  • Successful execution of digital transformation and business expansion projects.

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Job Title

Underwriting & Rating Analyst

About the Department

Join the Risk Assessment & Rating department within Health Alliance Plan, a mission-driven health plan serving members across Michigan. This team plays a critical role in ensuring accurate and efficient group renewal and new business processes, contributing to the organization's commitment to innovative coverage, care management, and wellness programs. By combining healthcare expertise with a focus on improving outcomes, this department offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of health and insurance services.

Role Overview

As an Underwriting & Rating Analyst, you will provide essential analytical and consulting support to the Risk Assessment & Rating department. Your work will directly impact the efficiency and accuracy of group renewal and new business processes, supporting both individual and group health plans. This role is vital to maintaining the integrity of our risk assessment and rating processes, ensuring we deliver on our mission to improve health outcomes for our members.

Why Henry Ford Health

At Henry Ford Health, we are relentless advocates for exceptional care for our patients, communities, and each other. We come to do meaningful work and grow our careers, and we stay for the connection, support, and shared pride in making the impossible, possible.

What You Will Do

  • Provide analytical and consulting support for group renewal processes (individual, reform, and non-reform) and new business.
  • Assist in recurring and special projects, developing and streamlining processes to increase departmental efficiencies.
  • Work extensively with databases to prepare documents, spreadsheets, and PowerPoint presentations for Risk Assessment & Rating projects.
  • Support planning and procedure development within the department.
  • Ensure accuracy and efficiency in all tasks, contributing to the overall success of the Risk Assessment & Rating department.

Go-to-Market Project Manager | Marketing Strategy & Execution

Are you a marketing strategist who enjoys leading go-to-market initiatives and driving growth in a fast-paced environment? Join Codekeeper as the driving force behind our marketing efforts, where you'll shape and execute the strategies that power our growth.

In this role, you'll own the go-to-market process end to end - coordinating cross-functional teams, launching campaigns, and turning strategy into measurable results.

We're accepting applications over the next two months and will fill the position as soon as we find the right fit.


Role Description:

As the Go-to-Market Project Manager, you'll be the engine that drives our marketing strategies and execution across various channels. You’ll oversee the go-to-market process, ensuring our content resonates with target audiences and fuels lead generation efforts. From SEO-driven content creation to campaign management, you’ll act as the linchpin between marketing and sales, translating business goals into impactful, market-facing strategies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and execute the go-to-market process, aligning content with company objectives.

  • Manage SEO-optimized content (website, blog, social media) and ensure it meets audience needs.

  • Oversee the creation of compelling Calls to Action (CTAs) that drive engagement.

  • Write, edit, and analyze email campaigns (mass, transactional, drip sequences).

  • Manage and create gated content and sales collateral (e.g., ebooks, infographics) that support the sales process.

  • Stay on top of relevant industry news and ensure we communicate with authority.

  • Continuously optimize content to align with brand guidelines and drive results.

  • Collaborate with the sales team to create content that directly contributes to lead generation and conversions.


More About Codekeeper:

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.


What We Offer:

  • A passionate and fun-loving team that thrives on collaboration.

  • A startup mindset with ample opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  • Regular team activities and collaborative sessions.

  • A comprehensive onboarding process, with a ramp-up period to set you up for success.

  • A supportive team that values open communication, direct feedback, and your contributions.

  • The chance to shape the future of software escrow and make a direct impact on the business.


Skills We Are Looking For:

  • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with a focus on creating compelling marketing content.

  • Ability to pragmatically use tools like ChatGPT to generate unique and high-quality content efficiently.

  • Deep knowledge of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in marketing and content management.

  • Proven project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.


Required Experience:

  • 3+ years in content creation and marketing project management.

  • Experience with HubSpot and Figma is a plus.


Job Location:

  • Remote

To apply, use the Apply button on this listing. In your application, tell us how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours, address some of the work we do, and introduce yourself as a colleague.

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

About the Position

WatchGuard Technologies is looking for an innovative, strategic, and passionate Global Director of Field and Channel Marketing who will be responsible for successfully leading the company’s Field, Partner, and Events Marketing organization. Our top candidate will have the talent and passion for continuing to drive our great channel partner ecosystem by creating, delivering, and executing integrated marketing programs that lead to quality pipeline, partner recruitment and partner growth. As part of the Revenue Marketing Team at WatchGuard, this candidate will lead a talented team and play a critical role on the marketing team and the broader GTM team. This individual will leverage their business and sales acumen, technology expertise, and strategic marketing skills to support the growth objectives of our partner team, driving adoption and usage of our products and services and improving new logo acquisition as well as overall customer and partner satisfaction, retention, and advocacy.

A Day in the Life

A day in the life of the Global Director of Field and Channel Marketing will likely start with checking in with various teams such as sales leadership, leadership counterparts across the marketing organization or your direct team. You will meet with the global Sales leads to discuss and set priorities as well as discuss pipeline performance and opportunities for impact. You will discuss current budgets, ongoing projects and any challenges that are occurring with specific partners including the steps to resolution. You will then assist and provide guidance to your team on any specific projects including building marketing plans, event strategy and planning, MDF budget recommendations, and thought leadership for our partners. You will foster a culture of global and regional knowledge sharing across your teams as well as chat with the other members of marketing leadership to discuss new tools and processes and collaborate on opportunities to optimize and mitigate challenges. You will hold regular team meeting to discuss team and companywide initiatives such as new tools available, quarterly and trimester goal, and health metrics and to connect the dots on these initiatives and the teams’ daily tasks. You will meet with and work directly with top partners, as well as help your team build short and long-term engagement plans for top partners in their territories. You will close out your day working on some IC projects including building new processes and opportunities for improvement, budget management, sales enablement initiatives and setting your goals and actions for the next day.

Position Responsibilities

  • Manage the global Field, Partner, and Events Marketing organizations. Create and implement an integrated marketing plan that starts with a clear view of priorities, an alignment with sales strategy and a solid understanding of the market trends within specific product lines and customer and partner market segments.
  • Passion for developing deep relationships within our ecosystem and providing the best partner experience. Work collaboratively with our sales teams, channel partners, and distributors to develop and deliver innovative, end-user marketing programs that generate demand for our partners and ultimately result in new logo acquisition. Publish and monitor results, learnings and

best practices with key stakeholders and partner, as well as adjust plans and priorities to stay focused and efficient.

  • Deliver innovative, partner acquisition marketing programs that drive awareness, new partner engagements, and deliver new partner to our ecosystem. Work with our sales and ABX teams to build and execute strategic ABX plans to assist in growth and accelerate pipeline from key target accounts.
  • Introduce new processes, cutting edge marketing trends, and best practices to evangelize with our partners as thought leadership as well as implement at WatchGuard to help scale the business.
  • Translate the overall annual marketing plan and goals into actionable quarterly targets, goals, initiatives, and metrics for the region as well as advocate for new company and marketing org practices, processes, and tools.
  • Lead the strategic events team in executing an offline and online event strategy that meets corporate and field objectives e. g. leads to Sales, awareness, advance major accounts, Industry/trade/User group, company, and partner events.
  • Maintain an overarching marketing plan the encapsulates the teams to and thru partner marketing activities including a 90-day rolling calendar of integrated activities and events
  • Work with the greater marketing team to arm sales teams and partners with tailored content support to leverage in customer and partner outreach and engagement.
  • Work with Channel/Field Marketing and Sales Management to reach agreement on budget for the year, quarterly program spending, and objectives. Manage the tracking, reporting, and forecasting of team spend. Follow and advocate for accounting practices and requirements to insure accurate and timely vendor management.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

  • Experience with channel marketing with a deep understanding of channel and distribution.
  • Experience developing direct marketing, and demand generation programs, with in depth knowledge of on-line and email marketing. An understanding of Account Based Experience including experience partnering with sales on their account-based approach.
  • Experience building deep partner relationships including developing and implementing marketing plans that include measurements of success as well as experience with event planning and execution.
  • Concise and accurate budget management across the region; Including ownership, management and reporting of MDF spend and planning and reporting of marketing budget, accrual, and expenditure.
  • Experience with building systems and processes to enable scale.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing high performing teams
  • Dynamic, results-oriented personality that works well with others and can drive projects forward amidst multiple shifting priorities and goals in a matrixed organization.
  • Highly detail-oriented with strong project management and organizational skills as well as strong written and verbal communications. Proven ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
  • Experience using CRM systems, Salesforce.com preferred
  • 10+ years of proven work experience with an ideal mix of marketing, strategic, technical, and business background
  • BA/BS degree preferred or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Able to travel up to 50% when required.

Location: Seattle, WA, Miami, Florida, Cork, Ireland, or remote within the US.

Why Work for WatchGuard?

WatchGuard is a global leader in network security and intelligence, advanced endpoint protection, multi-factor authentication, and secure Wi-Fi. Our award-winning products and services are trusted worldwide by more than 18,000 security resellers and service providers to protect more than 250,000 customers. Our technology keeps our customers ahead of increasingly sophisticated hackers and has fueled record revenues at WatchGuard.

WatchGuard is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with team members working remotely and in offices worldwide.

Our company culture places an intense focus on our customers and employees. From the newest employee to our CEO, you'll find that each person at WatchGuard embodies our Core Values: Accountability, Community, Belonging, Action, Innovation, and Customer-Centric. Learn more about our company culture at www.watchguard.com/wgrd-careers.

WatchGuard provides equal employment opportunities for all qualified employees, regardless of their race, color, national origin, religion, ancestry, creed, pregnancy, age, sex, sexual orientation (including gender expression or identity), marital status, mental or physical disability, honorably discharged veteran or military status or any other category protected by federal, state or local laws. Our equal employment opportunity (or EEO) policy focuses solely on the talent, hard work, contributions, and actual results achieved by each WatchGuard employee and on the potential of employment candidates to make such contributions. We consider focusing on an employee's protected characteristics rather than on talent, hard work, and actual work results to violate our EEO policy. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to a diverse workforce. WatchGuard participates in E-verify.

WatchGuard is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

raw.description:
About this Role

We are searching for an Events & Social Media Marketing Manager to join the Muon Space team. You will be responsible for planning and running Muon Space’s presence at industry events and for growing our voice on social media. The Events & Social Media Marketing Manager reports to the Marketing Lead and collaborates closely with Muon Space’s Business Development, Engineering, Product, Legal and leadership teams. You will own the event calendar from planning through follow-up, create and publish social content that reflects a confident, mission-focused Muon Space, and measure how both support company growth goals. You will manage event vendors and creative support as needed.

As Events & Social Media Marketing Manager, you will be the person who makes Muon Space visible where our customers, partners, investors and future employees gather, in person and online. You will plan and execute exhibits, sponsorships and company-hosted events at conferences such as Space Symposium, GEOINT Symposium and the SmallSat Conference, and you will turn those moments, along with launches, milestones and mission results, into a steady stream of social content. You will work closely with Business Development to make sure events produce meetings and leads.

This position can be performed remotely from an approved location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Muon Space’s annual event calendar: recommend which conferences, trade shows and sponsorships to attend, set objectives and manage the events budget.
  • Plan and execute event exhibits, including booth design, supporting materials, logistics, shipping and on-site coordination.
  • Plan company-hosted events such as customer receptions, executive dinners, facility openings and launch watch parties.
  • Work with Business Development to schedule customer meetings, speaking slots and executive participation at each event.
  • Measure and report on event results, including meetings held, leads generated and pipeline influenced, and follow up with leads after each event.
  • Manage Muon Space’s social media accounts, including LinkedIn, X and YouTube, and maintain a content calendar.
  • Create and publish social content, including posts, short video, photography and graphics, tied to company milestones, launches, events and thought leadership.
  • Grow audience and engagement, track performance and suggest new formats and features to build brand awareness.
  • Support executives and subject-matter experts in building their professional presence on LinkedIn.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal and leadership to ensure brand consistency, tone, voice and terminology, and to clear content for public release.
  • Manage event vendors, agencies and creative contractors.
  • All other duties as assigned

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in event marketing, social media marketing or a related role, ideally in a B2B or technology company.
  • Proven experience planning and running trade show exhibits and corporate events end to end, including budgets and vendors.
  • Hands-on experience managing company social media accounts and growing audience and engagement, especially on LinkedIn.
  • Excellent copywriting skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly and concisely.
  • Working knowledge of design and content tools such as Adobe Creative Suite or Canva, Google Workspace, and social scheduling and analytics tools.
  • Able to manage multiple projects with short deadlines and work with minimal supervision.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, oral and written communication skills, including the ability to work effectively in a diverse team environment.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced development environment.
  • Able to travel up to 35% of time, with concentrated travel around major events.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with aerospace, space, defense or government technology marketing.
  • Experience with major industry events such as Space Symposium, GEOINT Symposium, SmallSat Conference or AGU.
  • Short-form video production and editing skills.
  • Experience with marketing automation and CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Experience running executive social media or employee advocacy programs.
  • Experience working with communications and media teams on launches and announcements.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $146,000 - $219,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Muon is currently registered and able to hire in the following states:
AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IA, ID, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VT, VA, WA

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. The Company may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

Sua missão será apoiar clientes e equipes técnicas no planejamento e desenho de campanhas e jornadas, trazendo uma perspectiva de marketing e estratégia de negócios para os projetos de automação.

Você vai se destacar nesta função se for:

  • Uma pessoa curiosa, com vontade de melhorar processos e buscar novas soluções
  • Colaborativo, que valoriza trabalho em equipe e troca de conhecimento
  • Motivado pela interseção entre tecnologia, criatividade e dados
  • Familiarizado com metodologias Ágeis e consultoria (um diferencial)


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com clientes e equipes técnicas nos projetos de CRM & Marketing Automation, com foco em estratégia e performance.
  • Pesquisar benchmarks, realizar brainstormings e desenvolver conceitos e storytelling para campanhas e jornadas.
  • Desenhar estratégias de campanhas e jornadas no Miro, incluindo fluxos e detalhes de documentação, como objetivos principais e segmentação de público.
  • Elaborar briefings para orientar as equipes criativas e revisar textos, layouts e demais materiais de campanha quando estiverem prontos, garantindo que estejam alinhados à estratégia proposta.
  • Analisar performance e boas práticas das jornadas atualmente ativas, gerando insights e propondo otimizações de estratégia, testes A/B e próximos passos.
  • Conduzir sessões de discovery, consultoria e brainstorming com clientes para compreender seus objetivos e necessidades de negócio de curto e longo prazo, além do comportamento e ciclo de vida de seus usuários.
  • Apoiar a criação, o planejamento e a priorização de roadmaps.
  • Apoiar clientes e equipes de desenvolvimento nos processos de implementação, garantindo que a entrega final atenda aos requisitos de estratégia e performance.
  • Apoiar o(a) coordenador(a) de estratégia e as equipes de delivery na criação e atualização de processos de workflow, documentações, templates de briefing, apresentações comerciais e outros materiais relacionados aos projetos de Estratégia de CRM.
  • Apoiar o onboarding e atuar como mentor(a) de estagiários, trainees e analistas juniores de estratégia, compartilhando boas práticas da área.
  • Apoiar as equipes de gestão em atividades comerciais e de parceria, contribuindo com trabalhos estratégicos em cases e apresentações.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou pós-graduação, preferencialmente em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, Design ou áreas relacionadas; ou 6+ anos de experiência em posições de marketing.
  • 6+ anos de experiência em projetos de marketing, planejamento e/ou estratégia.
  • 4+ anos de experiência em projetos de CRM Marketing, incluindo automação e/ou campanhas pontuais.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Salesforce Marketing Cloud ou ferramentas de automação similares.
  • Experiência com e-mail, SMS, push notification e/ou WhatsApp.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Visão de negócios e marketing holística, além de excelentes habilidades de escuta.
  • Capacidade de interpretar necessidades implícitas durante reuniões, identificar as principais dores e necessidades reais do cliente e propor estratégias concretas para solucioná-las.
  • Inglês avançado.

Diferenciais:

  • Idioma espanhol intermediário a avançado;
  • Experiência monitorando e analisando dados do Google Analytics, dashboards do Datorama, PowerBI ou Data Studio, e criando slides para apresentações de relatórios.
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência em outras áreas e canais de marketing digital (por exemplo: conteúdo, mídia social, mídia paga, site, blogs, produtos digitais, etc.)
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência configurando e implementando campanhas de CRM ou Inbound Marketing, HTML, SQL básico ou qualquer outra etapa técnica do processo de automação.
  • Experiência trabalhando em projetos digitais de grandes empresas envolvendo agências ou consultorias (como parte da equipe da agência ou da empresa cliente).

Se não atender a todos os requisitos, ainda assim o incentivamos a inscrição. Na Valtech, valorizamos perfis diversos e vontade de aprender.

This role is based US (remote) - no more than GMT-6

Shape the strategies of North America’s leading technology vendors.

At Omdia Enterprise Consulting, we work with some of the biggest names in Enterprise IT, Cybersecurity, AI/IoT and Channel, helping them navigate shifting markets, outperform competitors and unlock growth. Our insights, data and consulting expertise inform board-level decisions.

We are growing quickly and looking for a Senior Consultant to deliver high-impact projects across the North American enterprise technology landscape. You will combine analytical rigour with project management discipline, working directly with executives to solve critical challenges. Our clients invest in strategic insight to drive measurable, long-term impact, and you will play a central role in delivering that value.

Project delivery

  • Deliver North America-focused consulting projects, including market entry, go-to-market strategy, partner ecosystem development and competitive positioning, applying Omdia’s methodologies to produce commercially strong, differentiated and actionable outcomes.
  • Manage distributed teams of analysts and consultants through the PMO framework, maintaining clear objectives, effective collaboration, and strong control of budgets, timelines and utilisation targets.

Business development support

  • Work closely with sales and account managers to scope, position and support proposals for North American clients, contributing accurate, well-structured and commercially aligned inputs to bids and custom projects.
  • Identify opportunities within client accounts to grow consulting and subscription work in partnership with account management teams.

Client engagement and influence

  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders across North America, positioning Omdia as a trusted partner and supporting senior colleagues in executive and partner-facing discussions.
  • Act as a reliable point of contact throughout delivery, ensuring client needs are addressed promptly and effectively.

Primary Competencies

  • Delivery and planning – Owns project delivery end to end, ensuring quality, timeliness and measurable client outcomes.
  • Collaboration and communication – Works effectively with analysts, consultants and sales teams across North America, with strong written, verbal and presentation skills for enterprise clients.
  • Commercial and client management – Brings confidence in budgets, project economics and proposal support, while building trust and managing day-to-day client relationships.
  • Problem solving – Applies structured thinking to client challenges within the North American market context.

Supporting Competencies

  • Market awareness and mindset – Brings a solid understanding of North American enterprise IT, cybersecurity, AI/IoT and channel ecosystems, with the credibility to engage client executives and draw on Omdia analyst expertise. Growth-oriented, resilient and committed to continuous improvement.

Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience in management consulting, market analysis or senior roles in the North American enterprise technology sector.
  • Strong knowledge of North American enterprise IT and channel markets, including indirect routes to market.
  • Proven track record of delivering consulting projects with multi-stakeholder client teams and supporting proposals, bids, workshops and governance calls.

raw.description:
Position Overview

What if your ability to build meaningful relationships could help take the hope of Jesus to places where he is least known? We’re looking for a new team member who sees fundraising as an invitation to God’s people to help fuel his work around the world in the nearly 150 countries, and on two large ministry ships, in which OM operates.

The Regional Philanthropy Advisor/Director of Major Gifts serves as a key member of the Advancement team, cultivating and stewarding relationships with donors across the Southeast region. This role manages a portfolio of approximately 125-150 major donors and prospects and is responsible for securing significant philanthropic investments that advance Operation Mobilization's mission to see vibrant communities of Jesus followers among the least reached.

Through strategic relationship management, donor engagement, and personalized invitation efforts, the Regional Director of Major Gifts will identify and cultivate relationships with high-net-worth individuals, families, and foundations, leading to five-, six-, and seven-figure gifts.

Key Objectives

  1. Meet or exceed annual fundraising goals for the assigned region.

  1. Develop and maintain meaningful, mission-centered relationships with donors and prospects through a disciplined moves management strategy.

  1. Contribute actively to the Philanthropy Advisory Team, the Advancement department, and the broader ministry of OM USA.

Major Responsibilities

Portfolio Management and Relationship Building

  • Develop and execute strategic moves management plans to secure five-, six-, and seven-figure commitments from a portfolio of 125-150 individuals, families and foundations throughout the Southeast region.

  • Serve as a compelling ambassador for OM's mission and vision.

  • Nurture donor relationships through personalized engagement, including qualification, cultivation, invitation, stewardship, and renewal activities. Includes a minimum of 55 face-to-face donor visits annually.

  • Discover and align donor passions, interests, and philanthropic goals with meaningful ministry opportunities.

  • Partner with donors to explore opportunities for increased involvement, planned giving, asset giving, and other complex gifts.

  • Equip, encourage, and mobilize donors to advocate for OM within their networks.

  • Reengage lapsed donors and identify opportunities for renewed partnership with OM's mission.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Partner effectively with the CEO, board members, key ministry leaders, Church Connections, others on the Philanthropy Advisory Team, and Freedom Challenge to maximize donor engagement and organizational impact.

  • Administration & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and timely donor records, activity reports, pipeline data, and revenue forecasts within OM's CRMs.

  • Monitor portfolio performance and establish strategies to achieve fundraising objectives.

  • Provide timely updates and reports to leadership on donor engagement, invitation activity, and revenue projections.

Travel & Work Environment

  • Work remotely from a home office within the assigned region.

  • Travel throughout the Southeast region and nationally, as needed, up to 50% of the time.

OM Team Participation

  • Participate in team gatherings focused on prayer, fellowship, mission updates, and professional development.

  • Contribute to a healthy and collaborative organizational culture across OM USA.

  • Engage constructively in team meetings, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional projects.

Qualifications

Mission & Faith Alignment

  • Demonstrates a personal commitment to Jesus Christ and agreement with OM USA's Statement of Faith.

  • Passionate about OM's mission to see vibrant communities of Jesus followers established among the least reached peoples of the world.

  • Able to represent OM's mission with authenticity, conviction, and spiritual maturity.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required; equivalent professional experience may be considered.

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of successful frontline fundraising experience, preferably within a mid-sized or large nonprofit organization.

  • Demonstrated success developing relationships with high-capacity funders, managing donor portfolios and securing major gifts.

  • Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

  • Strong listening skills with the ability to inspire, engage, and influence others.

  • Strategic thinker with proven organizational abilities.

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and capable of working independently.

  • High degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

  • Comfortable interacting with diverse stakeholders, including executives, entrepreneurs, ministry leaders, and missionaries.

  • Demonstrates humility, collaboration, adaptability, and servant leadership.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds on occasion.

  • Ability to travel extensively and attend meetings, conferences, and donor events.

Other Duties

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by the incumbent. Employees may be asked to perform other related duties as assigned.
