raw.description:
Overview

National Debt Relief is hiring a hands-on Paid Social Strategist to drive customer acquisition on Meta and TikTok across our brands. You will build and optimize campaigns in platform every day, develop new creative, and keep multiple brands' creative pipelines moving from request to launch to performance readout.

​This role sits on the paid social team and reports to the Director of Paid Social. It combines media buying and creative strategy: you own the full loop from concept to asset to launch to optimization, and you are accountable for efficient, compliant growth in enrolled debt.​

Responsibilities

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • Campaign management (hands on keyboard)
    • Build, launch and scale Meta and TikTok campaigns, ad sets and ads directly in platform
    • Make daily optimizations on budgets, bids, audiences, placements and pauses based on CPA, CPQL, ABI and enrolled debt
    • Manage value-based bidding setups and conversion API events so platforms optimize toward qualified and enrolled outcomes
    • Plan and run structured tests (creative, audience, bidding, landing page) with clear hypotheses and readouts
    • Expand into new audiences and formats, including Spanish-language campaigns and partnership ads
  • Multi-brand project management
    • Manage concurrent creative requests across multiple brands and prioritize by expected impact
    • Track every asset from request through development, approval, launch and performance, using consistent naming conventions
    • Keep stakeholders informed on status, timelines and blockers
  • Reporting
    • Deliver regular performance readouts covering results, learnings and next actions
    • Surface insights on creative fatigue, audience saturation and scale opportunities
    • Share learnings across brands to compound wins
  • Creative strategy and production
    • Develop concepts, hooks, scripts and copy for static, video, UGC-style and Stories/Reels placements
    • Edit or direct new creative in-house and with designers, editors and creators
    • Adapt winning creative across platforms and brands while keeping each brand's voice
    • Work with compliance to get ad copy and claims approved before launch

Qualifications

Education/Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required, bachelor’s degree in business or related field preferred.
  • ​​​5+ years running paid social customer acquisition with deep hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience and strong TikTok Ads Manager experience
  • ​Track record of scaling lead generation or direct-response accounts to efficient CPA targets, ideally with large budgets
  • ​Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, with a clear system for tracking asset development and launch
  • ​Experience with partnership ads, creator or UGC programs

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Working knowledge of conversion API, event setup, value-based bidding and lead quality optimization
  • Comfort with data: you can build and explain a performance
  • Clear written communication and a bias toward fast, independent execution
  • Experience in financial services, debt relief or other regulated verticals, including working with compliance on ad review is a plus
  • Demonstrated creative skill: strong instincts for hooks, messaging and visual storytelling, plus working ability in tools Monday, Claude, Trybe, etc
  • Experience with Spanish-language or multicultural audiences is a plus

National Debt Relief Role Qualifications:

  • Computer competency and ability to work with a computer.
  • Prioritize multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Punctuality expected, ready to report to work on a consistent basis.
  • Attain and maintain high performance expectations on a monthly basis.
  • Work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting.
  • Use and navigate multiple computer systems with exceptional multi-tasking skills.
  • Remain calm and professional during difficult discussions.
  • Take constructive feedback.
  • Available for full-time position.

Compensation Information

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for each position across the US. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This good faith pay range is provided in compliance with NYC law and the laws of other jurisdictions that may require a salary range in job postings. The salary for this position is $86,500 to $99,500 annually.

About National Debt Relief

National Debt Relief was founded in 2009 with the goal of helping an expanding number of consumers deal with overwhelming debt. We are one of the most-trusted and best-rated consumer debt relief providers in the United States. As a leading debt settlement organization, we have helped over 450,000 people settle over $10 billion of debt, while empowering them to lead a healthier financial lifestyle and feel free to live their best life. At National Debt Relief, we treat our clients like real people. Our purpose is to elevate, empower, and transform their lives.

Rated A+ by the Better Business Bureau, our goal is to help individuals and families get out of debt with the least possible cost through conducting financial consultations, educating the consumer and recommending the appropriate solution. We become our clients' number one advocate to help them reestablish financial stability as quickly as possible.

Want to learn more about who we are? Connect with us on social!

Benefits

National Debt Relief is a team-oriented environment full of rewards and growth opportunities for our employees. We are dedicated to our employee's success and growth within the company, through our employee mentorship and leadership programs.

Our extensive benefits package includes:

  • Generous Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Paid Holidays, Volunteer Time Off, Sick Days, and Vacation
  • 12 weeks Paid Parental Leave
  • Pre-tax Transit Benefits

  • Voluntary Benefits Options
  • ASPCA Pet Health Insurance Discount

raw.description:
Use your clinical expertise to improve how veterinary care is captured, supported and delivered

Are you an experienced veterinary or animal health professional who enjoys looking beyond the immediate clinical issue to understand how processes, systems and commercial decisions affect a practice?

We are ideally looking for someone with a qualification in veterinary science or veterinary nursing, combined with a strong clinical skillset and credibility. This is an opportunity to use that expertise in a broader role, helping veterinary teams solve problems, strengthen their processes and improve billing accuracy across a large national network. Your role will enable making billing easier for our teams – so they can spend more time with their patients and less time in their patient management system!

You will work closely with clinical teams, operations, commercial, pricing, PIMS and IT stakeholders to identify where things are not working as intended, understand why, and turn your findings into practical solutions.

About Greencross

Greencross is Australia’s largest integrated pet wellness organisation, bringing together Petbarn, City Farmers, Greencross Vets and our animal emergency and referral hospitals. Our purpose is to make our world a happier place through the love of pets.

The opportunity

You’ll combine clinical expertise, analysis, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving to understand what’s happening at clinic level and turn insights into practical improvements. You’ll identify opportunities to improve charge capture through making processes simpler for the clinical teams, whilst driving the veterinary network to value the services and care they provide.

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Use your clinical knowledge to influence improvements across a national veterinary network.
  • Work across clinical, operational and commercial teams to solve meaningful problems and turn insights into practical solutions.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and coach clinic teams through constructive improvement.
  • Help shape more consistent, sustainable approaches to billing accuracy and clinical compliance.

What you will do

  • Lead the approach to billing accuracy, charge capture and compliance across our veterinary network.
  • Review clinical records, estimates and invoices to identify gaps, patterns and opportunities for improvement.
  • Turn data and clinic insights into clear, practical action plans.
  • Work with clinic teams to understand barriers, strengthen processes and provide practical coaching.
  • Partner with Commercial, Pricing, Operations, PIMS and IT to resolve workflow, pricing or system issues.
  • Monitor progress and identify recurring issues that require broader process or system change.

About you

You’re a clinically credible, commercially curious problem-solver who genuinely enjoys working with people.

Ideally, you’ll bring:

  • A qualification in veterinary science, veterinary nursing or another relevant animal health discipline.
  • A strong clinical skillset, with the credibility to engage confidently with senior clinical stakeholders.
  • Sound business acumen and comfort working with data, reporting and Excel. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should enjoy using information to understand what’s happening and why.
  • Excellent stakeholder skills. You’re a people person who builds relationships and collaborates well across different teams.
  • A natural curiosity for finding problems, understanding their root cause and turning them into solutions.
  • Experience within veterinary practice operations, clinical auditing, billing compliance or commercial performance improvement.
  • Experience with veterinary PIMS, pricing, estimates, procedures or billing configuration would be highly regarded.

Above all, you’ll bring a constructive approach to improvement, respecting clinical judgement while helping teams build stronger, more consistent processes

Interested?

Please contact Angie Goldman at to express your interest and learn more about the next steps.

raw.description:
About Uplift

Uplift is a dynamic agency specializing in global talent search, covering EMEA, LATAM, USA, and APAC. With successful placements in 60 countries, we combine speed and cutting-edge technology to source top executive and mid-senior talent across various functions. Our innovative approach integrates global networks, AI, and advanced recruitment tools. Beyond recruitment, we engage with our audience through our podcast, newsletter, and webinars, ensuring we stay at the forefront of talent acquisition and global HR trends.

About Our Client

Our client is a leading global digital advertising company operating in over 130 markets worldwide. Through partnerships with nearly 60 major digital platforms, the company helps businesses expand their reach and maximize advertising opportunities. With a strong international presence and a dynamic, multicultural environment, they offer exciting career opportunities for professionals looking to grow in the digital advertising industry.

About the Role

We are looking for a results-driven Senior Client Partner to drive business growth and develop strong relationships with advertisers and media agencies.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in business development, digital advertising sales and client acquisition, with the ability to identify opportunities, build partnerships and deliver revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, prospect and acquire new advertisers, brands and agency partners to drive advertising revenue.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue targets and business growth objectives.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, advertisers and media agencies.
  • Understand clients' business objectives and recommend suitable digital advertising solutions.
  • Present advertising opportunities, platform capabilities and tailored proposals to prospective clients.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation and prospecting to negotiations and closing deals.
  • Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling and expanding existing client accounts.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful campaign execution and client satisfaction.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities and developments in the digital advertising industry.
  • Maintain accurate sales pipelines, forecasts and client information using CRM tools.
  • Provide regular updates on sales performance, revenue opportunities and business development activities.

Key Requirements

  • Proven experience in business development, advertising sales, digital media sales or client partnerships.
  • Strong track record in new client acquisition, achieving sales targets and generating revenue.
  • Good understanding of digital marketing, paid social advertising and the digital advertising ecosystem.
  • Ability to explain digital advertising solutions and their business value to clients.

Role Overview

The Finance & Accounting Lead (FAL) exists to give the founding team a clear, honest picture of Timber's cash, runway, and unit economics — and to ensure Timber is not just fundraise-ready when the moment comes, but can position Timber to scale financially, quickly and safely.

Position / Title

Finance & Accounting Lead (FAL)

Role Classification

Founding Team Member — “Someone joining extremely early and owning a critical function, but not necessarily receiving co-founder-level ownership.”

Reporting Relationship

Reports to the Founder & CEO (Allan Meade) and Chief Operations Officer (COO).

Start Date

To be confirmed in writing between the parties via Offer Letter.

Responsibilities

The Finance & Accounting Lead (FAL) leads Timber's financial planning and strategic financial operations: overseeing financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, cash management, cap table coordination, fundraising preparation, and analysis of Timber's business and marketplace economics.

Specific responsibilities include:

• Building and maintaining Timber's financial model, budget, and forecasts • Managing cash flow and runway planning for the founding team • Coordinating the Company's capitalization table alongside legal counsel and the Startup Legal Counsel • Preparing financial materials for fundraising, including data rooms and investor financial diligence • Analyzing marketplace economics (e.g., option fees, packaging fees, take rates) to inform pricing and strategy • Establishing financial controls, reporting cadences, and KPI dashboards for the founding team and Board • Tracking actual spend against budget and flagging variances to the CEO • Modeling different fundraising scenarios and their impact on runway and ownership • Supporting compensation and equity-pool decisions with clear financial context

Qualifications

Strong relevant experience matters more than a specific pedigree.

• Comfortable building and maintaining financial models, budgets, and forecasts in spreadsheets • Strong understanding of startup fundraising mechanics (cap tables, SAFEs/priced rounds) • Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills • Prior experience in finance, accounting, or startup operations is a plus, but not required • Comfortable working with incomplete data and evolving priorities

What “Wins” Look Like for this role

Concrete markers that this role is succeeding at Timber's current stage:

• An accurate, up-to-date financial model and runway forecast the CEO and COO can trust and use • Clean, organized financial records and cap table ready for investor diligence • Clear visibility into marketplace unit economics (option fees, packaging fees, take rates) • Fundraising financial materials ready ahead of when they're needed • Reliable, regular financial reporting to the CEO and founding team

Expected Time Commitment

Hours as needed, reflecting Timber's current early development stage. There is no fixed weekly hour requirement; the FAL is expected to commit whatever time is reasonably needed to meet the responsibilities above. This commitment is expected to increase as Timber reaches key funding or traction milestones.

Remote / Work Arrangement

Remote, with core collaboration hours coordinated with the CEO and founding team.

Startup Compensation Structure

  • Equity-only compensation during this fundraising round, with detailed equity terms to be set in the Offer Letter (including type of equity, vesting schedule, cliff, and any refresh considerations)

  • No cash salary as part of this round; compensation is aligned with equity ownership and future liquidity milestones

  • Any future compensation adjustments (e.g., salary, benefits) will be determined in subsequent fundraising rounds or upon milestone-based triggers, and will be documented in an updated Offer Letter or employment agreement

Communication Expectations

Weekly 1:1 with the CEO, participation in the founding-team leadership sync, and prompt (same-business-day) responsiveness on the Company's primary communication channel during agreed working hours.

Outside Activities

Because this is an hours-as-needed engagement, the FAL may hold other employment, consulting engagements, or business activities, provided they do not directly compete with Timber, do not create a conflict of interest, and do not interfere with the availability and responsiveness this role requires. Any potential conflict should be disclosed to, and approved in advance by, the CEO.

At-Will Relationship

This role is engaged on an at-will basis. Either the Finance & Accounting Lead (FAL) or the Company may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause and with or without notice. Nothing in this document guarantees continued engagement for any specific period, notwithstanding the vesting schedule described above.

Confidentiality & IP Assignment

As a condition of this role, the Finance & Accounting Lead (FAL) is required to execute Timber's Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement (“CIIAA”) prior to or concurrent with starting work. Under the CIIAA, all inventions, work product, and intellectual property created in connection with Timber are assigned to the Company, and the Company's confidential information (including marketplace, listing, and deal data) is protected during and after the engagement.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£41,300-52,250 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our VAIB team⭐

Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

As External Partnerships & Engagement Manager, you will strategically manage a portfolio of VAIB partnerships that bring vital specialist expertise and enhanced support to Monzo's most vulnerable customers. You will proactively identify new partnership opportunities while leveraging data and customer feedback to continuously monitor and maximize the value of your existing relationships. Ultimately, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate this external insight and lived experience into tangible, practical improvements across our products, services, and customer journeys.

  • Manage Partnership Lifecycles: Own the end-to-end portfolio of VAIB external partnerships, from identifying strategic opportunities to onboarding, ongoing relationship management, and appropriate exits.
  • Drive Data-Led Impact: Continuously evaluate partnership performance using data and operational feedback, clearly reporting successes and confidently acting to strengthen or stop underperforming relationships.
  • Oversee Governance and Risk: Partner with Supplier Operations to conduct robust due diligence, ensuring all external relationships strictly adhere to Monzo’s risk, governance, and regulatory expectations.
  • Translate Insights into Action: Leverage specialist partner knowledge to identify opportunities and drive tangible improvements across vulnerable customer journeys, products, and support strategies.
  • Lead Lived-Experience Research: Own the Signposting Standard and collaborate with the Research team to capture lived experiences, turning best-practice insights into clear cross-functional recommendations.
  • Deliver Community Engagement: Plan external awareness campaigns, host expert listening sessions, and collaborate with Public Policy and Communications to amplify Monzo's impact and support media activity.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have a deep understanding of VAIB principles and the barriers vulnerable customers face, driven by a strong commitment to improving customer outcomes through meaningful external collaboration.
  • You have proven experience managing external relationships, going beyond relationship-building to set clear objectives, build trust, and hold both internal and external stakeholders accountable for delivering measurable benefits.
  • You have experience evaluating partnership effectiveness using data and customer feedback, and are highly skilled at translating external expertise and lived experiences into practical, actionable recommendations for teams across Monzo.
  • You have a strong grasp of due diligence and risk management, ensuring all external partnerships are supported by rigorous governance and robust, accurate documentation.
  • You are a highly organised problem-solver capable of managing multiple competing priorities, confidently navigating challenging stakeholder conversations, and proactively course-correcting when partnerships fail to deliver their intended value.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £41,300-52,250 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Recruiter call (25 minutes)
  • Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

raw.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Join the recognized leader in AI-first CX

NiCE Cognigy is building the Agentic AI Workforce of the future for enterprise customer service — named a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ 2026 and a three-time Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™. We already power AI Agents for 1,250+ brands worldwide, and with NiCE investing heavily in AI, the opportunity ahead of us has never been bigger.

Italy is a market with significant potential for enterprise AI-driven customer service, and we’re now building our presence there. We’re looking for a seasoned, senior presales professional to help us win the first complex enterprise deals and lay the foundation for our growth in the Italian market.


Location: Remote, based in Germany, with the possibility to hire in Spain or the Netherlands

So, What's the role all about?

As a senior member of our European presales team focusing on the Italian-speaking market, you’ll be the trusted technical advisor on our most strategic and complex enterprise opportunities. This is not a junior demo role. It’s a position for a tenured consultant who can own the technical narrative in front of enterprise buyers, navigate sophisticated stakeholder landscapes, and shape solutions that close seven-figure deals.

This is a market in the making. You’ll be among the first to shape how NiCE Cognigy shows up in Italy, so we need a tenured, adaptable presales engineer who isn’t afraid to open a market from scratch and who delivers tangible results wherever the business needs them.
Beyond the deal cycle, you’ll be a visible voice for NiCE Cognigy in the market, representing us through thought leadership at customer and marketing events and helping drive awareness across Italy.

How will you make an impact?

  • Partner with the sales team to plan, prepare and execute on complex, strategic enterprise deals in Italy and, where relevant, other European markets.
  • Lead discovery calls and technical deep dives with enterprise stakeholders, uncovering pain points and business requirements.
  • Create and deliver powerful, customized product demonstrations and presentations in Italian and English that resonate with technical, business and partner audiences.
  • Design and recommend solutions tailored to customer needs, articulating the capabilities and value proposition of NiCE Cognigy.
  • Run and support POCs/POVs that prove value in real enterprise environments.
  • Be a visible voice for NiCE Cognigy in the market, representing us through thought leadership at customer events, webinars, trade shows and marketing activities to build awareness in Italy.
  • Stay ahead of the competitive landscape and deliver credible technical comparisons against other AI Agent and agentic AI platforms active in the Italian market.
  • Collaborate with product and other internal teams to feed back customer requirements and deliver internal enablement.

Have you got what it takes?

  • Senior Presales / Sales Engineering Expertise: A tenured track record in presales, sales engineering, or solution consulting, ideally managing complex enterprise deals end to end.
  • Market-Building Mindset: Adaptable and entrepreneurial, with a proven ability to open or develop a new market, work independently, and step in wherever the need is to achieve tangible results.
  • Enterprise Software Proficiency: Deep background in the enterprise software space, particularly contact center (CCaaS) or automation technologies.
  • AI Agents & Generative AI Experience: Hands-on experience presenting AI Agents, agentic AI, conversational and generative AI technologies.
  • AI-Native Way of Working: You actively use LLMs and AI tools in your daily work to move faster and build better. Whether it’s agentic coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, AI app builders like v0, Lovable or Replit Agent, or general assistants like Claude and ChatGPT, you know how to put these tools to work: “vibe coding” tailored demo environments, prototyping integrations, and accelerating POCs that wow customers.

  • Contact Center Knowledge: Understanding of contact center technology (SIP, SBCs, ACD, ASR, TTS, etc.) and experience with conversation, IVR or chatbot design.
  • Thought Leadership & Presence: A confident, engaging presenter comfortable on stage at customer and industry events.
  • Technical Depth: Strong grasp of NLU/NLP, conversational AI technologies, and related software, including UI/UX.
  • Sales Acumen: Able to translate complex technology into clear business value and build rapport with senior enterprise stakeholders.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and cross-functional collaboration. Fluent in Italian and English; additional languages such as Spanish, German or others are a plus.

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. Backed by global CX leader NiCE, we empower brands with AI Agents that redefine customer experiences and achieve measurable ROI—instantly, across every channel and in 100+ languages.

raw.description:
SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER, MOBILE APPS (CONTRACT)

Location: Remote, 6-month contract

Hours: 40 hrs/week, available for synchronous collaboration between 14:00-19:00 UTC

Summary

Wikimedia is looking for an experienced product manager (contract) for the Mobile Apps team in our Product department. The Product department builds the wiki experiences that enable our communities to achieve our vision: a world in which every single human being can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. This is an opportunity to have a tremendous impact with one of the most beloved parts of the internet.

Wikipedia is one of the most popular media properties in the world, visited by over 1 billion people a month across over 300 different languages. All this knowledge is created and managed by more than 200,000 volunteer editors. The Wikipedia mobile apps are a fast and fun way to read Wikipedia. The Wikipedia apps for Android and iOS are ad-free and available in more than 300 languages. They are the best place to be a fan of Wikipedia and to learning.

As a product manager with the Mobile Apps team (contract), you will work with engineers, designers, community members, other product managers, and our volunteer community to deliver on the reader strategy, with a focus on improving the experience of our most committed app users. This is a contract position to cover a parental leave January through the end of July. Candidates must be available for critical meetings and synchronous work between 14:00-19:00 UTC. This role will report to the Readers Group Product Manager.

About this role

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will personally write the requirements, file tasks, create measurement plans, and provide community updates for your workstreams, and you will own each step from ideation through release, analysis and reporting.

Because this role covers a leave, the product manager who normally leads the App Growth team will not be available for day-to-day guidance for most of the contract. We’re looking for someone self-directed and entrepreneurial: someone who ramps up quickly, takes an ambiguous problem, scopes it into something the team can ship in a matter of weeks, and makes sound decisions without waiting to be told. You will have a strong cross-functional team, a lot of documentation for context, and a manager to escalate to, but you should expect to pull together data, research and documentation to set your own direction within the team’s OKRs and established roadmap.

Success in this role is measured by what ships and what we learn from it.

You are responsible for:

  • Leading the product development process from ideation and discovery in a defined project area, through scoping, requirements, release and analysis, for features that convert web readers to retained app readers, and sustained app donors, within the guardrails of our OKRs, roadmap and strategic direction.
  • Scoping work realistically: breaking ambitious ideas into MVPs and phased releases that fit team capacity and the contract timeline, and making trade-offs explicit.
  • Writing clear, complete kick off decks, requirements and user stories in Phabricator that engineers, designers and other various stakeholders can build from without repeated clarification.
  • Setting success metrics: defining hypotheses and measurement plans with the data analyst before work enters development, then using quantitative and qualitative methods to evaluate impact.
  • Experimenting, releasing, and iterating intentionally to provide incremental value rapidly and validate hypotheses.
  • Coordinating with the Group PM in collaboration with the Communications, Marketing, and Legal functions to execute high-profile projects.
  • Collaborating with fellow apps product managers to stay aligned on higher-level strategic priorities, identify, and execute the direction of the apps team while honoring apps team culture
  • Owning the information for your workstreams: keeping decisions, notes, and open questions documented in a single source of truth, and surfacing risks, blockers, and changes in direction early.
  • Producing and updating community-facing documentation, and holding conversations with volunteer communities to gather feedback on projects and ideas, collaboratively adapting plans when needed.

Skills and experience:

  • 3+ years of experience managing user-facing products in a mobile first environment, working on Android or iOS applications
  • A track record of personally scoping and shipping features end to end in large-scale consumer apps. Be ready to walk us through specific features you scoped, wrote requirements for, launched, and measured
  • A hands-on, self-directed working style: you are comfortable doing the detailed work yourself and moving projects forward with limited oversight
  • Strong organization and documentation habits: you take thorough notes, build on context from earlier conversations, and keep a single source of truth for your projects
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams
  • Success making decisions in fast-changing and ambiguous situations
  • Experience working in an agile or iterative software development environment
  • Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Strong listening skills
  • Ability to clearly communicate plans and results to stakeholders and collaborators verbally and in written form
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in relevant work experience
  • A desire to make meaningful contributions to knowledge equity, free culture, and open access

Additionally, we’d love it if you had:

  • Experience with a two-sided platform or marketplace product
  • Experience with personalization features
  • Comfort using AI prototyping or “vibe coding” tools to explore ideas and create rough prototypes or wireframes
  • Experience with push notifications, re-engagement, or other mobile growth features
  • Proficiency with data, reporting, analytics, or A/B testing
  • Experience building products that support positive user habits, engagement, or ongoing value creation over time
  • Experience with fully remote, geographically distributed, and asynchronous teams
  • Experience working with communities, volunteers, or open source projects
  • Experience editing Wikipedia or contributing to other wiki projects
  • Experience with users in emerging markets, such as the Middle East, Africa, South Asia, or Latin America
  • Fluency in a language other than English

Expected deliverables

By the end of the contract, we expect you to have delivered the following App Growth initiatives:

  • Fun space in mobile apps with initial features in partnership with Marketing
  • Based on an A/B/C test, scope and launch a new game in the app
  • Overhaul reader Notifications in the app
  • Scope and release a consent flow for donors to sync their status with their account
  • Bring support for semantic queries at scale to the apps and improve search discovery and functionality in the mobile app
  • Scope and release at least two new reader focused features from our new feature backlog not including the ones named above
  • Scope and release at least one donor retaining experiment in partnership with Fundraising
  • Scope and release at least one web feature Integration that bring engaged readers from Wikipedia on mobile web to the apps in partnership with product marketing
  • Kick off and narrative decks, measurement plans agreed with the data analyst, public project pages, Phabricator epics and user story tasks, as well as project close out decks for every project you are responsible for
  • Weekly progress updates in Asana, regular MediaWiki project page updates, and a running log of product decisions made and why
  • Handoff documentation covering outcomes, learnings, open questions, and next steps for all work in progress

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries*. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$111,974 to US$172,826 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:
US States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)

Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (*citizens/permanent residents only)

We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.

All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.

If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or +1 (415) 839-6885.

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer who’s equal parts problem-solver, translator, and customer hero. You’ll be the go-to person when customers hit snags with Chainguard Images, digging into technical mysteries, keeping folks informed, and partnering with Engineering to squash bugs before they cause chaos. This isn’t just “reset the password and move on” support: you’ll work on real, complex issues with modern tools (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub, Helm charts, Terraform, etc.), make customers feel like superheroes themselves, and help shape how Chainguard delivers world-class support. Serious work, fun team, big impact.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the frontline agent: Triage, investigate, manage, and annihilate complex customer issues involving Chainguard Images.
  • Escalate wisely: Engage the Engineering team when things get spicy.
  • Communicate like a pro: Keep customers (and your SLAs) happy, informed, and impressed.
  • Bridge the tech lingo divide: Explain things clearly to both code whisperers and non-tech humans.
  • Document like a librarian: Create detailed write-ups of new issues and throw helpful Knowledge Base nuggets into the mix.
  • Channel your inner detective: Prioritize your own queue, drive clarity in communication, and proactively guide issues to resolution.
  • Speak up smartly: Push bugs, feature requests, and hidden gremlins up to Engineering and GTM teams.
  • Learn, teach, repeat: Seek new challenges, share wisdom, and maybe teach someone your favorite GitHub ninja trick.
  • Be there when it counts: Participate in an on-call rotation for after-hours, weekend, and holiday support.

What we're looking for:

  • You’ve spent 3+ years supporting enterprise customers with a confident, calm approach.
  • 2+ years under your belt with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes. You dream in containers.
  • You deliver top-tier customer experiences with stellar written and verbal communication.
  • You're a cross-functional harmony maker supporting teams across Engineering, Customer Success, and more.
  • You're comfortable in the DevOps warzone: CI/CD, Linux, GitHub, Helm Charts, Terraform, Open source and all the good stuff.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; AWS EKS experience is a plus.
  • Extra kudos if you’ve flirted with security frameworks, software supply chain security, or vulnerability scanning.
  • Extra kudos if you bring CKA, CKAD, CKS or KCSA certs and aspire to be a future Kubestronaut.
  • Startup experience? Even better. You’ve navigated fast lanes before.
  • A curious soul who learns faster than a caffeinated squirrel.
  • You hold a bachelor’s degree (STEM preferred) or have equivalent battle scars from the real world.

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Our Company

PharMerica

Overview

At BrightSpring Health Services, you’ll play an important role in bringing talented individuals into an organization where their work truly matters. You’ll build meaningful relationships, partner with leaders across the business, and help connect great people with opportunities where they can grow, contribute, and make a difference.

We’re looking for a Recruiter who is driven, personable, creative, and passionate about finding the right talent for the right opportunity. You’ll be part of a collaborative team that values partnership, innovation, and results, while having the opportunity to grow your own career along the way.

If you’re energized by people, motivated by making a great match, and ready to be part of a mission-driven organization, come grow with BrightSpring Health Services.

Responsibilities

  • Daily duties include facilitating the full cycle recruiting process: posting job advertisements; sourcing talent, interviewing, screening and presenting potential candidates to hiring managers; following up with candidates and hiring managers; job offer development and negotiations; conducting employment and reference checks; and various other recruiting activities.
  • Establish effective relationships with internal business partners, internal employees applying for positions and external candidates.
  • Monitor recruiting-related data in the applicant tracking system (ATS), track metrics, and respond to data inquiries with accuracy and a sense of urgency.
  • Maintain sourcing and referral network with operations and external resources.
  • Provide weekly and monthly reporting of recruitment activities.
  • Deliver a high-touch candidate experience and customer focus.
  • Provide consultative, problem-solving support for challenging staffing needs.
  • Proactively develop and maintain candidate slates for current and future positions.
  • Utilize established digital talent communities to develop talent pipeline.
  • Leverage social media to promote job postings and proactively source candidates.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert around applicant tracking system, candidate sourcing methodologies and recruitment process effectiveness.
  • Consistently demonstrate the highest level of ethical behavior & personal integrity.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 2 Years of private sector recruiting or staffing agency experience preferred
  • Travel 0-25%

About our Line of Business

PharMerica, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, delivers personalized pharmacy care through dedicated local teams, serving health care providers such as skilled nursing facilities, senior living communities, and hospitals. We also cater to individuals with behavioral needs, infusion therapy needs, seniors receiving in-home care, and patients with cancer. Operating long-term care, home infusion, and specialty pharmacies across the nation, we combine the personal touch of a neighborhood pharmacy with the resources of a national network. Our comprehensive solutions, backed by industry-leading technology and regulatory expertise, ensure accurate medication access, cost control, and compliance with best-in-class clinical standards. We are committed to enhancing resident health, reducing staff burdens, and supporting our clients' success. For more information, visit www.pharmerica.com. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.

raw.excerpt: Department:MarketingLocation:Home based, UK (with occasional travel to our London office) Reports to:Editor-in-Chief Hours:37.
raw.description:
Department:Marketing

Location:Home based, UK (with occasional travel to our London office)

Reports to:Editor-in-Chief

Hours:37.5 per week

Salary:(Depending on experience)

A quick note before you apply: This role is strictly UK-based and must be performed entirely within the United Kingdom; we do not employ remote staff overseas, nor do we offer relocation support. Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK prior to commencing employment. While we hold a sponsor licence, visa sponsorship is only considered in exceptional circumstances and is not available as standard for this vacancy.

Role Overview

You'll lead Cambridge Spark's video and audio production — hands-on with the edit, and owning the oversight and quality of everything that goes out: thought leadership content, client and learner impact stories, event highlights, long-form interview content and the short, fast-turnaround cuts that drive our social channels every week. We'll work with agencies and freelance crews for filming, specialist production and our biggest projects. You'll do some of the filming yourself, and lead the edit on what follows, turning one shoot into a client story, a set of social cuts, a long-form interview edit and an event highlight — all built with best-in-class visual and motion storytelling.

You'll also manage the agencies and freelancers we use for bigger productions, own the production process end to end — brief, schedule, edit, sign-off — and work closely with editorial, marketing, sales and senior stakeholders to turn their ideas into finished content on time. And you'll set the studio up: the kit, the workflows and the templates that let the wider team record and edit simple content themselves with AI tools. It's a hands-on making role with room to shape a new function.

Key responsibilities:

  • Edit and finish our thought leadership films, client and learner case studies, and long-form interview content, including cuts for social
  • Capture and edit our flagship events, and turn them into content that brings the experience to people who weren't in the room
  • Cut long-form footage into many short, fast-turnaround pieces for LinkedIn, the website, newsletters and sales
  • Film smaller pieces yourself, from studio interviews to vox pops at events
  • Manage our production agencies and freelance crews end to end — briefing, scheduling, quality control and budgets on bigger shoots
  • Own the production process from brief to delivery, working closely with stakeholders across editorial, marketing and sales
  • Set up and look after the in-house kit and a well-organised footage library
  • Build templates and simple workflows so the team can make their own content with AI tools
  • Track how video and audio perform, and use it to shape the next round

Candidate Specification:

Essential

  • Five or more years editing video and audio professionally, in-house, at an agency or production company
  • A showreel that shows strong visual and motion storytelling across long-form and fast-turnaround social content
  • AI-native and fluent in professional video and audio editing tools — the specific suite matters less than speed and judgement (think Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Audition or Descript) — and able to turn that fluency into templates and workflows the wider team can use themselves
  • Experience managing production agencies or freelance crews, and running a production process from brief through to delivery
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI video and audio tools, and good judgement about when they help
  • Agility and a great eye — able to move fast across several projects and deadlines, and spot the shot or cut that will actually land
  • Strong collaboration skills, comfortable briefing stakeholders across editorial, marketing and sales and pushing back when a brief isn't clear

Desirable

  • Camera and sound skills for small shoots
  • Motion graphics and captioning
  • Experience producing for a B2B audience, on LinkedIn or at live events
  • An interest in AI and how it's changing work

Company Benefits:

  • Pension with 4% matched contributions, opportunity to opt into salary sacrifice scheme
  • 25 days holiday + Flexi bank holidays + 1 day off on your birthday
  • A day for volunteering
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • Health & Wellbeing allowance of up to £30 per month
  • Annual Summer and Xmas events
  • Company socials including everything from Cambridge College formals, pub nights to team building events
  • CPD Allowance alongside quarterly reflections to ring fence time for development and growth
  • Private medical insurance and cash plan
  • Holiday buy back scheme (up to 10 days p/a)
  • Employee Assistance Programme with a dedicated company counsellor


Background to our Organisation

We are an education technology company that enables corporate and government organisations to achieve their business goals by educating their workforce with critical digital transformation skills to succeed in the AI era.

We deliver unique and innovative professional education that is accelerating the digital transformation of our clients, advancing the careers of their employees, helping people get into work and closing the digital skills gap. We are in a sector that is crucial to the economy and workforce, with a lot of opportunity for change and innovation. We are at the cutting edge of teaching applied data and digital skills, with our unique patented learning platform EDUKATE.AI offering our clients and learners a unique learning experience. EDUKATE.AI was developed with support from Innovate UK and provides all of our learners with 24/7 immediate feedback on their work, helping accelerate the learning process and providing a sandbox environment to experiment on real world datasets.

Since 2016, we have supported more than 15,000 learners across four continents with nearly 550,000 pieces of code submitted for feedback on EDUKATE.AI. We are trusted by some of the most recognisable brands in the world to educate their workforce, including Microsoft, the NHS, GSK, easyJet, the BBC and John Lewis. Our focus on applied learning to create business impact sets us apart - individual learners have reported applying their skills at work to generate recorded value of up to £40m.

Our Values

At the centre of the way we work together and inspire each other to achieve success are these core values:

Entrepreneurial

We take initiative and show entrepreneurial spirit which fuels innovation at Cambridge Spark. This includes identifying opportunities for improvement, taking ownership for implementing solutions effectively and driving improvement by using proof of concepts to demonstrate the feasibility and value of their work.

Team Spirit

Everyone is part of building an open and transparent culture, communicating effectively to raise issues, discuss improvements and share the evidence used to make decisions.

Customer-focused

Our customers are at the centre of everything we do, inspiring us to create great work. We strive to build friendly, professional and lasting relationships with them to better understand and anticipate their needs.

Gold Standard

We are experts in our field and are constantly developing our technology and offering. We set the benchmark in our industry: both in what we offer customers and in how we deliver it.

Cambridge Spark is an Equal Opportunities Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. Cambridge Spark is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunities for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Cambridge Spark are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, colour or ethnicity, ability or disability, gender or gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Cambridge Spark will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Cambridge Spark encourages applicants of all ages.

raw.description:
Moodle with us!

We're the world's most popular learning platform, and we’re on a mission to empower educators and learners worldwide with open, flexible, and innovative digital learning solutions. As the world’s most customisable and trusted open-source LMS, we partner with schools, universities, and organisations to create better learning experiences for millions. If you’re ready to make a real impact, and be part of a global movement shaping the future of learning, join us. Let's transform education together!

About the role..

Are you passionate about technology, already building things in your career as a developer? We’re looking for a motivated and curious Developer with 2 to 3 years of experience to join our Platform Solutions team. The team builds, improves and maintains Moodle LMS, the open-source platform all of Moodle’s products are built on. You’ll work on the core LMS alongside experienced developers, and your changes go through Moodle’s open contribution process.

We're building a team that works with AI, not around it. If you've been teaching yourself to build with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or the OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and you can show us what you've made, we want to hear from you. It matters far more to us what you've built than where (or whether) you studied.

This is a fully remote role and can be offered as a permanent role in India, Indonesia, Vietnam or the Philippines.

At Moodle, no two days will ever be the same, but will involve a mix of:

  • Collaborating with experienced developers on designing, developing, and implementing software solutions.
  • Using AI coding agents as part of your everyday workflow: scoping the task, writing a clear spec or prompt, then reviewing, testing and refining what comes back.
  • Writing clean, well-tested PHP and JavaScript, and being able to explain and defend every line of it, whether you or an agent wrote it first.
  • Building small automations and internal tools that make the wider team faster.
  • Participating in code reviews, learning best practices and improving code quality.
  • Contributing to the full software development lifecycle from concept to deployment and maintenance.
  • Learning new technologies and tools while solving real-world problems.
  • Contributing to projects that impact millions of users globally.

What we’re looking for..

  • Experience with or knowledge of PHP and JavaScript.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development tools (for example Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or agents you've built yourself with an LLM API). Self-taught absolutely counts: side projects, hackathons, open-source contributions and things you built for fun are all evidence.
  • Working understanding of how to get good results from these tools: giving an agent the right context, breaking work into verifiable steps, and knowing when the output is wrong.
  • Judgement about where AI helps and where it doesn't, and a healthy scepticism about code you didn't reason through yourself.
  • Passion for problem-solving, keen attention to detail and an eagerness to keep learning.
  • An approachable, collaborative way of working in a global team.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: increasingly, being a strong developer means being able to describe a problem precisely, to people and to machines.

Nice to have, not required: familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), retrieval-augmented generation, prompt/context engineering, agent evaluation or testing, or having published a tool, plugin or agent of your own.

You don't need a certification or a formal AI qualification for this role. A GitHub repo, a demo video or a blog post explaining something you built will tell us more than any course certificate.

What life at Moodle is like..

Moodle has a globally diverse team with over 280 team members in more than 25 countries around the world. We’ve built a passionate team of hard-working, driven and diverse people from all over the world, united by a shared belief in the ability of our platform to make a positive difference in our world. We respect our colleagues and value an open and innovative workplace filled with integrity and of course a strong focus on education (yes, these are our company values!)

In addition, you can expect:

  • A genuinely flexible, remote role, working from anywhere in India, Indonesia, Vietnam or the Philippines.
  • We believe in motivating performance rather than micromanaging it, empowering you to do what you do best.
  • Gaining new skills by learning from highly skilled peers, along with your own learning and development allowance each year to support your growth.
  • Work with a global team on a worldwide platform and make a real difference.
  • As a certified B Corp, we are proud to be part of a global community of mission-driven companies dedicated to using business as a force for good.
  • Other excellent benefits, like an extra time-off to recharge yourself, give back to a charity or community group, and enjoy a day off for your birthday, ‘choose your own’ benefit options, flexible public holidays, and many more!

Learn more about your new workplace..

Moodle is the world’s most trusted online learning solution, with a growing ecosystem of products and services, including Moodle Workplace, Moodle App, MoodleCloud, and more. The engine of our ecosystem is Moodle LMS, the secure and customisable open-source learning management platform used by well over 300million learners worldwide.

Find out more about us on our website and careers page

Does all this sound good? If so:

  • Click on the following link to apply.
  • Add your resume and a link to something you’ve built.
  • Press send.

raw.description:
Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Team

The Solutions Architecture team partners with Stripe’s users to design and build transformative solutions that unlock growth, modernize business models, and shape the future of commerce. We work with executives, product leaders, and engineering teams at the world’s largest and most innovative companies, helping them translate ambitious strategies into scalable solutions on Stripe.

Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture serves Stripe’s most complex and consequential users. The team combines deep technical expertise, commercial judgment, and customer empathy to solve problems that often have no established playbook. Its work not only helps individual users grow; it also surfaces emerging needs and opportunities that can inform Stripe’s product strategy and create value for users at global scale. These Solution Architects are deeply embedded in these users and are working along as their technical co-founders.

The Head of Strategic Accounts, Solutions Architecture will lead a team of senior architects who are trusted partners to strategic, key, and major accounts. This leader will set the vision for the team, develop exceptional technical talent, and work closely with account leadership to deepen and grow Stripe’s most important relationships. They will also build a strong partnership with Product and Engineering, turning insights from leading-edge customer engagements into the next wave of innovation across Stripe.

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between executive conversations, account strategy, architecture reviews, product discussions, and direct support for the team’s most complex engagements. They will be AI-enabled in how they lead and operate, highly curious about new technologies and business models, and committed to helping their team and Stripe continuously raise the bar.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities

  • Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture, aligning the team’s priorities with Stripe’s user, product, and business objectives.
  • Recruit, lead, coach, and retain a world-class team of senior Solutions Architects supporting Stripe’s strategic, key, and major accounts.
  • Partner with account leaders to develop and execute technical account strategies that deepen customer relationships, unlock new use cases, and drive durable growth.
  • Lead from the front in the team’s most complex and high-impact engagements, including architecture workshops, executive briefings, solution design, technical evaluations, and critical escalations.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders at the world’s largest and most innovative companies.
  • Build a close, durable partnership with Stripe Product and Engineering teams; synthesize patterns from strategic accounts, influence product priorities, and help translate customer needs into scalable capabilities for all Stripe users.
  • Create mechanisms for senior architects to share technical insights, reusable patterns, and field learnings across Stripe.
  • Establish a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, accountability, experimentation, and continuous learning.
  • Champion AI-enabled ways of working across the team, using AI to improve insight generation, solution development, team productivity, and the quality and speed of customer outcomes.
  • Develop talent through clear expectations, thoughtful coaching, meaningful feedback, and opportunities for architects to expand their technical, commercial, and leadership impact.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management, Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to deliver cohesive outcomes for users.
  • Build processes and metrics that measure the team’s impact on customer outcomes, account growth, product influence, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Anticipate changes in technology, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and industry structure, and translate those signals into action for the team and Stripe.
  • Represent Stripe in executive forums, customer business reviews, industry events, and other strategic engagements.

Minimum Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or comparable customer-facing architecture teams aligned to strategic, key, or major accounts.
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and leading senior technical talent in a complex, high-growth environment.
  • Deep technical fluency and the ability to remain hands-on—quickly understanding architectures, APIs, data flows, integration patterns, security and reliability considerations, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior customer executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders on complex, business-critical initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success connecting technical strategy to account growth, customer outcomes, and long-term partnerships.
  • Strong experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmaps, shape requirements, and turn customer insights into scalable product innovation.
  • An AI-enabled approach to leadership and problem-solving, with practical experience using AI tools to increase the quality, speed, or scale of work.
  • Exceptional curiosity and learning agility, including a strong desire to explore new technologies, business models, and ways of working.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and business topics clear to audiences at every level.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to lead through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and make high-quality decisions in fast-moving environments.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to align stakeholders across Sales, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to engage with strategic customers and collaborate with internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with payments, financial infrastructure, fintech space

POS-34020

HubSpot is a rapidly growing publicly traded technology company that has organically grown revenue from just under $100 million at the time of our IPO in 2014 to over to $3 billion in 2026.

With top-line revenue growth and an increase in the absolute dollar value of expenditures expected for years to come, we are looking to hire a Global Category Specialist to assist our new Procure to Pay team in building out a global procurement strategy and function that will scale with the growth of the Company.

The Global Category Specialist (Hub 4) supports the execution of HubSpot’s global procurement operations by owning defined procurement workflows and applying sound judgment to routine and moderate-complexity work. This role partners closely with cross‑functional stakeholders to manage contract intake, vendor review, and purchase execution while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery. The Global Category Specialist operates with growing autonomy, manages competing priorities, and builds the skills and judgment needed to take on increasingly complex procurement responsibilities over time.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Intake, Execution & Lifecycle Management

  • Owns contract intake and tracking for assigned categories, managing contracts from intake through red lining, execution, renewal, and publication.
  • Manages and maintains contract documentation, metadata, and audit readiness within Ironclad, Chamelio or the designated CLM tool.
  • Prepares contract change notices, monitors end dates, and supports renewal workflows to ensure continuity of services.
  • Executes purchase order processing and related procurement activities in alignment with established policies and procedures.
  • Ability to redline contracts to ensure alignment with company policy and negotiate redlines with vendors based on local policies and regional requirements.

Risk, Compliance & Vendor Review Support

  • Monitors vendor risk management queues in Omnea, ensuring assessments are completed accurately and within established service levels.
  • Collects, reviews, and organizes third‑party risk documentation in partnership with Legal, Security, Privacy, and Compliance teams.
  • Supports risk mitigation activities and vendor performance reviews, escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Ensures contracts and procurement activities adhere to internal policies and applicable regulations.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

  • Partners with internal stakeholders across IT, Legal, Security, Privacy, Finance, and other teams to coordinate contract reviews and procurement requests.
  • Serves as a primary point of contact for vendor‑related questions within assigned workflows, responding in a timely and professional manner.
  • Communicates clearly with global stakeholders and vendors, accounting for differences in regions, currencies, and business needs.

Procurement Operations & Process Improvement

  • Manages day‑to‑day execution of assigned purchase orders, prioritizing work to meet deadlines and service‑level expectations.
  • Identifies process inefficiencies and participates in the development and implementation of process improvements.
  • Supports vendor onboarding activities by coordinating required documentation, guiding vendors through procurement systems, and ensuring accurate setup in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Maintains accurate files and audit controls in accordance with compliance requirements.
  • Serves as a subject matter resource for procurement processes and system functionality in tools such as Omnea, Ironclad, (Chamelio or the designated CLM tool), Coupa, Zylo, and related P2P platforms.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, contract management, or a related operational role, preferably within a high‑growth or multinational organization.
  • Working knowledge of contract lifecycle management and global procurement operations.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Experience using procurement and P2P systems such as Omnea, Coupa, Chamelio (CLM), DocuSign, NetSuite, Dynamics-365, and Workday.
  • Familiarity with purchasing IT hardware, software, SaaS licensing, and professional services.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, evolving environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills and a collaborative working style.
  • Demonstrated accountability for execution quality, timeliness, and stakeholder experience.
  • Experience working with AI tools, rapid adaptability in reporting using AI tools, and experience building artifacts.
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to managing competing priorities and driving tasks autonomously.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.
