raw.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

Dotmatics is seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our team working on ground-breaking Scientific Software products such as Luma. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to help improve our processes, infrastructure and security by applying best practices with the latest technologies. You will be AI fluent and know how AI influences engineering and DevOps

In this role you will get to:

  • Design and manage CI/CD and deployment pipelines for both AWS-native and Kubernetes-based applications
  • Provide advice/assistance to the product teams, clarifying requirements for deployment
  • Collaborate with product teams on cloud and container best practices
  • Manage IT infrastructure in cloud computing environments
  • Automation: Use CI tools to automate code changes, builds, testing, and analysis
  • Monitoring: Monitor performance after release
  • Develop and improve monitoring systems for automated alerts
  • Strategy: Design and manage the DevOps infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
  • SECURITY: Embed security into every stage of the delivery lifecycle (DevSecOps), including automated SAST, DAST, dependency, secrets, and container image scanning in CI/CD pipelines
  • SECURITY: Implement and enforce least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, encryption in transit and at rest, and secrets management (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, KMS)
  • SECURITY: Harden Kubernetes clusters and cloud environments using policy-as-code, admission controls, runtime protection, and CIS/NIST benchmarks
  • SECURITY: Support vulnerability management, incident response, audit readiness, and compliance efforts (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001)
  • AI: Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate pipeline development, infrastructure code, troubleshooting, and incident analysis
  • AI: Apply AI/ML-driven capabilities to monitoring, including anomaly detection, alert noise reduction, and automated root-cause analysis
  • AI: Build and operate deployment pipelines and infrastructure for AI/ML and LLM-based workloads, including model serving, GPU-enabled clusters, and cost controls
  • AI: Establish guardrails for responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data privacy, access controls, and review of AI-generated code and configuration

We are looking for people who have 8+ years of experience maintaining high-traffic applications and complex technical infrastructure. You will be someone with a proven background in supporting cloud environments, with hands-on experience translating AWS Well-Architected principles into action.

The key skills we are looking for:

  • Kubernetes clusters/customer cloud environments
  • AWS (ECS, EKS, ALB, EC2, S3, RDS, CloudFront, Route53, etc.)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • CI/CD tools (Octopus Deploy, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, TeamCity, CodePipeline, etc.)
  • APMs and logging (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, ELK, App Insights)
  • Networking concepts in cloud environments
  • Software development lifecycle processes/version control
  • Security: DevSecOps practices, AWS security services (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF, Config, KMS), container and supply chain security (image signing, SBOMs), and security scanning tools (e.g. Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov)

raw.description:
Preparedness today, safer tomorrow.

Emergent is a leading public health company that delivers protective and life-saving solutions to

communities around the world.

We go where others won’t, taking on some of the biggest public health challenges to protect and enhance millions of lives, and create a better, more secure world. Here, you will join passionate professionals who advance their scientific, technical and professional skills to develop products designed to protect and enhance life.

Why This Role Matters

At Emergent, our work protects communities and strengthens global health security. As Head of IT Infrastructure & Operations, you will lead the organization’s global technology infrastructure and end-user services.

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Senior Director, Head of IT Infrastructure & Operations leads the strategy, engineering, security, reliability, and day-to-day operation of the company’s global technology infrastructure and end-user services. The role is accountable for resilient, secure, compliant, and cost-effective delivery across hybrid cloud, data centers, networks, compute, storage, workplace technology, service management, collaboration, and infrastructure platforms supporting a global 24/7 business and regulated operations. The position modernizes the infrastructure operating model through automation, observability, data-driven service management, and responsible use of AI, while maintaining disciplined lifecycle, continuity, validation, and vendor governance.

What You'll Do

Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Enterprise leadership and strategy

  • Serve as a member of the CIO’s IT Leadership Team and act as the executive owner for enterprise infrastructure and operations capabilities.
  • Define and execute a multi-year infrastructure and operations strategy, architecture, investment roadmap, lifecycle plan, and operating model aligned to business priorities, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data strategy, and application modernization.
  • Translate technology choices into clear business outcomes, risks, service commitments, investment requirements, and decision points for senior leaders.
  • Bring an infrastructure, integration, resiliency, and operability perspective to enterprise programs, acquisitions, site changes, and major technology initiatives.

Hybrid cloud, platforms, and architecture

  • Lead a fit-for-purpose hybrid cloud strategy spanning public cloud, SaaS, private hosting, and on-premises environments; establish standards for landing zones, connectivity, identity integration, workload placement, scalability, portability, and cost governance.
  • Own infrastructure architecture and engineering standards for networks, compute, storage, backup, recovery, databases and middleware where assigned, collaboration, telephony, endpoint and workplace platforms, and core operational tooling.
  • Partner with application, data, security, quality, and business teams to ensure platforms are interoperable, supportable, validated where required, and designed for availability, performance, recoverability, and lifecycle sustainability.
  • Establish technology currency and technical-debt practices that reduce unsupported platforms, single points of failure, and avoid operational risk.

Operational excellence, service management, and employee experience

  • Lead global 24/7 infrastructure operations, service desk, workplace services, major incident management, problem management, change enablement, configuration and asset practices, capacity management, and service continuity.
  • Establish service catalogs, service ownership, service level objectives and agreements, operational level agreements, KPIs, experience measures, and executive reporting that connect service performance to business impact.
  • Build mature monitoring, observability, event management, and command-center practices to identify degradation early, accelerate restoration, and drive permanent corrective action.
  • Continuously improve employee technology experience across offices, laboratories, manufacturing and distribution environments, remote work, and executive support.

Cyber resilience, continuity, and compliance

  • Partner with the Chief Information Security Officer and Quality organization to embed secure-by-design, zero-trust, privileged-access, vulnerability, patching, hardening, segmentation, backup protection, recovery, and logging requirements into infrastructure services.
  • Own infrastructure disaster recovery and technology continuity capabilities, including business-aligned recovery objectives, dependency mapping, crisis response integration, documented recovery procedures, and regular exercises.
  • Ensure infrastructure services meet applicable company policies and regulated-life-sciences requirements, including controlled change, documentation, qualification or validation, data integrity, audit readiness, and evidence retention where required.
  • Ensure operational risks, exceptions, and control gaps are visible, assigned, prioritized, and remediated or formally accepted.

Automation, AI-enabled operations, and data

  • Develop an automation-first operating model using infrastructure as code, orchestration, self-service, policy as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment and recovery patterns.
  • Adopt AI-enabled operations responsibly to improve event correlation, knowledge retrieval, service desk support, capacity forecasting, anomaly detection, and operational decision support, with appropriate human oversight, security, privacy, records, and compliance controls.
  • Create trusted operational data and dashboards that enable trend analysis, predictive insight, cost transparency, risk prioritization, and measurable continual improvement.
  • Build workforce capability in cloud, automation, AI, cybersecurity, service reliability, and modern engineering practices.

Financial, supplier, and talent leadership

  • Own infrastructure and operations financial planning, forecasting, cloud financial management, contract optimization, and investment prioritization.
  • Lead strategic sourcing activities, including RFPs, RFIs, SOWs, contract and service-level negotiations, supplier performance, concentration risk, exit planning, and third-party resilience.
  • Lead, develop, and retain a diverse global team; clarify accountabilities, succession, cross-training, on-call expectations, and skills plans across employees, managed service providers, and specialist partners.
  • Create a culture of ownership, disciplined execution, transparency, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.

The above statements describe the general nature of work performed in this job. They are not an exhaustive list of duties, and other duties may be assigned.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Advanced degree is preferred.
  • Typically 15+ years of progressive technology experience, including 7+ years leading multiple infrastructure, operations, engineering, or service delivery teams in a complex global enterprise.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide infrastructure transformation and operating-model change in a highly regulated environment; life-sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated accountability for global, business-critical, 24/7 services delivered through a mix of internal teams, public cloud, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, colocation, telecommunications, managed services, and outsourcing partners.

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Executive leadership, business acumen, financial stewardship, and the ability to communicate complex technology choices as business value, risk, resilience, cost, and employee impact.
  • Deep working knowledge of hybrid cloud, enterprise networking, compute, storage, backup and recovery, identity dependencies, endpoint and workplace technology, collaboration, telephony, monitoring, observability, and service management.
  • Experience with modern engineering and operations practices, including automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, APIs, DevSecOps, site reliability concepts, capacity engineering, and technology lifecycle management.
  • Ability to establish metrics and use operational, experience, risk, and financial data to prioritize work and demonstrate outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity infrastructure controls and close partnership with security teams on zero trust, segmentation, vulnerability and patch management, privileged access, secure configuration, logging, resilience, and incident response.
  • Experience designing, testing, and improving business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities across complex application and infrastructure dependencies.
  • Knowledge of cGMP expectations and experience supporting validated or qualified technology in regulated life-sciences environments, including change control, documentation, data integrity, and audit readiness.
  • Experience governing AI-enabled operational use cases with appropriate controls for security, privacy, compliance, transparency, reliability, and human oversight.
  • Proven ability to lead in a matrixed environment, build coalitions, influence executives, negotiate with suppliers, and manage competing priorities during incidents and transformation.
  • Strong talent leadership, coaching, succession planning, organizational design, sourcing strategy, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive influencing skills.

Preferred Knowledge and Credentials

  • Familiarity with ITIL practices and modern service management; relevant ITIL certification is preferred.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture and financial management practices; relevant cloud or FinOps credentials are preferred.
  • Familiarity with recognized cybersecurity, resilience, and control frameworks used by the company.
  • Experience supporting ERP, laboratory, manufacturing, quality, and data platforms with demanding availability, integration, and compliance requirements.

Ready To Make an Impact?

If you’re an IT Infrastructure Leader ready to bring your expertise and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join a mission-driven organization where your insights will support decisions that protect and enhance lives around the world. Apply today and help us build a safer, healthier future.

Contract Clinical Recruiter (Nurse Practitioner Recruitment)

Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Full-Time Contract (1099) | 40 Hours per Week
Contract Duration: 90 Days, with Potential to Extend
Compensation: $60 / hour on a 1099 basis

About Midi Health

Midi Health is transforming healthcare for women in midlife. As a rapidly growing virtual care company, we're expanding access to expert, evidence-based care for women navigating perimenopause, menopause, and beyond.

We're looking for an experienced, results-driven Contract Clinical Recruiter who can hit the ground running and help us attract and hire exceptional Nurse Practitioners (NPs) nationwide.

This is a high-volume, fast-paced recruiting role for someone who thrives in an agency-style environment, knows how to find hard-to-reach talent, and can deliver results with minimal ramp-up time.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct approximately 20–30 Zoom video interviews per week.

  • Deliver an expected 3 NP hires per week.

  • Own full-cycle recruitment for Nurse Practitioner positions, from sourcing and outreach through offer acceptance.

  • Proactively source, engage, and attract highly qualified NP candidates in competitive markets.

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies and overcome recruiting obstacles to consistently deliver top talent.

  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines while managing multiple priorities and requisitions.

  • Partner closely with recruiting teammates and clinical leadership to meet hiring goals.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records, pipeline activity, and recruiting workflows in Greenhouse.

  • Quickly learn Midi's clinical hiring requirements, processes, and expectations to contribute with minimal ramp-up time.

Required Qualifications

All requirements below must be met to be considered.

  • Agency Recruiting Experience: Minimum 2 years of agency recruiting experience, including agency recruiting experience within the past 2 years.

  • Nurse Practitioner Recruitment: Minimum 3 years of direct NP recruiting experience, with demonstrated success sourcing, attracting, and hiring qualified NP talent.

  • Proactive Sourcing: Proven ability to independently source candidates, navigate challenging markets, overcome recruiting obstacles, and attract top NP talent.

  • Greenhouse: Hands-on experience using Greenhouse ATS is required.

  • High-Volume Recruiting: Demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume interview schedule and consistently meet aggressive hiring targets.

  • Rapid Ramp-Up: Ability to work independently, learn quickly, and deliver results with minimal training or oversight.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Polished, professional, and personable, with the ability to build strong relationships with candidates and internal partners.

Preferred Qualification

  • Experience using Gem for candidate sourcing and engagement.

Contract Duration & Schedule Expectations

This is a 90-day contract opportunity with the potential to extend based on business needs and performance.

  • 40 hours per week are required. This is not a part-time opportunity.

  • Working hours are flexible, but contractors must be available during standard U.S. business hours for meetings, team collaboration, and recruiting activities.

  • Must be able to accommodate candidate interview availability.

  • Must be able to manage a consistent schedule of 20–30 Zoom video interviews per week.

  • Must be prepared for a rapid ramp-up and immediate contribution toward weekly hiring goals.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means quickly becoming a trusted, productive member of our recruiting team, building strong NP pipelines, and consistently delivering approximately 3 hires per week.

We're looking for someone who brings the urgency and resourcefulness of an agency recruiter, the expertise of a seasoned NP recruiter, and the professionalism and collaboration needed to succeed in a growing healthcare organization.

If you're an experienced clinical recruiter who loves the challenge of finding exceptional talent and delivering results, we'd love to hear from you.

Are you a natural relationship builder who knows how to turn conversations into business opportunities?

Do you enjoy connecting with decision-makers, opening doors to new partnerships, and closing deals?

Smart Suites is growing beyond Brisbane, and we're looking for a driven Business Development Manager to help take us there!

This is your opportunity to play a key role in expanding an Australian hospitality business by building relationships with real estate agents, engaging landlords, and securing new properties across Australia.

We are looking for someone who can do more than sell. We need a proactive dealmaker who can build trust, spot opportunities, negotiate confidently, and keep the pipeline moving.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build new partnerships: Connect with real estate agents, property managers, and landlords across Australia to develop leasing opportunities.
  • Drive business growth: Identify new markets, proactively source suitable properties, and establish relationships in expansion areas.
  • Pitch and negotiate: Confidently explain our leasing model, handle objections, and progress discussions toward signed agreements.
  • Manage your pipeline: Own the sales process from prospecting and initial contact through negotiation, follow-up, and deal conversion.
  • Collaborate with the team: Support lease discussions, coordinate property assessments, and help turn opportunities into secured properties.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, real estate, leasing, or related commercial roles.
  • Proven ability to generate leads, develop business relationships, negotiate, and close deals.
  • Excellent English communication skills, with confidence speaking to Australian clients and decision-makers.
  • Strong cold calling, prospecting, presentation, and objection-handling skills.
  • Highly organized with experience managing sales pipelines and CRM systems.
  • Commercially minded, resourceful, and comfortable handling challenging conversations.
  • Self-motivated, persistent, and able to deliver results with minimal supervision.

You'll Have an Advantage If You Have:

  • Experience in Australian real estate, property management, or residential leasing.
  • Knowledge of Australian property markets and leasing practices.
  • Experience developing new territories or business partnerships.
  • A background in hospitality, serviced accommodation, or short-term rentals.

A bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value proven sales performance and relevant experience.

What's In It for You?

  • Competitive compensation: AUD 2,000–2,400 per month (negotiable based on experience).
  • Work from anywhere in the Philippines: Enjoy a fully remote setup.
  • International exposure: Work directly with an established and growing Australian hospitality business.
  • Make a real impact: Help drive expansion into new Australian markets and see the results of your efforts.
  • Ownership and autonomy: Manage your pipeline, develop partnerships, and take initiative.
  • Growth-oriented team: Work with driven professionals who value innovation, accountability, and collaboration.

About Smart Suites

Smart Suites is a growing Australian accommodation business managing 100+ short-term rental properties across Brisbane, Queensland.

We combine hospitality, technology, and efficient operations to create comfortable, thoughtfully managed stays.

Now, we're setting our sights on new markets across Australia, and we're building the team to make it happen.

Engagement Details

  • Work Arrangement: 100% Remote (Philippines)
  • Engagement Type: Independent Contractor
  • Schedule: Full-time, 5 days per week, aligned with Australian business requirements
  • Monthly Rate: AUD 2,000–2,400 (all-inclusive, negotiable)

Ready to Build Something Bigger?

If you're a confident communicator, a natural networker, and a results-driven sales professional who enjoys turning opportunities into successful deals, we want to hear from you!

Apply now and help Smart Suites unlock its next stage of growth across Australia.

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule
  • Opportunities for promotion
  • Work from home

Work Location: Remote

Chief Program Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Program Officer (CPO) is responsible for overseeing the organization's strategic programs, enterprise-wide initiatives, and complex, multi-project portfolios across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that major programs are strategically aligned, properly resourced, effectively governed, and successfully delivered within approved timelines and budgets. The CPO will establish program management standards, coordinate cross-functional teams, manage interdependent projects, and ensure that strategic initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team, the CPO will translate corporate priorities into coordinated programs that support business growth, operational excellence, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and organizational development.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Management

  • Develop and implement the organization's enterprise-wide program management strategy.
  • Identify, structure, prioritize, and oversee strategic programs aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Translate organizational strategies into coordinated programs with clear goals, milestones, deliverables, and expected outcomes.
  • Manage interdependencies between projects, business units, and strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with organizational priorities.

Insurance & Investment Program Delivery

  • Lead strategic programs involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee programs related to insurance product development, underwriting modernization, claims transformation, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Coordinate investment-related programs involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Manage initiatives involving regulatory changes, new business models, market expansion, and operational restructuring.
  • Ensure program deliverables address business requirements and relevant industry regulations.

Program Governance & Management Office

  • Establish and oversee program governance frameworks, methodologies, policies, and reporting standards.
  • Develop program charters, business cases, implementation plans, risk registers, and performance dashboards.
  • Implement structured review processes, approval mechanisms, escalation procedures, and executive reporting.
  • Ensure consistency in program management practices across subsidiaries and business units.
  • Work with the Project Management Office (PMO) to coordinate individual project delivery and maintain portfolio visibility.

Program Budget & Resource Management

  • Develop and oversee program budgets, resource plans, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor program expenditure, financial performance, and budget variations.
  • Ensure effective allocation of people, technology, and financial resources across programs.
  • Evaluate program business cases, cost-benefit analysis, expected returns, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Digital & Business Transformation Programs

  • Lead cross-functional programs involving digital transformation, automation, AI, cloud adoption, and enterprise system modernization.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, CRM systems, and investment service technologies.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leaders to ensure technology programs deliver business value.
  • Oversee business process redesign, operational improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify, assess, and manage program-level operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure programs comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish mitigation strategies, contingency plans, and escalation mechanisms.
  • Monitor program quality and ensure deliverables meet approved standards.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to define program priorities.
  • Coordinate communication and collaboration among project sponsors, program managers, and key stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with regulators, external consultants, strategic partners, and implementation vendors, as appropriate.
  • Resolve conflicts involving program scope, resource allocation, timelines, and competing business priorities.
  • Present program progress, financial performance, key risks, and strategic recommendations to senior management.

Leadership & Program Management Excellence

  • Lead and develop program directors, program managers, project managers, and program delivery teams.
  • Build a high-performing program management function with clear accountability and performance standards.
  • Establish training, mentoring, and professional development initiatives.
  • Promote consistent program management methodologies and continuous improvement.
  • Introduce tools and reporting systems to improve program visibility, coordination, and delivery effectiveness.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Program Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in program management, project portfolio management, enterprise transformation, or strategic initiative delivery.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing large-scale, multi-project programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs with measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of program governance, project management methodologies, budgeting, risk management, and resource planning.
  • Experience establishing or leading enterprise program management offices.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Excellent leadership, strategic planning, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic programs delivered on time and within budget.
  • Program performance against approved strategic objectives.
  • Achievement of program milestones and deliverables.
  • Program budget variance and resource utilization.
  • Benefits realization and return on investment (ROI).
  • Effective management of project interdependencies.
  • Program risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive reporting quality.
  • Compliance with program governance and reporting standards.
  • Successful delivery of digital, operational, and business transformation programs.

Communications & Adoption Specialist – Federal Health IT

Location: Remote (United States)
Personnel Vetting: Federal background investigation eligibility required

Keep Healthcare Technology Users Informed and Ready for Change

Rackner is seeking a Communications & Adoption Specialist to help healthcare professionals navigate changes to the systems they rely on. This role supports federal health IT operations by delivering clear, timely information about releases, service interruptions, and available resources.

You'll coordinate user updates, maintain digital information channels, and develop targeted outreach that strengthens awareness and adoption. Working with technical, operational, and clinical stakeholders, you'll also gather feedback and help ensure published guidance is accurate and appropriately reviewed.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and schedule release communications aligned with approved technology release calendars, ensuring users receive timely and consistent information about upcoming changes.
  • Prepare weekly updates and recurring communications that keep healthcare technology users informed about service developments, available resources, and adoption activities.
  • Manage and maintain content across designated adoption portals, SharePoint environments, and enterprise collaboration channels to ensure information remains current and accessible.
  • Draft downtime notifications, urgent service announcements, and other time-sensitive communications in accordance with established notification requirements and lead times.
  • Maintain organized archives of published communications and notices to support audit readiness and applicable recordkeeping requirements.
  • Design and administer user surveys to measure service satisfaction, user trust, and feedback related to technology adoption and service improvements.
  • Develop targeted communication campaigns using approved product guidance, coordinating appropriate clinical review and validation before distributing applicable content.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in communications or change management within an IT or healthcare program.
  • Hands-on experience managing content in SharePoint or relevant Microsoft 365 collaboration environments.
  • Experience designing surveys to collect user feedback, satisfaction, or related service information.
  • Must be eligible to undergo the federal background investigation required for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prosci certification or a comparable change management certification.
  • Experience supporting communications initiatives within federal healthcare technology environments.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, you'll join a team focused on delivering practical technology solutions for important federal missions. We value professionals who combine subject-matter expertise with collaborative problem-solving and a commitment to continuous improvement.

You'll have the opportunity to make complex technology changes easier to understand, collaborate across operational and clinical disciplines, and help healthcare professionals stay informed as the systems they use evolve.

Benefits & Perks

Rackner offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support professional development, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Depending on eligibility, benefits include:

  • Company-supported professional certifications and career development opportunities
  • 401(k) retirement plan with 100% company matching up to 6%
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement
  • Weekly pay and company team events

Work Arrangement

This is a remote position based in the United States.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
About the role

Chime is building a world-class Member Services organization, and the quality of that experience starts long before a member ever reaches an agent. It starts with how well that agent was trained. We're creating this role to raise the bar on two things at once: how consistently training gets delivered across our partner network, and how accountable our BPO partners are for delivering it well. As our Sr. Training Lead, you'll own training governance for Operations and Member Experience, spend real time in the classroom at our vendor sites training new hire agents yourself, and hold our partners' training teams to a higher standard than they've been held to before.

This is a new role on our Learning, Training, and Content Operations team. It's remote, with approximately 30% domestic and international travel to our BPO partner sites.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Own training execution across our lines of business, ensuring BPO trainers are facilitating our programs and content as expected, that agents are receiving the support they need during new hire training, that agents are completing training on time, and provide feedback to the Learning team about opportunities.
  • Guide a group of BPO master trainer contractors to drive training excellence with BPO training teams.
  • Travel to our partner sites roughly 30-40% of the time and train in the room, facilitating new hire classes, delivering Train-the-Trainer ahead of site launches and major releases, and co-facilitating alongside BPO trainers so you see delivery quality firsthand instead of reading about it.
  • Own trainer effectiveness at our BPOs end to end, including trainer certification and recertification, training lead calibration, a real observation and coaching cadence, and the decision about who is cleared to teach a Chime class.
  • Hold our BPO partners accountable for training delivery the way a vendor manager would: build the scorecard, run the governance cadence with partner training leadership, bring the data to business reviews, and drive corrective action plans when a site misses.
  • Measure what matters, using graduation rates (overall and on-time), nesting performance, speed to proficiency, trainer certification rates, and early-tenure quality and performance to find where delivery is breaking down and fix it.
  • Partner closely with Learning, Content, Quality, Workforce Management, Partner Operations, and LOB Operations so that launches land on time and agents are ready on day one.
  • Diagnose the gaps in how we train today and partner to rebuild the standard, bringing a point of view on what good looks like rather than waiting for it to be defined for you.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 7+ years in training, learning, or talent development within a contact center, BPO, or other high-volume service environment, including hands-on facilitation of new hire classes for frontline agents. You are still comfortable in front of a room.
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or BPO partners and holding them accountable for outcomes, including building performance metrics, governance frameworks, scorecards, and corrective action mechanisms. You've had the hard conversation with a vendor and kept the relationship.
  • Experience building training governance from the ground up: certification and train-the-trainer programs, facilitation standards, observation and coaching models, and the documentation that makes them hold up over time and under audit.
  • Strong coaching skills with other trainers, and the judgment to tell the difference between a content problem, a facilitation problem, and an operations problem.
  • Comfort with data, with the ability to evaluate program effectiveness, identify trends across sites and vendors, and translate what you find into business requirements and decisions.
  • The ability to influence without authority across internal stakeholders and external partners at every level, from a trainer on the floor to a partner's site leadership.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 30-40% of the time. Experience in financial services, fintech, or another regulated environment is a plus.

Below is the base salary offered for this role and level of experience. Full-time employees may also be eligible for bonus(es), competitive equity, and benefits. For commissioned roles, the base salary listed in this job description does not include incentive/variable pay. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Wage Notice
$130,000—$180,000 USD

A little about us

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.

We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.

We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.

We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.

Because if we don't—who will?

*Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.

What we offer for our full-time, regular employees

  • 🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
  • 💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
  • ✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
  • 🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
  • 🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
  • 👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
  • 👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
  • 👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
  • 💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress

We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.

Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. raw.title: Principal Product Manager, Protection Programs
raw.excerpt: At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone.
raw.description:
At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role

Evolve’s Protection Programs help protect homeowners, guests, and Evolve from the unexpected. Programs such as damage protection, travel insurance, and chargeback insurance can reduce financial risk and give customers greater confidence throughout a reservation.

These programs sit at the intersection of product experience, commercial performance, and operational risk. Their success depends on more than a well-designed user flow: the right coverage, pricing, eligibility, partner economics, distribution, claims experience, and operational processes all need to work together. Evolve is looking for a product leader who can shape this portfolio as a durable business while making protection simple and valuable for customers.

As Principal Product Manager, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for Protection Programs end to end. You’ll identify where protection can create value for customers and Evolve, build and optimize program economics with Commercial and partner teams, and lead cross-functional delivery with Design, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders.

What you’ll do

  • Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Protection Programs, connecting customer value, risk reduction, and sustainable business performance.
  • Build a deep understanding of homeowners, guests, internal teams, and insurance or protection partners; identify where protection addresses meaningful needs across the reservation lifecycle.
  • Develop a portfolio strategy across offerings such as damage protection, travel insurance, and chargeback insurance, including where to invest, expand, refine, or retire programs.
  • Own the commercial model for programs in partnership with Commercial, Finance, and external partners. Evaluate pricing, conversion, coverage, partner economics, claims costs, and operational expense to improve sustainable contribution.
  • Identify and validate growth opportunities, including customer segments, distribution moments, packaging, pricing, and partner capabilities; translate them into clear business cases and measurable product bets.
  • Improve the end-to-end experience, from understanding and selecting protection through purchase, servicing, cancellation, and claim, while making coverage terms, eligibility, and customer expectations clear.
  • Partner with Commercial and go-to-market teams on positioning, packaging, channel strategy, and enablement so programs are compelling, accurately represented, and easy to sell or adopt.
  • Work with Operations, Claims, Support, Legal, Compliance, and partners to make program rules and service processes reliable, scalable, and aligned with applicable requirements.
  • Use customer research and data to monitor performance across awareness, attach or adoption, conversion, retention, loss and claims trends, customer satisfaction, and unit economics; adjust the roadmap as evidence changes.
  • Lead cross-functional work through discovery, business case, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration, aligning teams around outcomes, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Make clear choices across customer experience, commercial return, risk exposure, and operational complexity; communicate tradeoffs to senior stakeholders.
  • Represent the voice of customers and the health of the Protection Programs portfolio in product decisions and help the organization build a shared understanding of both.

What makes you a great fit

  • Minimum 10 years of product management experience, including 0-to-1 product buildouts and ownership of strategy and delivery for complex products or product areas.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience owning or materially shaping a product’s business model. You can evaluate revenue, margin or contribution, pricing, adoption, partner economics, and cost-to-serve alongside customer outcomes.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous opportunities into focused strategies, business cases, roadmaps, and measurable results.
  • Experience building products that involve financial risk, insurance, payments, lending, warranties, fraud or disputes, or other regulated or partner-dependent services; direct insurance experience is a plus.
  • Ability to connect product decisions to go-to-market execution, including customer segmentation, positioning, packaging, distribution, and sales or channel enablement.
  • Strong customer discovery skills and the ability to balance customer needs with business viability, risk controls, partner requirements, and operational realities.
  • Experience working closely with external partners and internal teams such as Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Support, Design, and Engineering.
  • Comfort using product and financial data to set success measures, assess program performance, understand unit economics, and make evidence-based investment decisions.
  • The judgment to balance near-term performance with long-term customer trust, clear coverage expectations, and scalable program operations.
  • Comfort working closely with Engineering on technical tradeoffs, system constraints, integrations, and sequencing.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to align senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams around decisions and outcomes.
  • An AI builder mindset with a pragmatic approach to using AI tools, LLMs, and agents. You can rapidly prototype solutions, validate hypotheses, and address core customer needs, partnering closely with Engineering to transition proven concepts into scalable production features.
  • Experience in insurance, fintech, travel, e-commerce, property technology, vacation rentals, or other consumer or B2B2C businesses is a plus.

Compensation

For this role, our salary range is $170K to $205K, depending on relevant experience. The role is also eligible for a variable annual bonus based on company and individual performance.

Location

All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. If you live in Colorado, you can work remotely anywhere in the state, at our downtown Denver office, or a hybrid of both! If you're planning to move soon, please let us know, and we'll be happy to review your application again.

California Applicant Privacy Policy | Evolve

How we reward Evolvers

We’re intentional about offering benefits that empower every Evolver to thrive both professionally and personally because they’re more than perks—they’re investments in our customer-obsessed, high-performing team.

We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. Whether it’s helping you take care of your health, plan for the future, or celebrate life’s milestones, our offerings are designed to support you every step of the way.

  • Financial Wellness: Industry-competitive pay, equity in the company, and a 401(k) with a 4% immediate vesting match.
  • Family Support: 16-18 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 10 weeks for non-birthing parents, plus infertility coverage.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, with 100% employer-paid dental and vision for individual coverage, a low-cost medical option, 10 free mental health visits, and pet insurance.
  • Time to Recharge: Generous PTO, RTO (for full-time exempt employees), sick leave, holidays, and a personal holiday to celebrate what matters most to you.
  • Travel Perks: Annual Evolve travel credit after one year and discounts on stays at all Evolve properties.
  • Growth Opportunities: World-class onboarding programs, learning, and development resources to help you grow your impact.
  • Connection: Employee Resource Groups celebrating our diverse communities at Evolve.

How we work together

With our core values as our guide, every Evolver helps shape the company we want to work for and the people we want to be. We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, care, and responsibility that we can all be proud of, and we’re excited to see what you’ll bring as your authentic self.

Still curious about who we are and what we do? Read more about our business and our culture at .

EEO

At Evolve, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military service or veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Evolve participates in e-Verify for all positions.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please let your recruiter know.

The Sr Solution Sales Executive Data & Analytics - State and Local Government (SSE) is a sales role built for experienced data and analytics sellers who have the curiosity, confidence, and technical acumen to transform a customer’s business through AI, Data and Analytics. You will play a pivotal role in shaping ServiceNow’s D&A business and work on exciting and transformational use cases with Data & Analytics to deliver Insight to Action on the ServiceNow AI Platform. People who excel at this job can lead discovery sessions, leverage value-based selling, and deliver measurable business outcomes through customer specific priorities and use cases. The SSE has the technical fluency to present, demo, and provide customers with the confidence to invest in ServiceNow D&A solutions.

What you get to do in this role

  • Lead end-to-end D&A sales cycles as a co-prime with the core account executive, from opportunity creation through close and ongoing adoption.
  • Own and sell the full D&A portfolio (Workflow Data Fabric, RaptorDB Pro, Data Apps, and Autonomous Data Analytics) across your assigned accounts.
  • Develop strategic D&A account plans to position ServiceNow D&A solutions as foundational to a customer’s AI, real-time analytics, and data strategy with a focus on new business with existing ServiceNow customers.
  • Lead discovery, value-based conversations, technical presentations, and demos with data, analytics, and AI leaders to uncover priorities, pain points, and accelerate AI ready data modernization initiatives.
  • Develop relationships with customer technology and data executives, including those at the Chief Data and Analytics Officer (CDAO) level, as well as leaders in data engineering, data governance, and analytics, in addition to the ServiceNow platform owner and CIO, to increase awareness and influence.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of field sales experience with an emphasis on D&A sales, or AI-adjacent solutions preferred.
  • Technical fluency in AI, Data and Analytics, to be able to present, demo and lead credible discovery, value positioning, and use case identification with executives, ServiceNow platform owners, and Data and Analytics leaders.
  • Experience selling analytics or BI (such as Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Power BI, Qlik, or Oracle Analytics) or credible depth in modern data platforms, cloud data warehousing, data integration, data management and governance.
  • Experience selling Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Palantir, Salesforce Data 360, Informatica, or Boomi, as well as a strong understanding of the broader data market, is an advantage
  • Experience with consumption-based models and driving growth after the first sale.
  • Experience with the ServiceNow ecosystem, platform, use cases and target buyers is a huge plus
  • A self-starter mindset, hands-on, thought leader that is comfortable operating in a fast paced matrixed, product, sales, and GTM environment.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

  • People Focus: Unite with the best global talent in life sciences, empowered to grow and collaborate in a vibrant environment.

  • Anniversary bonus program: Receive substantial bonuses on special work anniversaries (5, 10, 15 years)

  • Truly Global: Join a truly global organization where mutual support, teamwork, and diversity drive our collective success.

Empowering Global Talent in Life Sciences Transformation

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

This role will be based in Tokyo, Japan remotely and be able to travel to Yamagata upon the client’s requests. We are looking for a potential candidate who can lead the workstream at the client's side as well as large projects in the near future.

At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.

As we are still in the exciting early stages of building our presence in Japan, joining Fusion means you won’t just be another consultant - you will be an initiating member helping shape our Japan growth story locally. You will have the opportunity to work on projects with truly global clients, where diverse perspectives and cross-border collaboration are the norm. You will be acting as the bridge between the global English-speaking business and potentially Japanese speaking local operations. With this comes a high level of accountability and ownership, empowering you to directly influence outcomes and see the tangible impact of your work.

  • Documentation & Turnover: Ensure commissioning evidence, issue status, turnover documents, and operator training support a reliable handover.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Coordinate delivery partners and internal teams; communicate readiness, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.

About the Role

raw.excerpt: Who We Are:Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We're seeking a Senior Business Architect (Canada) for ACCC: someone who can go deep on brokerage operations across accounts, trading, clearing, settlement, custody, and asset servicing, and can turn that operating knowledge into clear requirements and turn that into clear requirements Product and Engineering can build.

You are the bridge between how the Canadian brokerage actually works and the product roadmap. You lead structured discovery with counterparts and work out how partner firms, account opening, clearing, custody, and day-to-day operations fit together, then write that down as epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and open decisions.

Success is measured by: requirements and designs teams can build without guessing; a clear split between what the system does and what people still do at launch; solution options that Product and Engineering can sequence; and a backlog tied to ACCC milestones and capabilities.

What You'll Walk Into

You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:

  • Operations scope: defining what ACCC must support across accounts, trading, clearing, settlement, custody, books and records, and asset servicing.
  • Partner firm handoffs: what partners send us, what we send back, and who does what across accounts, trades, cash, and securities.
  • Account and trade lifecycle: account opening, settlement in Canada through CDS, failed trades, transfers, and corporate actions such as dividends and splits.
  • Platform gap analysis: comparing today's Alpaca platform with Canadian brokerage operations requirements to decide what we reuse, change, or build.
  • Launch scope: separating what must work on day one from what follows, including registered accounts (TFSA, RRSP, RESP), more products, and more partner services.
  • Open decisions: logging each one with an owner so it gets closed or consciously deferred.

What you’ll own

Requirements across ACCC’s brokerage operations, and what comes next:

  • Map brokerage operations end to end across these areas: broker onboarding, account carrying, trade clearing/settlement, custody of cash/securities, books & records, financing (if in scope), corporate actions, transfers, exceptions, and reporting
  • Help define target operating models and capability designs: what the platform must do, what stays manual (for now), what is control vs. feature, what is Canada-specific vs. reusable globally
  • Turn regulatory and operational obligations into product requirements: what the platform must do, what stays manual (for now), what is control vs. feature, what is Canada-specific vs. reusable globally
  • Write epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that Product and Engineering can build against.
  • Produce the artifacts teams actually use: process maps, capability matrices, requirement specs, data/field definitions, state machines, exception catalogs, RACI for build vs. run, and decision logs
  • Work with Product Managers and Engineering to sequence MVP → launch → scale: must-haves for go-live vs. post-launch backlog across these operating areas (e.g. additional account types, asset classes, IB services, automation)
  • Interface across Product, Engineering, Ops, and Compliance: translate business need into buildable scope; escalate open decisions with clear owners and options
  • Run structured discovery: workshops, SME interviews, gap analysis vs. current Alpaca platform, peer operating models where useful
  • Keep requirements automation- and AI-aware: flag where STP, rules, and AI-assisted exception handling should be designed in—not bolted on later
  • Flag where straight-through processing, rules, and AI-assisted exception handling should be designed from the start.
  • Maintain a living requirements backlog tied to ACCC milestones, risks, and open decisions

Who you are (Must-Haves)

  • Excited about what Alpaca is building and about standing up Canadian brokerage operations.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior IC reporting to the President — driving clarity across Product, Engineering, Ops, and Compliance without needing a formal team.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.
  • 8+ years as a business architect, business analyst, consultant or in product operations within brokerage, clearing, custody, or capital markets.
  • Comfortable translating brokerage operating processes and regulatory requirements into product language (you don’t need to be a lawyer or CCO)
  • Strong structured analysis: flows, entities, states, exceptions, controls, and what breaks if a step is missing.
  • Clear writing: specs, diagrams, and decisions others can execute against.
  • Collaborative with Ops SMEs, PMs, Engineering, and Compliance; curious enough to dig; disciplined enough to close loops
  • Bias to precision over vague “requirements fluff”; you know when something is a product change vs. an ops procedure vs. a policy decision
  • Judgment to tell a product change from an operating procedure or a policy decision.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across operations, product, engineering, and compliance.

Who you might be (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Experience on a carrying, self-clearing, or custody build.
  • Canadian dealer, carrying broker, or introducing broker experience.
  • Prior business architecture or enterprise/solution architecture exposure in capital markets
  • Familiarity with CDS or Canadian settlement workflows.
  • Experience with registered accounts or Canadian tax requirements (TFSA, RRSP, RESP).
  • Background with API or platform brokerage products.
  • Experience working at a fintech, startup, or greenfield launch.
  • AI-native workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT in spec drafting, discovery synthesis, and gap analysis.
  • Experience shaping greenfield capability roadmaps with executive sponsors

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

This is a fully remote 6 month contract-to-permanent opportunity with one of Arctiq's clients. Candidates must be able to work permanent for any US employer and located in one of these states: AZ; CA; CO; CT; DC; FL; IL; IN; MA; MD; ME; NH; NJ; NY; PA; TN; TX; UT; VA; VT.

We are hiring a Senior Systems Engineer to take the lead on engineering, administering, and continually refining our client's enterprise Systems and Compute environment. Your focus will be keeping the infrastructure reliable, secure, and efficient, and spotting ways to modernize, automate, and upgrade the overall technology environment.

Day to day, you'll collaborate with the Manager of Systems and other technology groups to make sure infrastructure solutions fit business requirements, enterprise architecture, and operational standards. We need someone who pairs hands-on technical depth with sharp problem-solving and real experience running complex enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage the foundational systems: Exchange, physical and virtual servers, Active Directory and Group Policy, Certificate Services, authentication platforms, and the compute, networking, storage, and remote access/mobility services that go with them.
  • Provide administration and support for cloud-based platforms and services, including Microsoft Azure and Office 365.
  • Oversee and administer Citrix VDI, load balancers, and SSL certificate management.
  • Track, maintain, and fine-tune system performance so the environment stays reliable, scalable, and secure.
  • Handle routine, scheduled, and long-term maintenance as well as user-facing service work, keeping operational standards consistently high.
  • Act as the expert-level escalation contact for difficult technical problems.
  • Write and keep current detailed technical documentation covering processes, procedures, troubleshooting guides, training materials, and change management records.
  • Share in the on-call rotation, covering after-hours support as required.
  • Be ready for occasional overtime, off-hours work, or travel when projects and operations call for it. Make sure integrations are secure, efficient, and in line with enterprise architecture and governance standards.
  • Put security best practices into action and help meet relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements, in partnership with the Information Security, Applications, and Infrastructure teams.
  • Work alongside appropriate cross-functional technology teams on risk assessments and on strategies to lower exposure to security vulnerabilities.
  • Keep records of data flows, API endpoints, schemas, and integration logic.
  • Help evaluate, select, implement, and improve integration platforms.
  • Back efforts to ensure data quality, integrity, and reconciliation between systems.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years as a Systems Engineer, with Microsoft Server experience in enterprise settings.
  • 10+ years of designing, building, securing, and managing virtualized environments on the VMware stack (ESXi, vCenter).
  • Hands-on experience building and securing Hyperconverged Infrastructure (Nutanix, Dell VxRail, HPE).
  • Experience managing and administering Citrix VDI, load balancers, and SSL certificate management.
  • Experience with mail and messaging services in Exchange Online.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure and Entra ID.
  • Familiarity with enterprise storage across block (SCSI/NVMe), file (CIFS/NFS), and object (S3) types.
  • Experience with enterprise backup and recovery platforms (Rubrik, Cohesity, Veeam).
  • Proven capability to run enterprise-wide systems and compute infrastructure while juggling several infrastructure components at the same time.
  • Expert command of Microsoft Windows enterprise environments, including Active Directory, M365, and PKI design, support, and administration.
  • Advanced understanding of VMware, Windows Server, TCP/IP, DNS, and related protocols.
  • Strong grasp of network design and management (LAN/WAN, MPLS, VPN, VLAN, Wi-Fi).
  • Solid working knowledge of encryption technologies, along with cybersecurity risk reduction and system hardening practices.
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting ability for system utilities, automation, and administration.
  • Skilled with monitoring platforms (SolarWinds, LogicMonitor, Splunk, Aria)

Education

  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, computer information systems, or a related discipline is preferred, and an advanced degree is a plus.

Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.
