Avante is the enterprise AI platform for benefits teams. Benefits is one of the most complex, high-stakes functions in any company, and Avante’s purpose-built agents take on end-to-end benefits work, from checking vendor contracts against claims to preparing leadership reports to helping employees use and understand their benefits. Samsung Semiconductor, Real Chemistry, Zscaler and News Corp use Avante today to keep costs in check, support employees across the globe, and get more from their benefits investment.

The Role

You'll own the full deal, from first conversation through signature, and land new logos like Calix, Personify, Datavant, and Real Chemistry. Deals run $50K to $150K in ACV, move faster than enterprise, and involve smaller buying groups: typically a Head of Benefits or Total Rewards as champion, an HR or finance executive as economic buyer, and an IT or security reviewer.

Your hardest job is explaining how Avante differs from the ben admin platform, the decision support tool, and the point solutions buyers already own. Avante replaces none of them. It's the intelligence layer that connects them. Most of your pipeline will be direct, and when a broker or consultant is in the deal, you'll work alongside them without losing the buyer relationship.

This role reports to the Director of Sales. We're hiring someone 3–6 years into a quota-carrying career who is ready to own a full patch and a full cycle, with a path toward larger accounts as Avante scales.

What You'll Do

  • Own a named mid-market patch end-to-end. Build the territory plan, prioritize accounts, run the cycles, and close the business.
  • Generate your own pipeline. Work with Sales Development on outbound, and run your own research, outreach, and follow-up on your patch.
  • Run a fast, focused cycle. Move from discovery to demo to proposal with a mutual plan and dates the buyer agrees to. Identify the champion, economic buyer, and security reviewer early.
  • Sell the closed-loop story. Teach buyers what benefits intelligence is, why the loop between Carly and Ava matters, and why purpose-built agents beat generic AI bolted onto legacy systems.
  • Run sharp demos and proofs of value. Partner with Sales Engineering to get customers live in about 30 days.
  • Forecast with discipline. Keep a clean pipeline, use MEDDPICC or equivalent scaled to deal size, and bring risks forward early.
  • Use AI daily. Research accounts, draft outbound, prep meetings, and turn call transcripts into next steps with tools like Claude and Granola. If you're a traditional AE who occasionally tries ChatGPT, this isn't the right seat.
  • Adapt as we grow. Your patch, playbook, and deal size will evolve, and you should welcome that.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6 years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience, with at least 2 years closing new-logo deals at $50K+ ACV
  • A track record of hitting or exceeding quota while managing many concurrent opportunities
  • Experience building your own pipeline through outbound prospecting
  • Experience selling to HR, Benefits, or Finance buyers, with the presence to engage a Head of Benefits or a CFO
  • Comfort selling a new type of product where you have to teach the buyer what it is first
  • Active, hands-on use of AI in your selling motion
  • A methodical approach to pipeline, forecast, and qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent)

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling into benefits, HR tech, or healthcare to self-funded employers
  • Experience selling AI-native or data-intensive platforms
  • Relationships with benefits leaders or the brokers and consultants who advise mid-market employers
  • Early-stage startup experience helping build the playbook

What We Offer

The compensation for this role is $250,000-$300,000 OTE. Where you land in that range depends on your experience, your skills, and how well your background fits what the role needs.

We also offer:

  • Equity: Stock options, so you share in what we’re building
  • Health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision, with employee premiums covered by Avante
  • Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to rest and recharge, plus paid company holidays
  • Retirement: 401(k)
  • Commuter benefit: $150/month toward however you prefer to get to work

Avante is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome candidates of all backgrounds.

How We Work

Our four values aren't aspirational. They translate into concrete operating tenets that shape how we make decisions every day.

Beat Yesterday. We re-evaluate our own toolkit every quarter, because the workflows that made you effective three months ago may already be outdated. We act on 70% of the information rather than waiting for certainty. We timebox, execute, and iterate, getting work in front of real people quickly instead of polishing in isolation. And we own our output regardless of how we produced it. AI can get you 80% of the way there. Everything that goes out with your name on it is your responsibility to review, refine, and stand behind.

Embrace Type 2 Fun. We take on hard problems and find meaning in the work, even when it's uncomfortable. We assume good intent and follow up directly rather than venting in side channels. We celebrate wins loudly and specifically, naming the actual behavior so the whole team learns what great looks like. We are on by default, because we owe it to each other and to our customers to be available beyond what a regular corporate job would demand. And we do unscalable things today that build scalable advantages tomorrow: every hand-built account play and late-night proposal turnaround earns us the right to scale later.

Stay Hungry, Stay Curious. We expect everyone to be the expert on AI in their function before anyone asks them to be. The landscape changes weekly. When you learn something, teach it. Learn enough about adjacent functions to ask good questions. Ask the question you think is too basic, because in complex domains like benefits, the cost of a wrong assumption can be a lost account. And remember: curiosity without urgency is a hobby. Learning has to translate into action on a timeline that matches the opportunity.

Act Like an Owner. We say the uncomfortable thing early, raising missed commitments or quality gaps directly with the person within 48 hours. We surface problems when they're small, not the week they become a crisis. Customer-facing work gets priority, always. And we close the loop every time, because over-communication is a feature at our stage, not a bug.

raw.description:
Technical Consultant plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System data migrations. The responsibilities of an data migration consultant, as outlined, involve various aspects of data migration, data management, automation, and collaboration with clients and source application data provider teams.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Lead end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects involving migration of safety data from legacy safety systems databases into target safety systems.
  • Perform source system assessment, data profiling, gap analysis, and migration impact assessments to define migration strategies and project deliverables.
  • Analyze and convert PostgreSQL databases, schemas, tables, views, indexes, sequences, functions, triggers, and stored procedures into Oracle Database/Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB) while ensuring data integrity and optimal performance.
  • Design and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, transformation rules, migration specifications, and data conversion documentation.
  • Develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), reconciliation, validation, and migration reporting activities.
  • Perform data extraction, cleansing, standardization, transformation, and loading activities while ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Execute database schema conversion and optimize migrated database objects for Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
  • Conduct comprehensive data validation and reconciliation between source and target systems to verify successful migration of all pharmacovigilance data.
  • Support migration of safety entities including Cases, Products, Events, Licenses, Studies, Regulatory Reports, Literature, Users, Workflow Data, Attachments, and Configuration Data.
  • Develop and execute migration validation plans, reconciliation reports, exception reports, and post-migration verification activities.
  • Participate and support in migration testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Testing, and Production Validation.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve migration issues related to data quality, database conversion, mapping discrepancies, application configurations, and system integrations.
  • Develop and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports and validation reports to support migration verification and operational reporting.
  • Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Business Analysts, Database Administrators, Validation Teams, and Oracle Support throughout migration projects.
  • Support system integrations between Oracle Argus Safety and external applications using APIs, web services, and interface technologies.
  • Ensure migrated data and system configurations comply with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA, ICH E2B(R3), GAMP 5, and organizational validation standards.
  • Prepare and maintain migration documentation including Migration Plans, Data Mapping Specifications, Validation Documents, Technical Design Documents, SOPs, and Migration Summary Reports.
  • Support Oracle Argus upgrades, cloud migrations, and database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
  • Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance on migration methodologies, database conversion techniques, and Oracle Argus best practices.
  • Recommend automation opportunities and continuous improvements to enhance migration efficiency, quality, and compliance.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Strong expertise in PostgreSQL database administration and development.
  • Hands-on experience converting PostgreSQL databases to Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
  • Experience with PostgreSQL-to-Oracle schema conversion, including tables, indexes, constraints, sequences, views, triggers, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills.
  • Experience developing migration scripts, stored procedures, packages, and automation utilities.
  • Experience using Oracle SQL Developer Migration Workbench or equivalent schema conversion tools.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle Database architecture, Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB), and performance tuning.
  • Experience with ETL processes, data transformation, and migration automation.
  • Ability to optimize SQL queries and improve migration performance for high-volume datasets.
  • Perform end-to-end data assessment, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and migration activities.
  • Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents and migration specifications.
  • Execute complex SQL-based reconciliation and data validation activities.
  • Identify and resolve migration defects, mapping inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
  • Conduct pre-migration, mock migration, production migration, and post-migration verification.
  • Support migration testing including SIT, UAT, Regression Testing, and Production Validation. Page 4 of 4 CONFIDENTIAL ERD-3-01b, Job Description Template, Rev. 13.0, Eff. 02/22/2023
  • Perform record-level reconciliation to ensure completeness, consistency, and accuracy of migrated pharmacovigilance data.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree/Masters Degree in IT Stream
  • 7+ years of relevant experience in safety IT Systems

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

raw.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. As a Demand Generation Manager, you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation.

You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal & Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web
  • Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas
  • Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance
  • Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs
  • Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach
  • Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence
  • Work cross-functionally to move campaigns forward: Design tickets within the sprint cycle, Lifecycle requests, and early Legal, Compliance, and bank review
  • Oversee website strategy and optimization, ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, ICP targeting, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization
  • Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau
  • Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results
  • Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality

What We Look For:

  • 5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products.
  • Proven experience leading demand generation and pipeline growth, including paid digital channels such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce and HubSpot.
  • Demonstrated skills or projects with claude, chatgpt, co-pilot or any other AI tool.
  • Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, funnel reporting, and dashboards in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool).
  • Track record of designing and analyzing test-and-learn experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to optimize campaign performance.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics.
  • Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment.
  • Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs.
  • Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization.

What We Offer You:

  • Competitive salary and stock option plan
  • 100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Paid parental leave
  • Health & wellness initiatives

raw.description:
BryceTech is seeking experienced Administrative and Operations Managers to provide senior-level financial, comptroller, administrative, and program operations support to the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Port Hueneme Division (NSWC PHD). These positions will support the Government’s financial management and program execution objectives through financial analysis, budget development, operational coordination, process improvement, reporting, and customer support. The successful candidates will apply strong analytical, organizational, and management skills to help ensure the effective use of resources, accurate financial and program data, and timely completion of organizational requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Provide financial management, comptroller, administrative, and program operations support to NSWC PHD departments and program offices

  • Support department-wide financial planning, budget development, resource allocation, expenditure tracking, and financial reporting

  • Analyze historical, current, and projected expenditures, commitments, and obligations to support operating budgets, carryover estimates, and funding decisions

  • Prepare budget justifications, financial impact statements, variance explanations, executive summaries, and other reports for Government review

  • Review financial transactions, funding documents, invoices, vouchers, and accounting records for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable policies and procedures

  • Reconcile financial data across Government systems, research unmatched disbursements and accounting discrepancies, and coordinate corrective actions

  • Track funding status across multiple appropriation types and support the processing, monitoring, and closeout of funding documentation

  • Develop and maintain financial tools, metrics, spreadsheets, reports, and dashboards to support organizational decision-making and performance monitoring

  • Support the preparation and presentation of quarterly financial reviews, management briefings, and other executive-level materials

  • Interpret and apply financial management policies, procedures, regulations, and internal controls to support organizational objectives and regulatory compliance

  • Coordinate administrative and operational activities, including training requests, procurement requests, purchase requisitions, travel documentation, and related workflow requirements

  • Track program tasks, milestones, deliverables, schedules, risks, and resource requirements; prepare status reports and recommend actions to address issues or delays

  • Collect, analyze, and communicate program and operational data, identifying trends, challenges, and opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness

  • Develop, update, and maintain standard operating procedures, desk guides, memorandums, financial plans, program documentation, and training materials

  • Support continuous process improvement, business transformation, strategic planning, and quality management initiatives

  • Coordinate with Government customers, department personnel, external stakeholders, and other support teams to resolve issues and facilitate effective communication

  • Organize and facilitate meetings, prepare agendas and briefing materials, maintain schedules and calendars, and document meeting outcomes and action items

  • Support records management, document control, and the appropriate handling, storage, archiving, and disposition of Government information

  • Support department-level website and portal management, including content updates, user access management, newsletters, and reporting metrics, as assigned

  • Coordinate the operation and scheduling of Government conference facilities and secure and unclassified video teleconference capabilities, as assigned

  • Active Secret security clearance or above

  • Master’s degree from an accredited college or university

  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in financial management, comptroller operations, program management, business operations, or administrative support

  • Demonstrated experience analyzing financial, budgetary, operational, or program data and preparing reports and recommendations for management

  • Experience supporting budget development, financial tracking, resource allocation, accounting processes, or program execution

  • Ability to interpret and apply organizational policies, procedures, financial management principles, and applicable regulations

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive-level reports, presentations, and briefing materials

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate multiple activities, identify operational challenges, and recommend practical solutions

  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and customer service skills

Position is contingent upon contract award.

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

BryceTech is a trusted leader in complex technology domains, delivering data-driven solutions in aerospace, biosecurity, and defense. We specialize in systems engineering, advanced analytics, R&D programs, and strategic advisory support. Our clients – including NASA, DoD, HHS, DHS, and other civil and national security agencies – rely on us to drive mission success and accelerate innovation.

BryceTech has been recognized in the Washington Technology Fast 50 ranking of top high-growth small businesses for five consecutive years and received a GovCon Contractor of the Year Award in 2025, underscoring our strong growth, competitive positioning, and excellence in federal contracting. With a proven track record of winning sought-after contracts, scaling high-performance teams, and executing on critical government missions, BryceTech presents a compelling opportunity for strategic partnerships in the GovCon space.

raw.description:
Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve organizational performance, operational efficiency, business agility, and long-term competitiveness across the insurance and investment businesses.

The role involves developing and executing the organization's transformation strategy, modernizing business models, optimizing operating structures, driving digital adoption, and leading strategic change programs. The CTO will work closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team to translate corporate strategy into measurable transformation outcomes.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic leadership, financial and operational expertise, technology awareness, and strong change management capabilities, with a proven track record of delivering complex transformation initiatives in insurance, investment management, banking, or financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, profitability, and organizational agility.
  • Align transformation priorities with corporate strategy, market conditions, and long-term business objectives.
  • Evaluate existing business models, organizational structures, and operating processes to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Establish transformation objectives, milestones, governance frameworks, and measurable success criteria.

Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead initiatives to modernize business models, operating structures, and service delivery frameworks.
  • Drive organizational restructuring, process redesign, and business integration initiatives.
  • Improve operational efficiency across insurance underwriting, claims, policy administration, distribution, and customer service.
  • Support transformation of investment operations, portfolio reporting, client servicing, and wealth management processes, where applicable.
  • Develop scalable operating models to support business expansion, diversification, and organizational growth.

Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead technology-enabled business transformation initiatives in collaboration with the CIO, CTO, and CDO.
  • Drive adoption of automation, AI, advanced analytics, cloud solutions, and digital platforms.
  • Modernize legacy systems, enterprise applications, and operational infrastructure.
  • Oversee transformation programs involving InsurTech, FinTech, digital insurance, and investment platforms.
  • Ensure technology investments deliver measurable improvements in productivity, customer experience, and business performance.

Financial & Operational Performance Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Lead cost transformation, process efficiency, and productivity improvement programs.
  • Establish performance management frameworks and operational KPIs.
  • Evaluate transformation business cases, financial benefits, investment requirements, and expected returns.
  • Monitor cost savings, revenue improvements, and overall financial impact of transformation initiatives.

Organizational Change Management

  • Develop and implement change management strategies to support enterprise transformation.
  • Build organizational readiness and secure leadership and employee engagement.
  • Lead communication, training, and stakeholder engagement initiatives during transformation programs.
  • Address resistance to change and promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Support leadership development and workforce transformation initiatives.

Customer & Business Experience Transformation

  • Drive initiatives to improve customer journeys and service delivery across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer and commercial leadership to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and engagement.
  • Simplify customer onboarding, claims processing, policy renewals, investment transactions, and client servicing.
  • Promote customer-centric operating models and consistent service standards.
  • Use customer insights and analytics to identify transformation priorities.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Work with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen organizational controls.
  • Lead initiatives to improve regulatory reporting, risk management processes, and governance frameworks.
  • Assess transformation-related operational, financial, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Establish appropriate controls and accountability throughout transformation programs.

Strategic Projects, M&A & Business Integration

  • Oversee major strategic transformation programs, including mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration.
  • Lead integration of business processes, systems, teams, and organizational structures following acquisitions.
  • Support new market entry, geographic expansion, and business diversification initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional transformation projects involving multiple subsidiaries and business units.
  • Track project outcomes and ensure delivery of expected strategic and financial benefits.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with the CEO, Board, executive team, and business unit heads to establish transformation priorities.
  • Lead transformation offices, program directors, project managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Establish transformation governance, reporting structures, and performance accountability.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology partners, and implementation specialists.
  • Present transformation progress, business impact, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Business Strategy, Organizational Development, Finance, or Transformation Management preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, operational excellence, or enterprise change management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership role overseeing large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Significant experience in insurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading complex enterprise transformation programs with measurable financial and operational outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience in operating model redesign, organizational restructuring, digital transformation, and process optimization.
  • Strong financial acumen, strategic planning, and business performance management capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder engagement, and change management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Prosci Change Management Certification.
  • Certified Business Transformation Professional (CBTP).
  • PMP or Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation milestones.
  • Cost savings and operational efficiency improvements.
  • Revenue growth and profitability improvements resulting from transformation.
  • Reduction in process turnaround times and operational bottlenecks.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.

- Digital adoption and automation rates.

  • Customer satisfaction and service delivery improvements.
  • Employee engagement and organizational change adoption.
  • Successful integration of acquired businesses and strategic partnerships.

Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Sales Commissions Analyst to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Echodyne is seeking a Sales Commissions Analyst to administer sales compensation plans and ensure accurate, timely commission and incentive payments. This role will partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and HR to manage monthly calculations, validate payouts, and help employees understand their compensation.

The ideal candidate is thorough, process-oriented, and highly skilled in Excel, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy. This role will also improve the tools and processes used to calculate, track, and report compensation as our go-to-market organization evolves.

This role has access to sensitive employee earnings, compensation plans, and financial information. Maintaining confidentiality and sharing information only with authorized individuals is a core responsibility.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Commission Administration and Accuracy

  • Administer sales compensation plans and monthly payout processes in accordance with approved plan terms.
  • Calculate and validate commissions, bonuses, and other sales incentive payments.
  • Reconcile sales, employee, and compensation data across systems to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Prepare payout summaries and supporting documentation for review, approval, and payroll processing.
  • Maintain clear records of calculations, adjustments, approvals, and payout history.
  • Resolve compensation inquiries and explain calculations and adjustments clearly.
  • Handle employee and compensation information with discretion and confidentiality.

Compensation Models and Plan Support

  • Maintain compensation models, payout logic, and employee plan assignments.
  • Support compensation plan development, implementation, and rollout using established best practices.
  • Support updates to plans as the go-to-market structure, territories, quotas, and sales roles evolve.
  • Model and validate proposed plan changes and their impact on payouts.
  • Document plan rules, calculation methods, and exceptions to support consistent administration.

Process Improvement and Reporting

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate compensation processes.
  • Improve the tools, workflows, and data models used to calculate, track, and report compensation.
  • Reduce manual effort and processing time while maintaining accuracy and appropriate review controls.
  • Develop recurring reports that provide visibility into commission earnings, payouts, and adjustments.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve source data quality and resolve recurring issues.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3 years+ (minimum) of experience in sales compensation, finance, sales operations, or a related analytical role.
  • Advanced Excel and data modeling skills, including complex formulas, lookup functions, pivot tables, and data reconciliation.
  • Thorough approach to work, with strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy.
  • Understanding of best practices for building, administering, and rolling out sales commission plans.
  • Process-oriented mindset, with the ability to document workflows, identify gaps, and implement improvements.
  • Ability to validate calculations across multiple data sources and investigate discrepancies.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to meet recurring monthly deadlines.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain compensation calculations to employees and business partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential employee and compensation information with discretion, protect sensitive data, and follow established access and information-sharing requirements.

PREFERRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

  • Direct experience working with sales compensation or financial data.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, or sales compensation management tools.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

  • Accurate, timely commission and incentive payouts, with clear supporting documentation.
  • Simplified compensation processes that reduce manual work, errors, and processing time.
  • Compensation models and payout logic that reflect approved plans and support revenue goals.
  • Improved tools and reporting that make compensation easier to calculate, track, and understand.
  • Timely resolution of compensation questions and discrepancies, building confidence in the payout process.

Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

raw.description:
About the Job
Title: Chief of Staff – Executive Operations
Location: Remote (US, Eastern or Central time zone)
Type: Full-time (W-2) or Part-time contractor (1099)
Compensation: $85,000–$105,000 annually (full-time) or $42–$55/hour (part-time, ~20 hours/week)
Start: April 2026

About Serve Freight

Serve Freight is a high-reliability logistics operator specializing in complex freight execution for mid-market shippers and project-driven industries. We manage transportation, warehousing, and value-added logistics programs for companies that cannot afford missed delivery windows, broken communication, or unreliable carriers. We are scaling fast in 2026 and building the operational infrastructure to support it. This role is part of that buildout.

The Role

We are hiring a Chief of Staff – Executive Operations to serve as the CEO’s operational right-hand, owning the day-to-day rhythm of the business so the CEO can focus on the things only he can do.

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant or operations management position. It is a hybrid role that combines structured operational ownership with cross-functional coordination, process ownership, and real decision-making authority.

You are the person who keeps the CEO out of the weeds. You own the recurring operational cadence, drive accountability on tactical priorities, and make the calls that would otherwise sit in a queue waiting for approval.

50% of your time will be structured operational ownership. 50% will be dedicated to cross-functional problem-solving, process improvement, and team coordination.

What You Will Do

Executive & Calendar Management

  • Manage the CEO’s calendar: scheduling, rescheduling, conflict resolution

• Triage and prioritize the CEO’s inbox

• Coordinate travel logistics

  • Prepare meeting agendas, pre-reads, and follow-up action items

Data, Dashboards & Financial Support

  • Pull and format weekly operational dashboards from Turvo, QuickBooks, and HubSpot
  • Run down accounts receivable discrepancies and flag issues
  • Prepare financial summaries and talking points for leadership meetings
  • Support the company’s strategic advisor with slide deck preparation and data pulls

Process & SOP Ownership

  • Draft and maintain internal SOPs for recurring operational processes
  • Document workflows across departments as they are formalized
  • Research and recommend operational tools within defined budget parameters
  • Integrate approved tools into existing workflows

Operational Problem-Solving

  • Investigate and resolve operational issues across departments before they reach the CEO
  • Triage which priorities you can own directly vs. what needs to be escalated
  • Reschedule initiative timelines when circumstances change
  • Coordinate with internal team members across operations, accounting, and brokerage

Decision-Making Authority

This role carries real decision-making responsibility within defined boundaries. You will not be waiting for approval on every task.

You will decide: which tools to investigate, which software to select within budget, how to reschedule internal timelines, how to triage and route requests, and how to resolve calendar conflicts.

You will escalate any commitments to external parties, expenditures above the threshold, changes to sales or pricing, and strategic or partnership decisions.

Who You Are

  • 5–8 years in operations, chief of staff, or executive support roles at a growing company (under 50 employees preferred)
  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats and operating across departments without waiting for a playbook
  • Can make decisions without perfect information; does not freeze with ambiguous direction
  • Strong written communicator: SOPs, slide decks, and emails without heavy editing
  • Data-literate: can pull and present operational and financial data without being an analyst
  • You think like an owner, not a task-taker

Tools You Will Use

Turvo (TMS), QuickBooks Online, HubSpot (CRM), Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Excel/Sheets. You do not need to be an expert in all of these on day one, but you should be comfortable learning quickly.

What Success Looks Like

At 30 days: The CEO has measurably more free time. Recurring tasks are transferred and running on schedule.

At 60 days: You are proactively resolving issues before they reach the CEO. You have recommended or implemented at least one process improvement.

At 90 days: The CEO feels like you are an extension of himself. Internal stakeholders engage with you directly. Minimal oversight needed.

What This Role Is Not

• Not a calendar-only EA role

• Not a system administrator or IT role

  • Not a sales or business development role
  • Not a strategic advisory role -- but your judgment and recommendations will directly shape how we operate

How to Apply

Submit an application here and send a short note (not a cover letter) to with the subject line: Chief of Staff - Executive Operations - [Your Name].

Answer these three questions:

  • Tell us about a time you made a decision on behalf of an executive. What was the situation, what did you decide, and what happened?
  • Describe a process you built or improved at a previous company. What was broken, what did you change, and what was the result?
  • Give an example of a time you had to figure something out with almost no direction. How did you approach it?

No form letters. No AI-generated cover letters. We read every response.

AIR is seeking a Research Assistant for its Learning Supports program. This position will support a growing portfolio of research focused on improving student learning outcomes, including projects related to instruction, education technology, leadership development, and supports for special populations such as English learners and students with disabilities. The ideal candidate will bring enthusiasm for communicating about project and organizational initiatives and contributing broadly across program activities. The position will support multiple projects simultaneously and requires strong collaboration, communication, and organizational skills.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of AIR's U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories. Candidates must be willing to travel.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

The responsibilities for the position include:

  • Conduct literature reviews to support research projects and proposal development activities.
  • Prepare and clean data for analysis, including renaming variables, generating derived variables, and reviewing datasets for errors and missing values.
  • Code and review studies for research synthesis and evidence review projects.
  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses and contribute to the reporting and interpretation of findings.
  • Support efforts to recruit and engage schools and districts in research studies, including conducting outreach, building relationships, and coordinating recruitment activities.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for schools and teachers, providing ongoing communication and coordination related to study data collection activities.
  • Develop and maintain spreadsheets, databases, and tracking tools to support project activities.
  • Support business development efforts by researching funding opportunities, conducting literature reviews, and contributing to proposal development.
  • Assist in identifying, reviewing, and developing scholarly materials that communicate research findings.
  • Prepare research products, presentations, and communication materials for delivery and dissemination.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in the social sciences or a related field.
  • Knowledge of or experience with research methodologies and data collection approaches, such as research synthesis screening, survey design, structured interviews, observations, and focus groups.
  • Experience with or interest in learning communication tools and strategies, including social media platforms.
  • Experience with or interest in learning software programs such as NVivo, R, or Stata for data analysis is preferred, but not required.

Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in data collection, analysis, and report preparation.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
  • Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate efficiently in a virtual work environment.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively with project stakeholders and external partners.

Disclosures: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. Employment-based visa sponsorship (including H-1B sponsorship) is not available for this position. Depending on project work, qualified candidates may need to meet certain residency requirements.

American Institutes for Research is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including, but not limited to, actual or perceived race (including traits historically associated with race, such as hair texture, hair type, and protective hairstyles such as braids, locs, and twists), creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition (e.g., cancer), sex, gender, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, civil union status, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, genetic information, or military or veteran status. AIR adheres to strict child safeguarding principles. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles and will therefore undergo reference and background checks. AIR maintains a drug-free work environment.

ACCESSIBILITY NOTICE: If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process due to a physical or mental disability, please send an email to or call 202.403.5000.

Fraudulent Job Scams Warning & Disclaimer: AIR is aware of individuals falsely presenting themselves as AIR representatives. Fraudulent job scams seek to extract sensitive information or money from victims. To protect yourself, please be aware that AIR recruitment will only email you from an "@air.org" domain. Please take extra caution while examining the email address. For example, is correct, while is not a legitimate AIR email address. If you are unsure of the legitimacy of a communication you have received, please reach out to .

If you see a job scam, or lose money to one, report it to the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) at ReportFraud.ftc.gov. You can also report it to your state attorney general. Learn more about how to avoid scams at ftc.gov/scams.

AIR’s Total Rewards Program, is designed to reward our staff competitively and motivate them to achieve our critical mission. This position offers the anticipated annual salary as listed. Salary offers are made based on internal equity within the institution and external equity with competitive markets. Please note this is the annual salary range for candidates that are based in the United States.

Anticipated Hourly Rate Range
$25—$28 USD

raw.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

We are looking for a Finance Manager forour IFM Finance business line.

About JLL

We’re JLL. We’re a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying and investing in real estate.

If you’re looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. At JLL, you’ll have a chance to innovate with the world’s leading businesses, put that expertise into action on landmark projects, and work on game-changing real estate initiatives. You’ll also make long-lasting professional connections through sharing different perspectives, and you’ll be inspired by the best. We’re focused on opportunity and want to help you make the most of yours. Achieve your ambitions – join us at JLL!

Role Purpose

The Client Finance Manager is a senior leadership role, with oversight of one client account. This role oversees a geographically dispersed team, across multiple countries in EMEA regions. This role will have direct responsibility for leading the finance team.

The Client Finance Manager is the financial liaison between the JLL Operational Team and the Client. Responsible for the implementation and execution of accounting processes and programs designed to ensure the appropriate level of accuracy, tracking and control over the operating expenses and capital expenditures of the client account. They are also responsible for accounting compliance, and all JLL Corporate finance deliverables for the client account including budgeting, forecasting and monthly variance analysis.

What this job involves

Strategic Direction & Management

  • Provide clear direction and strategic financial advice to the JLL team working on the Client.
  • Liaise and support the Client’s primary financial managers/units.
  • Ensure the team is structured to maintain & exceed the client’s financial expectations.
  • Develop and maintain all relevant policies and procedures with respect to all financial & support services associated with the Client.

Relationship Management

  • Be proactive in developing and managing client / business unit relationships ensuring that the expected service levels are achieved across the region.
  • Encourage an environment that supports teamwork, financial transparency, co-operation & performance excellence across the region.
  • Manage and coach the team to ensure high staff morale, trust, work ethics, clear goals and performance reviews.
  • Develop IPMP and succession plans for all roles in the JLL client finance team.

Budgeting and Reporting – both Corporate and Client

  • Support and coordinate the activities of the finance team across the Globe and EMEA: Information, Report production, Financial Administration.
  • Ensure that accurate and timely financial information is provided to all members of the management team.
  • Production of annual budgets in conjunction with JLL team and client finance team.
  • Understand the Client’s accounting structure and system.
  • Develop, maintain & deliver in a timely manner, the Client’s approved financial reports across the region.
  • Coordinate and track the cost savings initiatives for the region.

Data Management, Policies & Procedures & Audit:

  • Ensure data integrity of the systems across the region and audit data from time to time.
  • Ensure that appropriate process, systems controls, and controls are in place and maintained to guarantee the integrity of all transactions.
  • Ensure that all financial accounting and reporting is audit worthy and in keeping with recognized quality management processes.
  • Ensure all finance staff are well trained on the financial systems & are effectively able to extract data.

JLL Reporting

  • Balance Sheet and P&L reporting
  • Own reporting on profitability of the client account
  • Ensure data integrity of the balance sheet.
  • Ensure accurate and timely cash flow completion
  • Manage and optimise the efficiency and effectiveness of finance processes.
  • Ensure robust financial controls in place including Cash Reconciliations, all Balance sheet reconciliations & compliance with SOX reporting
  • Production of annual budgets in conjunction with JLL team and client finance team.
  • Ensure data integrity of the balance sheet for both the client and Corporate.
  • Ensure accurate and timely cash flow completion

Invoice Payment & Processing

Ensure the management of:

  • Payment of all operating invoices in a timely manner, including payment of rental to landlords, in accordance with legal obligations.
  • Support the client in the set up & management of inter departmental cross charging.
  • Develop and maintain all necessary guidelines and manuals associated with the Clients payable / receivable process
  • Ensure the timely processing of the JLL invoices, including monitoring the Clients receivable

Every day is different, and in all these activities, we’d encourage you to show your ingenuity.

Sound like you? To apply you need to be / have:

  • Customer service orientation essential
  • Previous EMEA or international experience essential
  • 3-5 years’ experience in a similar position (working with international teams and clients)
  • University degree in Accounting/Finance/Economics or equivalent and Qualified Member of Professional Accounting Association (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA)
  • Experience in managing team over 2-5 people
  • Strong leadership skills working with a dynamic team directly and by influencing indirectly stakeholders
  • Motivated, positive and flexible in approach to work and able to develop others in such an approach
  • Demonstrated financial competency at both a strategic & detailed level of operation
  • Decision maker - motivated by & objectives focused
  • Demonstrated competency in planning & management
  • Self – supporting; diligent; can deliver to tight deadlines
  • Excellent PC skills, proficient in Office tools, especially Microsoft Outlook Word & Excel.

What you can expect from us:

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay.

Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sights and imagine where JLL can take you...

JLL is an Equal Opportunities Employer and encourages applications from all sections of the community.

Accounting Processes, Financial Controlling, Financial Processes, Leadership, Management Processes, People Management, Taking Initiative

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

***This is an independent contractor position (Per-Project Basis).

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A day in the life:

  • You must be eager to learn, challenge yourself on a daily basis, and contribute to the creative efforts of client campaigns. This position mainly focuses on the execution of design deliverables with a goal to grow your digital marketing mindset while working alongside a team of fellow designers, editors and strategists.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Work closely with a team of designers, editors, and ACDs in the execution of all design deliverables for your pod and owned accounts
  • Collaborate with our Creative & Marketing teams to craft creative & engaging designs/content across various marketing channels
  • Areas of focus include: Social Media, Paid Advertising, Email, Content Marketing, Infographics and Branding
  • Maintain an organized workflow and keep to deadlines across multiple projects
  • Receive and incorporate feedback from from stakeholders throughout the review process
  • Apply learnings from Power metrics & other creative content that's out in the world
  • Keep a pulse on design trends + implementing them into client’s content strategy in a timely manner

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in design and creative
  • A strong understanding of visual design, branding, and the digital landscape
  • Attention to detail on all work, timelines, and communication with fellow team members
  • Confidence in your ability to communicate with your team(s) and clients
  • Ensure projects are completed with high quality and on schedule
  • Work with a wide range of media and use graphic design software including Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, etc.
  • Ability to multitask & be flexible in day-to-day tasks within an agency culture

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Own 100% of Graphic Design work for up to 10 clients
  • Meet weekly projection (15 tasks/week)
  • Zero (0) Avoidable Errors
  • Zero (0) Late Submission

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Deliver high quality graphic designs during design phases of marketing projects
  • Delivering project phase completion (design) on time, within the projected timeline
  • Utilize modern trends, techniques, and strategies in graphic design to provide the best possible product for our clients

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

raw.description:
POS-P2934

Solutions Engineer

AI is changing how businesses buy. Buyers arrive informed, often having researched with AI, and they no longer buy on promises: they want to see their own business running in HubSpot, and proof that it will deliver measurable results, before they commit. HubSpot's agentic customer platform is leading this shift, connecting customer context, Breeze AI agents and a unified CRM so scaling companies realize business outcomes, not just adopt software. As buying moves from large contracts signed up front to proving value one use case at a time, we are building a new technical go-to-market team to lead customers through that change.

Come join the team defining what technical go-to-market looks like in the AI era. As a Solutions Engineer, you bring a customer-facing background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture or technical consulting, along with hands-on building experience. You won't just show customers what's possible; you'll build it with them, prove it delivers their outcomes, and set them on the path to realizing them. This is a pre-sales role, not a software engineering role, for technologists who build fast with AI tools. Few companies have figured out how to sell this way at scale, and here you will help lead the industry in defining and building a new technical go-to-market model that others will follow. If you love building, thrive at the intersection of business and technology, and want to help write the playbook for how software is bought next, this role is for you.

In this role, you will need to:

  • Tell compelling, outcome-led stories (via demos and product led experiences) that show customers how their business can be reimagined on HubSpot's agentic customer platform.
  • Lead discovery that uncovers the pain, outcomes and requirements by engaging customers and then earning the right to go deeper
  • Partner with Account Executives to map the technical buying committee, competitive landscape and path to a decision.
  • Redesign customers' legacy complexity into a simplified HubSpot architecture that integrates with their wider tech stack.
  • Design and build working proofs quickly with AI coding tools, Breeze AI agents and the HubSpot developer framework, scoped to clear use cases, success criteria and timelines.
  • Run hands-on proofs with customers, iterating on their feedback and clearing security and integration risks to secure the technical win.
  • Turn proof into a business case, ROI and use-case roadmap with a consumption plan that sizes the first commitment.
  • Present results to executives and generate confidence to move forward with HubSpot
  • Guide and build with customers and implementation partners to ensure the realization of the customer’s first outcomes.
  • Create reusable assets and capture field feedback to shape our playbooks and the HubSpot product roadmap
  • Occasional travel to customer sites to perform the above activities
  • Success measurement: This role will be measured on our ability to win new customers and ensure that the customer achieves their initial business outcomes

We are looking for people who (skills and experience):

  • Experience: Customer-facing background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting or implementation for SaaS platforms, with a track record of winning complex deals or delivering solutions that moved business results.
  • Art-of-the-Possible Storytelling & Discovery: Ability to turn a customer's goals into a compelling, outcome-led vision of their business reimagined in HubSpot, backed by peer proof rather than features. Skilled at uncovering the pain, outcomes and requirements customers don't state outright, through sharp questioning and by reading how they react to what they see.
  • Solution Building & Proof Design: Hands-on fluency building working solutions fast with leading AI coding tools, Breeze AI agents and the HubSpot developer framework. Sound judgment about what proof a deal needs and how to make it measurable, time-boxed and reusable in implementation.
  • Solution Architecture & HubSpot Platform Depth: Ability to simplify legacy complexity into a scalable HubSpot solution and architecture that integrates appropriately with a customer's tech stack (ERP, billing, data warehouse, AI tools, etc.). Deep comfort with enterprise solution architecture, APIs, integrations and AI coding.
  • Consumption Planning & Outcome Ownership: Business acumen to translate outcomes into a use-case roadmap, consumption plan and ROI model. An owner's mindset that guides and builds with the customer to ensure that outcomes are realized.
  • Executive Influence & Orchestration: Credibility with executives and technical buyers to generate excitement in the future vision and the confidence to move forward as well as equip champions to sell internally. Ability to lead without authority across sellers, partners and customer teams.

We have several roles open at different levels within this team within our Mid-Market and Corp segments. During the process, if we believe your experience may align more closely with another level/segment, we’ll discuss this with you and outline potential next steps.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
$105,800—$151,200 USD

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Explore more:

  • HubSpot Careers
  • Life at HubSpot on Instagram

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.

raw.description:
About Uplift

Uplift is a dynamic agency specializing in global talent search, covering EMEA, LATAM, USA, and APAC. With successful placements in 60 countries, we combine speed and cutting-edge technology to source top executive and mid-senior talent across various functions. Our innovative approach integrates global networks, AI, and advanced recruitment tools. Beyond recruitment, we engage with our audience through our podcast, newsletter, and webinars, ensuring we stay at the forefront of talent acquisition and global HR trends.

About Our Client

Our client is a leading global digital advertising company operating in over 130 markets worldwide. Through partnerships with nearly 60 major digital platforms, the company helps businesses expand their reach and maximize advertising opportunities. With a strong international presence and a dynamic, multicultural environment, they offer exciting career opportunities for professionals looking to grow in the digital advertising industry.

We're looking for a Senior Client Partner who will drive new business growth for TikTok advertising in Latvia.

As their team's partner for TikTok in the Latvian market, you will represent one of the world's most engaging platforms and bring innovative advertising solutions to leading brands. This is a senior digital advertising sales role for someone with extensive experience, a strong industry network, and the ability to manage large, complex, multi-million international digital advertising projects.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the market entry strategy for our products and boost sales in Latvia.
  • Take responsibility for results delivery across the region.
  • Build, retain, and grow a dedicated book of business made up of top agencies and advertisers.
  • Consistently meet and exceed individual sales targets and other defined KPIs.
  • Build and nurture a broad network of customer and industry relationships.
  • Develop short-term and long-term revenue strategies that deliver significant revenue growth.
  • Co-develop the market through workshops, seminars, PR, and education.
  • Plan and execute winning account strategies.
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external sales support stakeholders on managed products.
  • Report to the product partner team.
  • Maximize customer satisfaction and retention.

Qualifications:

  • A strong background in media sales, with demonstrable knowledge of online marketing and advertising.
  • A highly customer-oriented approach, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A systematic way of working, combined with a strong can-do attitude.
  • A highly analytical, data-focused mindset, with the ability to think both strategically and creatively.
  • Tech curiosity, with knowledge of Sheets, PowerPoint, and Keynote. Experience with Salesforce, DSM, and DFP is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of the Latvian and wider Baltic advertising markets.
  • Business-level English and Latvian, written and spoken.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and complexity, and a proactive approach to problem solving.
  • A focus on delivering business-critical results for clients rather than simply selling media.
  • Close connections with key agencies and clients in Latvia are an advantage.
