About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an SMB Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by opening new opportunities with small and midsize businesses and by bringing back clients who have gone quiet. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will work three motions: cold outreach to a prioritized list of companies with $5M to $300M in annual revenue, reactivation of dormant clients, and call backs to prospects who missed a scheduled Client Advisor call. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through outreach and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our SMB sales team. If you are a self motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment.
  • Sales: Understand current and future demand across the SMB and midmarket segments. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position Toptal with SMB clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and talent topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
  • Begin the Relationship: Through lead generation activities and cold calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales ready leads and opportunities from a prioritized list of companies with $5M to $300M in annual revenue. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
  • Reactivate and Recover: You will restart relationships that have gone quiet. When a dormant client has not restarted an engagement with its Account Manager, the account moves to the SDR pool, and you reach out, book the meeting, and bring the client back. You will also call back prospects who missed a scheduled Client Advisor call, starting 7 days after the missed call, and book a new meeting.
  • Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future SMB clients, you will build rapport through strategic outreach and a well rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team, SMB outbound Account Executives, Account Managers, and Client Advisors to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Account Executives close the opportunities you source, and Account Managers take over each account once the engagement starts. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on companies of every size, from fast growing SMBs to the world’s largest enterprises.
  • Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and our outreach and productivity tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Nooks, and Claude).
  • Integrate into your pod, partner with SMB outbound Account Executives, Account Managers, and Client Advisors, and begin working your prioritized account list.
  • Learn the process for each motion: new business outreach, dormant client reactivation, and missed call follow up. Implement an outreach process and hit your first month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Complete your ramp on the SDR team and attain your metrics, which include calls, emails, Sales Accepted Leads (SALs), and pipeline created.
  • Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within target accounts, dormant clients, and missed call leads that result in revenue generating engagements for Toptal.
  • Hit activity, SAL, and pipeline objectives.
  • Become proficient in using our sales tools.
  • Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
  • Build new and existing client relationships, bring dormant clients back, and continue to execute account plans.
  • Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the prioritized account list, alongside clients brought back through reactivation and missed call follow up.
  • Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience as an SDR or outbound Account Executive in SMB or midmarket sales.
  • Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by small and midsize businesses.
  • Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from target accounts, dormant clients, and missed call leads.
  • Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
  • Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
  • Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
  • Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
  • Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
  • Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business. We want self starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
  • Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
  • Urgency. SMB deals move fast. You follow up quickly on every lead, reactivation, and missed call.
  • Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
  • Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
  • Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
  • Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
  • Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on sales development results. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

raw.description:
At Regnology our greatest asset is our people. We value diversity and foster an inclusive environment that supports learning, safety, and growth. By investing in our team, listening to customers, and encouraging creativity, we drive continuous innovation and improvement.
We offer a flexible, innovative environment where your ideas matter and your career can thrive.
Regnology is a global leader in regulatory reporting, helping financial institutions, regulators, and tax authorities improve data quality, efficiency, and cost savings. Our mission: to safeguard financial markets through smarter, future-ready solutions.

What you'll do


We are seeking motivated and customer-oriented professionals to join our Global Support team as a Customer Support Specialist for our Financial Platforms. In this entry-level role, you will be the first point of contact for clients using our suite of financial software applications for regulatory banking, risk, and tax. In this role, you will provide product support to our clients while contributing to 24/7 global service continuity through a coordinated Follow the Sun (FTS) support model.

This position is a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in the financial technology industry. You will play a key role in helping financial institutions navigate a complex regulatory landscape by joining a supportive and diverse team that values knowledge sharing and teamwork across the globe.


Key Responsibilities


  • Serve as a primary support contact for clients using our financial reporting products, resolving inquiries related to business rules, configurations, and report outputs.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot issues related to data discrepancies, reporting logic, and system behavior, using internal tools, configuration review, and logs analysis.
  • Guide clients through issue resolution while ensuring clear, structured communication and high service quality.
  • Investigate discrepancies in regulatory calculations, collaborating with internal teams to deliver solutions.
  • Work closely with technical and product teams to ensure client issues are resolved thoroughly and effectively.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule for urgent support needs during weekends or outside of local business hours.
  • Ensure seamless handover and coordination with other regions as part of the Follow the Sun support model.
  • Support response efforts for high-priority or platform-wide incidents, maintaining clear internal communication and documentation.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives aimed at enhancing support processes and product features.
  • Support the development of internal knowledge base content and client-facing documentation.

Why we should decide on you


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
  • 0 - 2 years of experience in customer service, business analysis, or working with financial software solutions (recent graduates with relevant internship experience are encouraged to apply).
  • A strong interest in technology and finance, with a desire to learn about financial regulations, capital markets, and software solutions.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with basic technical troubleshooting (e.g., reviewing logs, user access, configurations, SQL queries).
  • Exposure to Java-based applications and cloud frameworks (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes) is a strong plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both German and English are required; additional proficiency in French is advantageous.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, Zendesk) or agile methodologies (Scrum) is a plus.
  • Highly structured and analytical, with strong troubleshooting instincts and attention to detail.
  • Calm and dependable in high-pressure or time-sensitive situations.
  • Client-focused and collaborative, with a service-oriented mindset.
  • Proactive in driving improvements to internal processes and documentation.
  • Motivated to help build and scale a globally distributed support function.
  • Familiarity with AI concepts and its potential application in a business environment

Why you should decide on us


  • Market Leadership: Join a global leader where our agile culture and innovative spirit allow you to shape the future of financial stability.
  • International Scope: Take ownership of high-profile international projects and benefit from our global internal mobility initiatives.
  • Growth & Mentorship: Access a wide range of our technical and functional training opportunities.
  • Culture of Inclusion: We foster a supportive, transparent atmosphere with frequent team events and a commitment to diversity.

To get a first impression, we only need your CV and look forward to meeting you in a (personal/virtual) interview!


Recognizing the benefits of working in diverse teams, we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, and sexual identity.


Are you interested? Apply now!

You'll be at the forefront of helping Australian and New Zealand enterprises secure their digital future in an era defined by AI. What will you be doing

    - Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to consistently grow Saviynt's revenue across Australia and New Zealand, targeting organisations with 1,000+ employees.
    - Orchestrate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building trusted relationships with CISOs and senior executives by understanding their business, security, and technology priorities.

Why you'll love this role

    - Care deeply about understanding complex customer challenges and crafting tailored solutions that deliver tangible business and security outcomes.
    - Enjoy the challenge of orchestrating a diverse team – both internal experts and external partners – to collectively win complex enterprise deals.
    - Thrive in a dynamic environment where you can leverage modern sales tools and AI to drive efficiency, gain deeper insights, and continuously refine your sales strategy.

What you bring

    - Proficient in enterprise sales methodologies, such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and their practical application.

    - Highly organised and disciplined in developing and executing territory, account, and opportunity plans.
    - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility and rapport with C-level executives.
    - Collaborative spirit, understanding the importance of teamwork and effectively coordinating cross-functional resources and partners.
    - Proactive and resourceful in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership.
    - Analytical and curious mindset, eager to understand customer needs and market trends, especially concerning AI.

Our Company

PharMerica

Overview

The Associate Vice President of Sales will be managing regional business line strategy to drive strategic business plans and growth to meet/exceed LTC Revenue goals through organic new sales and may assist in client retention. The Associate Vice President of Sales will also be responsible for planning, developing, and executing collaborative bed growth initiatives based on the strategic direction and goals of PharMerica.

* This is a remote position with 75% travel. Applicants should reside within the territory.

We offer:

Competitive pay

Health, dental, vision and life insurance benefits

Company paid STD and LTD

Tuition Assistance

Employee Discount Program

401k

Paid-time off

Tuition reimbursement

Non-retail/Closed-door environment

Responsibilities

  • Works with Vice President of Growth and Market Development, Vice Presidents of Operations, Regional Pharmacy Directors, Account Executives and other key PharMerica associates to implement growth initiatives in coordination with the overall strategic revenue plan for PharMerica
  • Possibly develops and executes chain client business strategies to expand PharMerica’s value proposition, assess levels of satisfaction of services, address client issues/concerns and resolve in a timely manner, manage client expectations, communicate financial, operational, and clinical updates, solicit client feedback and coordinate intervention where necessary
  • Works with Vice Presidents of Sales and Client Management, Vice President of Client Services, Regional Client Manager, Vice President of Operations and Regional Pharmacy Directors to ensure that new business is implemented in a manner consistent with an established client management plan
  • Works with Sales Team, Regional Client Managers, Regional Pharmacy Directors and Pharmacy Directors to assure a continuous update of the client profiling database for tracking, information gathering, and/or troubleshooting
  • Works with Regional Pharmacy Directors, Pharmacy Directors and Regional Client Managers to review the results of client feedback and identify areas of improvement that drive consistent growth
  • Works with Regional Client Managers, Customer Field Services, Regional Pharmacy Directors and Pharmacy Directors to support new client start-ups, acquisitions, and any new business transitions as necessary
  • Maintains database (CRM) to ensure strategic planning for all clients remain on targetHas Lead role in developing and executing strategy with Regional Client Managers and corporate chain clients within their region for maximum operational, clinical, and financial performance while securing long term business partnerships
  • Performs other tasks as assigned
  • Conducts job responsibilities in accordance with the standards set out in the Company’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, its policies and procedures, the Corporate Compliance Agreement, applicable federal and state laws, and applicable professional standards

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Each essential function is required, although reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree; MBA/MHA, preferred
  • Five years Client Management/Client Sales experience
  • Experience working with CEO’s, COO’s, SVP’s
  • Five years in Pharmacy Benefit Management, Pharmacy Wholesale Management, or Long-Term Care Management
  • Familiarity with Broad Sales, Client Service Orientation, and Territory Management
  • Knowledge of tools/databases related sales management
  • Strong client service, communication, and influence skills

PharMerica, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, delivers personalized pharmacy care through dedicated local teams, serving health care providers such as skilled nursing facilities, senior living communities, and hospitals. We also cater to individuals with behavioral needs, infusion therapy needs, seniors receiving in-home care, and patients with cancer. Operating long-term care, home infusion, and specialty pharmacies across the nation, we combine the personal touch of a neighborhood pharmacy with the resources of a national network. Our comprehensive solutions, backed by industry-leading technology and regulatory expertise, ensure accurate medication access, cost control, and compliance with best-in-class clinical standards. We are committed to enhancing resident health, reducing staff burdens, and supporting our clients' success. For more information, visit www.pharmerica.com. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.

raw.excerpt: Job Description: Director of PMO – Insurance & Investments 1.
raw.description:
Job Description: Director of PMO – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Director of Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for establishing, leading, and managing the organization's Project Management Office to ensure effective governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of strategic and operational projects.

The role oversees the project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate operations, technology, digital transformation, and business development functions. The Director of PMO ensures projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and organizational objectives while maintaining effective risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will drive project management excellence, strengthen governance frameworks, improve delivery performance, and ensure that project outcomes contribute to business growth, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PMO Strategy, Leadership & Governance

  • Establish, develop, and lead the organization's Project Management Office.
  • Define PMO strategy, policies, methodologies, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement standardized project management processes, tools, templates, and reporting structures.
  • Establish project approval processes, stage gates, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Promote project management best practices across departments and business units.
  • Ensure alignment between project execution and corporate strategy.

B. Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the organization's project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Evaluate project proposals, business cases, feasibility studies, and investment requirements.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, financial impact, risk, and resource availability.
  • Monitor project dependencies, interdepartmental coordination, and portfolio-level risks.
  • Provide recommendations to senior management regarding project prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Track portfolio performance and ensure delivery of expected business benefits.

C. Project Planning & Execution

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution of strategic projects.
  • Ensure project managers develop comprehensive project plans, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and identify delays, delivery challenges, and performance gaps.
  • Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to maintain project delivery commitments.
  • Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

D. Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee projects related to insurance operations, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution.
  • Coordinate initiatives involving investment operations, financial products, portfolio reporting, and client services, where applicable.
  • Support the implementation of regulatory, compliance, risk management, and internal control initiatives.
  • Monitor projects involving new product development, market expansion, operational improvements, and business integration.
  • Ensure project deliverables reflect the operational and regulatory requirements of the insurance and financial services industry.

E. Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Oversee technology-enabled transformation projects, including core insurance systems, CRM, ERP, digital platforms, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with IT, technology, operations, and business teams to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor technology project budgets, vendor performance, implementation timelines, and delivery quality.
  • Support digitalization, process automation, data management, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Ensure technology projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

F. Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and monitor project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure reports.
  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources.
  • Monitor project costs, financial variances, and budget performance.
  • Evaluate project financial risks and recommend cost-control measures.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Procurement teams on project funding, contracts, and vendor payments.
  • Assess project return on investment (ROI) and benefits realization.

G. Risk Management, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish project risk management frameworks and escalation mechanisms.
  • Identify, assess, and monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
  • Monitor project quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed specifications.
  • Maintain project documentation, audit trails, and management records.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams.

H. Performance Monitoring & Executive Reporting

  • Develop project dashboards, management reports, and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Present project status, risks, budget performance, and delivery updates to executive leadership.
  • Provide timely visibility into project delays, resource constraints, and critical dependencies.
  • Monitor project KPIs and ensure accountability among project managers.
  • Lead project review meetings and portfolio governance sessions.
  • Recommend improvements to project delivery processes and organizational performance.

I. Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Lead and develop project managers, PMO analysts, and project support professionals.
  • Build strong working relationships with senior executives, department heads, project sponsors, and external vendors.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination across business units and functional teams.
  • Develop project management capabilities through training, coaching, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, Finance, or a relevant discipline is preferred.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 10–15 years of progressive professional experience in project management, program management, or portfolio management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership or Director-level position.
  • Proven experience establishing, managing, or transforming a Project Management Office.
  • Experience overseeing complex, enterprise-wide projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Background in insurance, banking, financial services, investment management, or related industries is highly desirable.
  • Experience managing large project portfolios, budgets, resources, and multiple project teams.
  • Exposure to digital transformation, technology implementation, business process improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Managing Successful Programmes (MSP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

- Lean Six Sigma certification.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic project and portfolio management.
  • PMO governance and operational leadership.
  • Financial planning and budget management.

- Risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Executive communication and stakeholder management.
  • Change management and business transformation.
  • Leadership, team development, and decision-making.
  • Project management systems and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and delivery success rate.

- Project cost and schedule variance.

  • Achievement of project milestones and strategic objectives.

- Project benefits realization and ROI.

  • Effectiveness of project governance and reporting.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project sponsor feedback.
  • PMO process maturity and continuous improvement.
  • Compliance with project management standards and regulatory requirements.

raw.title: Principal Product Manager, Fraud and Risk
raw.excerpt: Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions.
raw.description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

As the Principal Product Manager for our Defend product, you will own the strategy, vision, and execution of tools designed for fraud investigation and risk prediction. Defend is our anti-fraud platform that protects consumers against forgery or impersonation. Experience in building fraud or cybersecurity products is a must. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to create intuitive investigative tools and data-driven risk models that protect businesses and their customers. You’ll work directly with customers to deeply understand their challenges, anticipate emerging fraud trends, and deliver solutions that drive real impact.

In addition, you will also lead strategic planning, vision definition, GTM strategy, stakeholder alignment, executive presentations and customer briefings as it pertains to your product area. You may also need to be an expert in specific customer segments such as enterprise, real estate or financial services. This role is an individual contributor role, reporting to the VP of Product.

What you'll do as a Principal Product Manager:

  • Independently lead customer solution conversations to help unlock activation and gather key product insights to improve your product area.
  • Build a deep understanding of the intersection between our customers and our trusted agents to drive these insights back into our product strategy.
  • Make critical product and business decisions in an area that is highly ambiguous and requires the synthesis of data, feedback and customer insights
  • Creating product vision and roadmaps to advance our product strategy in the market and presenting this to key customers and stakeholders
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to review product strategy, build consensus and ensure alignment.
  • Provide status updates, action plans and recommendations to senior leadership on an ongoing basis
  • Partner with our operations teams to streamline the onboarding of new notaries and agents to our platform.
  • Partner with our strategy team to define new business opportunities and business models for agents to earn on our platform.
  • Shape the GTM strategy for how we drive engagement and community within our network of trusted agents.
  • Partner with the Fraud Operations team and Customer Support to respond to cases of fraud, creating a feedback loop for the platform.
  • Research and introduce new technologies that can be incorporated into our product (for example, technologies such as machine learning, computer vision, PKI, real-time analytics, etc.)
  • Define the work for our engineering team by writing functional specs, prioritizing roadmaps, troubleshooting customer issues and managing the day-to-day execution of several software development projects.
  • Partner across Solutions, Customer Success, Sales and Engineering to advance the mission of our Trust Platform.

What were looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience in software development (ideally with a mix of SaaS, startup, B2B/B2C experience)
  • 5+ years of experience in technical product management
  • 3+ years of experience with design thinking product methodology
  • Ability to influence, negotiate and drive results
  • Excellent communication skills and executive presence
  • Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.
  • A solid toolbox of product management skills
  • A passion for building great customer experiences
  • You thrive in ambiguity and believe every problem has many solutions

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

The Billing Team is dedicated to building, maintaining, and evolving the technological backbone and functionality that underpin Toptal’s financial operations across all business areas. We’re looking for a full-stack engineer with a front-end focus who is comfortable working across the front-end and back-end, and who is keen to lead initiatives and work closely with our Product team.

By joining the team, you’ll have the opportunity to work on multiple applications, mainly in React front-end and Ruby on Rails back-end. We love TypeScript and Ruby, and heavily use GraphQL for communication between our front-end SPA apps and their back-ends. At Toptal, we push the boundaries of what’s possible every single day, and we’d love for you to be a part of it.

We strive to build performant, scalable, and well-organized apps that are aligned with business goals and non-functional requirements. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. ### Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Write elegant, efficient, and testable React and Ruby code that is easy to maintain and debug.
  • Write, update, and integrate your features with React front-end components.
  • Implement and maintain Ruby on Rails APIs to support seamless communication between front-end and back-end systems.
  • Cover code with tests and perform manual testing of features, while reviewing the work of colleagues.
  • As a true teammate, continuously improve the team’s processes, brainstorm ideas, and communicate statuses and progress.
  • Mentor other people, provide feedback, and grow as a part of the team.
  • Learn new concepts and technologies.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Be introduced to Toptal’s practices and processes.
  • Start participating in company-wide training sessions.
  • Set up your local environment and get familiar with our tech stack.
  • Create your first pull request.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Familiarize yourself with the team’s business domain.
  • Contribute to our product development.
  • Develop a deeper understanding of our technology, processes, and product pipeline.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Actively supply software planning, development, and maintenance.
  • Suggest and implement improvements to Toptal’s processes and codebase, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Lead technical initiatives in our team.
  • Drive improvements to the codebase and processes.
  • Take part in the on-call rotation.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have a detailed understanding of Toptal’s technical stack, collaboration rituals, processes, and performance.
  • Mentor Toptal’s new team members.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • 5+ years of web development experience.
  • Proficient in React and TypeScript, capable of integrating front-end components with back-end systems.
  • Have hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails.
  • Have a demonstrable understanding of back-end and development principles, databases, clean code, and best testing practices.
  • Proactive and adaptable, able to lead projects and work effectively within cross-functional teams.
  • Consider multiple quality dimensions like user impact, failure tolerance, code maintenance, implementation time, availability, security breaches, and performance.
  • Tackle complex problems but also consider multiple solutions, weigh them, and decide on the best course of action.
  • Be genuinely interested in technology and love to try new things.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of clearly explaining complex concepts.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

About the Team

The Consumer Marketing team is committed to bringing DoorDash’s mission of empowering local economies to life for consumers across Canada. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for Canadian cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow those businesses and the communities that support them.

To bring this mission to life, we’re looking for a marketer who will sit at the intersection of growth, brand and operations to help execute integrated marketing strategies for our consumer business at DoorDash Canada. As part of New Verticals, we aim to grow our non-restaurant businesses – including grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail and more. This role will help drive acquisition, retention, and habituation of consumers across New Verticals in Canada, and will make an impact by exercising influence, collaboration, and creative problem-solving across teams.

About the Role

As Manager, you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution of our New Vertical acquisition, retention, and habituation efforts in Canada, helping define who we target, where we target, and how we communicate to consumers, in partnership with your manager and the New Verticals Strategy & Operations team. This position blends product marketing with growth marketing initiatives, giving you the opportunity to craft innovative campaigns and solutions that get Canadian consumers to try, come back to, and build lasting habits with DoorDash’s New Verticals.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own the day-to-day strategy and execution of New Vertical acquisition, retention, and habituation campaigns in Canada.
  • Own the launch of new New Verticals Merchants on the DoorDash platform, driving awareness and trials for these new partners.
  • Get the opportunity to work on both 0 to 1 tests and always-on programs that let you drive impact across the full New Vertical consumer journey, from first order to habitual use.
  • Act as a go-to expert on the New Vertical consumer, deeply understanding their pain points across the acquisition, retention, and habituation lifecycle.
  • Help develop and execute the consumer strategy (the “what” and “how”), encompassing goals, category focus, and core value proposition, keeping the Canadian consumer at the heart of our approach.
  • Partner cross-functionally across Brand, Creative, Retention, and Performance Marketing to bring the strategy to life with campaigns and initiatives across paid, owned, earned, and in-app channels.
  • Interface and collaborate frequently with counterparts in product, strategy + operations, analytics, and finance to execute integrated strategies and report out on key initiatives / campaigns.
  • Track and report on primary metrics for your workstream, including iGOV, iMAU, New Trials, as well as efficiency and quality metrics
  • Stay current on marketing best practices, Canadian cultural trends, and the competitive landscape.

We’re excited about you because…

You have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in marketing in a corporate or startup environment
  • Fluency across the marketing mix, with an understanding of marketing principles across the full funnel, including both acquisition and retention/lifecycle marketing
  • The ability to connect with people, build relationships and influence without authority
  • A strategic, business-minded approach; you find trends in the data and look to gather audience-first insights
  • A creative and collaborative inclination; you love working with a team and solving challenging problems in new ways
  • An extraordinary bias for action; you’re dependable, self-motivated and able to multi-task
  • A track record of delivering measurable results through integrated marketing campaigns
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Paid marketing experience preferred
  • CRM or lifecycle marketing experience a plus

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash

  • We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
  • We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.
  • We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.
  • We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.
  • We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.
  • We offer great compensation packages and comprehensive health benefits.

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.
$113,000—$141,000 CAD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Actively involved in an evangelical Christian church

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, preferred

  • Security+ or CISSP certification

  • GIAC, CCSK, or CCSP certification

SVP, Client Partner - Energy/Utilities

Location: Remote based role in the US on the East Coast

Travel: Regular 

Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

As an SVP, Client Partner, you own a portfolio of enterprise accounts: pursuing new logos, growing existing relationships, and leading the strategy, commercial success, and delivery quality of every engagement. Delivery and Product Management roll up to you, so what we ship and how it lands are yours to set. Over time, you also build the firm’s thought leadership and the repeatable solutions and patterns that make Robots and Pencils sharper in the domains your portfolio covers.

Why This Role Matters

You are the face of Robots and Pencils in the market and the steward of our clients' outcomes inside the firm. Across your portfolio, you set the strategy, drive the growth, and build the offerings and talent that decide what we're known for next. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days; that pace holds only when someone runs the portfolio like their own business, sets the bar on craft, and has the courage to make the hard calls early.

What You’ll Do

Portfolio Ownership & Delivery

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise clients end-to-end (P&L, client success, delivery quality, and multi-year account strategy), meeting or exceeding revenue and margin targets.
  • Set delivery direction across your accounts, align outcomes to client business goals, and drive estimating and pricing that protect both impact and profitability.
  • Get ahead of risk, trade-offs, and scope conversations early, before they cost the relationship or the result.

Client Trust & Growth

  • Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with C-suite stakeholders, listening past the brief to uncover real business drivers and challenging assumptions when it serves the work.
  • Translate progress into business impact (ROI, milestones, decisions) in a cadence that builds executive confidence and demonstrates ongoing value.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Delivery on pipeline, forecasting, resourcing, and multi-year growth plans for your portfolio.

Firm Building & Thought Leadership

  • Win complex, high-value deals by shaping offerings, pricing, and pursuit strategy that open new ground for the firm.
  • Mentor VP, Client Partners and Delivery Managers, and act as a talent magnet who attracts the next generation of Robots and Pencils leaders.
  • Codify reusable IP, cross-vertical offerings, and delivery practices that raise margins and become benchmarks others adopt. Represent the firm externally to convert that visibility into pipeline.

What You’ll Bring

  • 15+ years in consulting, digital, or AI and technology services, with senior ownership of enterprise portfolios or verticals and full P&L accountability.
  • A proven record of multi-million-dollar growth, complex deal wins, and sustaining executive (VP and C-suite) relationships that renew and expand.
  • Depth in applied AI, cloud (AWS preferred), digital product, and experience design, with the ability to translate technology into measurable business outcomes.
  • Vertical depth in Energy/Utilities.
  • A track record leading globally distributed delivery (onshore and offshore), with operational fluency across forecasting, pricing, utilization, and margin management.
  • Visible market presence (speaking, publishing, alliances) that builds external pull for the firm.
  • Willingness to travel regularly to meet clients where they work.

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • MBA and/or certifications such as PMP, PgMP, or SAFe. Impact and outcomes still matter most.
  • Experience selling or scaling AI co-worker, agentic, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise.

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

Description

AWS Cloud Engineer

Location: US / Canada (Eastern Time) - Home based

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About AllCloud

AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io

﻿

Job Summary

AllCloud is seeking an AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, and deploy highly scalable, reliable, and secure cloud environments for our customers. In this role, you will focus on delivering complex cloud projects, including large-scale migrations from on-premises data centers to AWS, containerized application deployment (including Amazon EKS), building new landing zones, and implementing infrastructure-as-code using modern automation frameworks. You will be responsible for setting up, maintaining, and evolving AWS architectures; developing automation to streamline delivery; ensuring robust monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting practices; and leveraging cutting-edge AWS services to help customers achieve their business goals. This position is hands-on, customer-facing, and integral to driving successful AWS delivery engagements.

Requirements

Summary of Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, deploy, and maintain scalable, highly available, and secure AWS infrastructure for project needs (e.g., compute, storage, networking, database).
  • Lead or participate in cloud migrations: lifting and shifting on-premises workloads, re-architecting to cloud-native services.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines (for example via AWS CodePipeline / AWS CodeBuild / Jenkins / GitLab CI) to automate deployment workflows.
  • Implement serverless solutions using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and integrate event-driven architectures where appropriate.
  • Containerize applications (Docker) and orchestrate microservices using AWS container platform services, with a strong focus on Amazon EKS, ECS, and Fargate.
  • Ensure monitoring, logging, alerting, tracing of AWS resources and applications using tools like CloudWatch, X-Ray, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack.
  • Apply best practices around security: IAM policies, least privilege, encryption (at rest/in transit), network segmentation (VPCs, subnets), Web Application Firewall (WAF), GuardDuty, AWS Shield, etc.
  • Implement backup, disaster recovery and high availability strategies; manage data redundancies, snapshots, multi-AZ / multi-region architectures.
  • Optimize cost & performance: right-sizing resources, identifying waste, designing for efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues in cloud infrastructure and services; conduct root cause analyses.
  • Maintain documentation for architectures, configurations, standard operating procedures, runbooks.
  • Engage with cross-functional teams: developers, QA, operations, security/compliance, and project managers to ensure successful delivery.
  • Communicate proactively and effectively with clients to understand technical needs, provide progress updates, and articulate complex solutions clearly.
  • Apply critical thinking and strategic problem-solving to evaluate trade-offs, identify root causes, and design robust cloud architectures.
  • Stay up to date on the latest AWS services, features, industry best practices; evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements.
  • Perform deep OS-level troubleshooting and system administration across both Linux and Windows environments operating in the cloud.

Summary of Requirements & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or relevant field (or equivalent work experience).
  • 3-5+ years of hands-on experience working with AWS in an engineering or infrastructure role (seniority adjustable).
  • Strong knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, S3, VPC, RDS / Aurora, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.
  • Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools: Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker, Kubernetes / Amazon EKS, ECS, and Fargate.
  • Proven ability to debug and troubleshoot complex container workload issues in Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and AWS ECS environments.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions.
  • Solid scripting skills (Python, Bash, NodeJS, PowerShell, or similar) for automating tasks.
  • Working familiarity with monitoring, logging, tracing tools (e.g. CloudWatch, X-Ray, ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, and compliance (VPCs, subnets, security groups, network ACLs, encryption, identity management).
  • Experience in project delivery: working in agile or scrum environments, estimating work, delivering against milestones.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills—able to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Deep technical knowledge and hands-on experience with OS-level administration, configuration, and advanced troubleshooting for both Linux and Windows Server platforms.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills with a proven track record of building trust and managing technical discussions with stakeholders.
  • Exceptional critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and decisive problem-solving capabilities under complex or ambiguous scenario conditions.

Why work for us?

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development.

raw.description:
At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement. Join our Qrew!

EQT is building a fleet of AI agents that work alongside our people, and we need an AI Engineer to help it grow. You'll join an AI team that builds the shared tools agents rely on, configures and deploys the agents themselves, and keeps the whole fleet healthy once it's live.

Our agents already run in production on Microsoft Foundry, posting into Salesforce and the enterprise systems our people use every day. The next step is scale: many more agents, built faster, with business users helping tune them.

As an AI Engineer, you build and maintain the capabilities our agents run on, and you monitor and optimize the agent fleet once it's in production. You set up the configuration for each prompt agent and customize its tools. Then you hand off to AI Specialists and domain experts, who test against real cases and tune the prompts until the agent is right.

When reasoning alone can't do the job reliably, you build a pro-code hosted agent or specialized tooling. That's the exception, not the plan.

Who thrives here:

  • You think agentically. You trust reasoning models to do most of the heavy lifting, and you reach for deterministic code where the outcome must be guaranteed, not by default.
  • You build for flexibility. You'd rather ship an agent that improves as models get better and cheaper than hardcode every scenario and fall behind.
  • You favor progress over perfection. You'd rather get many useful agents live and improve them than polish one forever.
  • You make others better. You enjoy building the tools and patterns that let business users and new builders do more on their own.
  • You're excited about where AI is going. You follow the field, try new models and tools as they land, and want to help an organization change how it works.

The AI Engineer I/II/III responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build and maintain shared agent tools and capabilities.
  • Configure Foundry prompt agents: instructions, model selection, tool assignments, permissions, and guardrails, ready for others to test and tune.
  • Customize and extend tools when an agent needs something the shared set doesn't yet cover.
  • Partner with AI Specialists and domain experts as they test against real cases, and coach them on prompt design and evaluation.
  • Deploy agents and monitor the fleet through the Foundry control plane: evaluations, monitoring and alerts, audit trail, and cost.
  • Optimize agents in production, and recognize when a deployment is drifting or needs tighter guardrails, better data, or a narrower scope.
  • Build pro-code hosted agents or specialized tooling when review shows a prompt agent can't do the job reliably.
  • Ensure agents adhere to our security and identity standards.
  • Help shape the Agent Factory standards and share what you learn, so the next agent is faster to build than the last.
  • Stay current with models, agent frameworks, and Foundry features, and bring forward ideas that move more work from code to reasoning.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (computer science, engineering, information systems, or similar), or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, or AI/ML roles.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-based agents or applications: prompt design, tool calling, retrieval, and evaluating outputs against real cases.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals in Python, including git, code review, testing, and working with APIs.
  • Working experience with Microsoft Azure or a similar cloud platform, including identity, permissions, and secrets management.
  • Comfort working across enterprise systems and data, including SQL and integrating with platforms like Salesforce and Databricks.
  • Judgment about when code is the right answer versus when a well-designed prompt and the right tools are simpler and just as successful.
  • Clear communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs to business partners and coach non-engineers as they test and tune agents.

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • Experience with Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry): prompt agents, hosted agents, tools, evaluations, and the control plane.
  • Exposure to agent frameworks and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce (configuration, security model, Flow) and the Databricks ecosystem (Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL).
  • Experience operating AI in production: monitoring, evaluation harnesses, cost tracking, and responsible AI practices such as PII handling, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review.

Remote work is being considered for this role excluding the following states: California, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, and Tennessee unless willing to relocate.

Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level.

1. Role Summary

The Director of Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for establishing, leading, and managing the organization's Project Management Office to ensure effective governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of strategic and operational projects.

The role oversees the project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate operations, technology, digital transformation, and business development functions. The Director of PMO ensures projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and organizational objectives while maintaining effective risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will drive project management excellence, strengthen governance frameworks, improve delivery performance, and ensure that project outcomes contribute to business growth, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PMO Strategy, Leadership & Governance

  • Establish, develop, and lead the organization's Project Management Office.
  • Define PMO strategy, policies, methodologies, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement standardized project management processes, tools, templates, and reporting structures.
  • Establish project approval processes, stage gates, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Promote project management best practices across departments and business units.
  • Ensure alignment between project execution and corporate strategy.

B. Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the organization's project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Evaluate project proposals, business cases, feasibility studies, and investment requirements.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, financial impact, risk, and resource availability.
  • Monitor project dependencies, interdepartmental coordination, and portfolio-level risks.
  • Provide recommendations to senior management regarding project prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Track portfolio performance and ensure delivery of expected business benefits.

C. Project Planning & Execution

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution of strategic projects.
  • Ensure project managers develop comprehensive project plans, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and identify delays, delivery challenges, and performance gaps.
  • Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to maintain project delivery commitments.
  • Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

D. Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee projects related to insurance operations, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution.
  • Coordinate initiatives involving investment operations, financial products, portfolio reporting, and client services, where applicable.
  • Support the implementation of regulatory, compliance, risk management, and internal control initiatives.
  • Monitor projects involving new product development, market expansion, operational improvements, and business integration.
  • Ensure project deliverables reflect the operational and regulatory requirements of the insurance and financial services industry.

E. Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Oversee technology-enabled transformation projects, including core insurance systems, CRM, ERP, digital platforms, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with IT, technology, operations, and business teams to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor technology project budgets, vendor performance, implementation timelines, and delivery quality.
  • Support digitalization, process automation, data management, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Ensure technology projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

F. Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and monitor project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure reports.
  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources.
  • Monitor project costs, financial variances, and budget performance.
  • Evaluate project financial risks and recommend cost-control measures.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Procurement teams on project funding, contracts, and vendor payments.
  • Assess project return on investment (ROI) and benefits realization.

G. Risk Management, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish project risk management frameworks and escalation mechanisms.
  • Identify, assess, and monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
  • Monitor project quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed specifications.
  • Maintain project documentation, audit trails, and management records.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams.

H. Performance Monitoring & Executive Reporting

  • Develop project dashboards, management reports, and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Present project status, risks, budget performance, and delivery updates to executive leadership.
  • Provide timely visibility into project delays, resource constraints, and critical dependencies.
  • Monitor project KPIs and ensure accountability among project managers.
  • Lead project review meetings and portfolio governance sessions.
  • Recommend improvements to project delivery processes and organizational performance.

I. Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Lead and develop project managers, PMO analysts, and project support professionals.
  • Build strong working relationships with senior executives, department heads, project sponsors, and external vendors.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination across business units and functional teams.
  • Develop project management capabilities through training, coaching, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, Finance, or a relevant discipline is preferred.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 10–15 years of progressive professional experience in project management, program management, or portfolio management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership or Director-level position.
  • Proven experience establishing, managing, or transforming a Project Management Office.
  • Experience overseeing complex, enterprise-wide projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Background in insurance, banking, financial services, investment management, or related industries is highly desirable.
  • Experience managing large project portfolios, budgets, resources, and multiple project teams.
  • Exposure to digital transformation, technology implementation, business process improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Managing Successful Programmes (MSP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

- Lean Six Sigma certification.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic project and portfolio management.
  • PMO governance and operational leadership.
  • Financial planning and budget management.

- Risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Executive communication and stakeholder management.
  • Change management and business transformation.
  • Leadership, team development, and decision-making.
  • Project management systems and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and delivery success rate.

- Project cost and schedule variance.

  • Achievement of project milestones and strategic objectives.

- Project benefits realization and ROI.

  • Effectiveness of project governance and reporting.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project sponsor feedback.
  • PMO process maturity and continuous improvement.
  • Compliance with project management standards and regulatory requirements.
