raw.excerpt: 以下为中文版本Role OverviewExperience focus 5–7 yearsYou will own the product direction, priorities and measurable outcomes of an assigned mobile game or substantial product area.
raw.description:
以下为中文版本

Role Overview

Experience focus 5–7 years

You will own the product direction, priorities and measurable outcomes of an assigned mobile game or substantial product area. You will connect player insight, game design and commercial goals, then work with the team to turn those choices into releases, experiments and product improvements.

You will work closely with Game Design, UX, Art, Engineering, QA, Analytics, User Acquisition, Monetization and Finance, as well as publishing or development partners where relevant. You will lead through clear decisions and cross-functional coordination, with budgets and approval authority defined for your product scope.

I. KEY JOB DUTIES

1. Product strategy and player discovery

  • Define target players, product problems and priorities using market research, competitor analysis, player feedback and behavioral data.
  • Build business cases and maintain an outcome-led roadmap. Compare player value, commercial potential, effort and risk, and explain what to build, defer or stop.
  • Plan discovery, prototypes and playtests to test important assumptions before larger investment. Update recommendations when evidence changes.

2. Gameplay and monetization

  • Partner with Game Design and UX to improve the core loop, onboarding, difficulty, progression and session experience for the intended audience.
  • Evaluate economy sources and sinks, reward pacing, ad placements and purchase offers with specialists. Apply the systems relevant to the game.
  • Balance revenue opportunities with retention, progression and player experience. Validate changes and investigate unintended effects.

3. Product analytics and experimentation

  • Define product metrics, tracking requirements and data-quality checks. Use cohort and funnel analysis to investigate player behavior and performance changes.
  • Set testable hypotheses, primary measures, guardrails and decision criteria. Review experiment validity and uncertainty with analysts, then decide whether to roll out, iterate or stop.

4. Feature specification and delivery

  • Translate product choices into clear requirements covering player flows, game rules, edge cases, tracking needs and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate milestones, specialist estimates, capacity and dependencies across Design, Art, Development and QA.
  • Resolve ambiguity and delivery risks early. Negotiate scope, timing and quality trade-offs and escalate decisions outside your authority.

5. Product quality and release management

  • Review technical constraints and product risks with Engineering. Agree release-readiness and quality criteria with Engineering and QA.
  • Coordinate rollout checks and monitoring. During live incidents, clarify player and commercial impact and work through the incident owner on recovery priorities, communication and follow-up.

6. Live operations and publishing

  • Set priorities appropriate to the game lifecycle, balancing new features, content, events and technical health.
  • Review event and content results by player segment and recommend changes based on player response, operating effort and commercial value.
  • Align product readiness with acquisition, store positioning, localization and launch plans. Review acquisition-cohort quality with User Acquisition and manage partner commitments where assigned.

7. Commercial outcomes and accountability

  • Translate business goals into measurable product outcomes with clear baselines and guardrails. Review retention, monetization and relevant cohort economics with Analytics, Finance and User Acquisition.
  • Explain results, investigate material deviations and follow through on corrective actions or investment recommendations. Manage delegated budgets and report product decisions and risks to product or studio leadership.

8. AI adoption and team collaboration

  • Use approved AI tools to improve suitable product workflows, including research support, requirements, localization checks and analysis assistance. Verify outputs and protect company, player and partner information.
  • Measure AI benefits after review and rework. Establish useful review checkpoints and coach junior colleagues in reliable application.
  • Build cross-functional alignment, resolve recurring coordination issues and turn research, experiments and retrospectives into applied learning.

II. QUALIFICATIONS AND CAPABILITIES

Experience and educational background

  • 5–7 years of relevant experience in product management or adjacent game roles, with demonstrated ownership of mobile game features, systems or a product area through delivery and evaluation.
  • A relevant background in product management, game design, business, technology or a related discipline, gained through education or equivalent practical experience.
  • Practical experience using player and commercial evidence to make product decisions. Be prepared to explain your contribution, the trade-offs, the results and what you changed afterward.
  • Global mobile game experience: Experience managing at least one globally released mobile game with 1 million or more cumulative installs is preferred; experience with 5 million or more installs is a strong advantage. Candidates should demonstrate their ownership scope and measurable contribution to product performance.

Knowledge

  • Mobile free-to-play models, player segmentation, core loops, onboarding, progression and difficulty. Understand the economy and advertising or purchase model relevant to the game.
  • Product metrics and cohort economics, including retention, conversion, revenue per active user, lifetime value and acquisition cost, with consistent definitions and time windows.
  • Product discovery, experimentation, game production workflows, requirements and release-quality concepts. Understand enough about technical constraints to work effectively with specialists.
  • AI capabilities and limitations, output verification and responsible handling of confidential data and generated material.

Skills

  • Prioritize roadmaps, build business cases and turn ambiguous problems into clear product requirements and practical plans.
  • Analyze funnels and cohorts, frame hypotheses and interpret experiments with appropriate analytical support. Work confidently with relevant analytics and collaboration tools.
  • Communicate product recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Negotiate trade-offs and align cross-functional or partner commitments.
  • Coordinate resources, dependencies and risks, and provide useful feedback and coaching to junior colleagues.

Abilities and working approach

  • Exercise independent product judgment within an agreed scope, make proportionate decisions with incomplete information and escalate material risks early.
  • Balance player experience, commercial goals and development constraints, and distinguish evidence from assumptions or misleading metric changes.
  • Take ownership through post-release evaluation, acknowledge failed assumptions and adapt priorities when results or constraints change.
  • Lead through influence, encourage constructive challenge and apply learning consistently to improve the next decision.
  • Language proficiency: Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English, both spoken and written, to communicate effectively with development partners and international stakeholders.
  • Platform adaptability: Ability to quickly assess and respond to Google Play and App Store policy and technical changes, coordinating necessary product and release updates with relevant teams while protecting player experience and business performance.

III. EXPECTED DELIVERABLES AND OUTCOMES

You are expected to deliver the following within your assigned product scope:

  • A clear product direction and prioritized roadmap, supported by player needs, commercial reasoning and documented trade-offs.
  • Actionable discovery and experiment results that resolve important uncertainties and lead to explicit continue, change or stop decisions.
  • Clear feature specifications and realistic delivery plans, with visible ownership, dependencies, acceptance criteria and release risks.
  • Measurable progress against agreed player and commercial objectives, supported by reliable data, post-release reviews and timely corrective action.
  • Coordinated releases and lifecycle plans that balance player experience, product quality and operating effort.
  • Reliable AI-assisted workflows and evidence of stronger collaboration or junior capability through applied learning and coaching.
  • Specific targets, baselines, player cohorts, guardrails and review periods will be agreed for the game and its lifecycle stage. Performance will be assessed through the quality of your decisions and execution, as well as the outcomes achieved within your authority and resources.

raw.description:
Fleet Data Centers designs, builds and operates mega-scale data center campuses. Fleet provides its customers flexibility and predictability to meet their upside demand forecasts, addressing a key need in the market as traditional leased models are struggling to keep pace with the demand for new Cloud and AI infrastructure. Fleet is led by a team of industry veterans that have already made a lasting imprint on the evolution of global digital infrastructure and are committed and uniquely capable of upleveling data center development scale and operations in the face of rising demand. Fleet is well positioned to bring in-house design, engineering and operational capabilities to collaborate with customers on tailored solutions for campuses of 500MW+. This unique model enables Fleet to provide the world’s largest and most sophisticated customers a seamless extension of their own data center fleets with constant access to design innovation.

Fleet Data Centers is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Contracts Management Director focused on high-value agreements spanning EPC contractors that support islanded power/power generation solutions. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Strategic Partnerships and Development, you will lead the commercial strategy and the prepositioning of EPC contracts with key partners for Behind-the-Meter, Battery Energy Storage Systems, and related islanded power solutions. You will partner with executive leadership, Legal, Engineering, Islanded Power technical teams, development, construction, operations, and finance to negotiate complex agreements, manage commercial risk, and handover to the proper project-execution team.

How will you make a difference?

  • Lead commercial negotiations across a diverse portfolio of complex agreements (e.g., EPC to include BTM, BESS, etc.)
  • Negotiate and manage major EPC, engineering, construction, and contractor furnished/contractor installed equipment along with prepositioning related service contracts (e.g., O&M).
  • Develop commercial strategies that balance project delivery, cost, schedule, and contractual risk.
  • Provide executive leadership with commercial recommendations, negotiation strategies, and risk assessments.
  • Work with Systems and Operations teams across Supply Chain to establish contract management systems, governance procedures, and commercial controls.
  • Work with Legal to develop templates, negotiation plans, and commercial standards that improve consistency and efficiency.
  • Partnering closely with legal while maintaining ownership of commercial outcomes.
  • Support multiple high-value complex agreements simultaneously within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, Economics, Finance, Construction Management, Legal Studies, Contract Law, Business Law, Construction Management, or Supply Chain.
  • 10+ years in contracts, commercial management. Extensive experience negotiating complex agreements for large-scale capital projects within industries such as Hyperscale Data Centers, Data Center Developers, Power Generation, Energy, Utilities, Industrial Infrastructure, mission critical EPC Projects.
  • 7+ years of data center experience or mission critical, fast-paced/large-scale infrastructure or data center projects.
  • 10+ years of commercial/transactional contracts management experience including awarding, drafting, negotiation, execution, and administration. Includes an applied understanding of commercial/contract language, engineering/network practices, risk management, supply chain, or similar contracts-related experience.
  • Expertise in sourcing through contracting, cost management and optimization, supplier management, and strategic sourcing in construction, data center, or critical infrastructure sectors
  • Strong financial analysis and analytical capabilities
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Technologically adept with procurement systems and tools; Microsoft Office proficiency
  • Proven success negotiating complex EPC, construction, engineering, and supply agreements.
  • Strong “cradle to grave” understanding of complex agreements and terms that impact contracts administration, change management, claims, and associated downstream commercial risk post contract execution.
  • Ability to influence executives and other senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience negotiating complex agreements for islanded power solutions specifically for BTM and BESS.
  • Advanced Degree in business administration, economics, construction management, legal studies, contract/business law, or engineering.
  • Start-up environment/mentality with a bias for execution.
  • Strong knowledge of supply chain management tools, data analytics, and advanced reporting.
  • Knowledge of supply chain sustainability/social responsibility
  • Proficiency in contract lifecycle management (CLM) capabilities (development of business requirements through active use).
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. .

Required Traits and Skills

  • Integrity and Ethical Standards: Build trust, ensure fairness, and foster long-term, transparent relationships with suppliers.
  • Effective Communication: Clearly convey expectations and requirements to suppliers and negotiation parties, while understanding their needs and concerns. Comfortable delivering written and verbal presentations to internal leadership teams.
  • Emotional Intelligence (EQ): Understand the emotions, cultural nuances, and motivations of others, while effectively managing one's own emotions during high-pressure negotiations.
  • Strategic Thinking: Recognize how supplier relationships and negotiations align with broader organizational goals, while aiming for outcomes that benefit both parties.
  • Critical Thinking Skills: Find innovative solutions and remain flexible in addressing unexpected challenges.
  • Analytical Ability: Make data-driven decisions, assess cost structures, and identify potential risks, ensuring informed and strategic outcomes.
  • Influence and Persuasion: Effectively advocate for a position, build consensus, and secure favorable agreements without compromising relationships.
  • Operational Paranoia: Anticipate risks, identify vulnerabilities, and proactively implement mechanisms to prevent and minimize disruptions and safeguard safety, security, availability, and scale.
  • Relationship Management: Cultivate trust, collaboration, and long-term partnerships, while building a broad network that provides valuable benchmarking, industry insights, and alternative sourcing options.

Location and Travel

  • Work location is flexible to Seattle, WA, Denver, CO, Austin, TX, or Alexandria, VA. 100% Remote employees will be considered on an individual basis.
  • Regular travel, as needed, to Fleet offices as well as to meet with vendors.

Expected Salary Range

  • $190,000 - $210,000 + Discretionary Bonus.

Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Only candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship will be considered.
